description:
This position is based at our Luxembourg headquarters and requires regular office presence. The EIB offers you the opportunity to live and work in a truly international and multi\\-cultural environment. We also offer relocation support.
   

  

 The EIB, the European Union's bank, in the framework of its GRAD programme, is seeking to recruit for its Finance Directorate (FI), Capital Markets Department (CAP), Financial Markets Documentation Division (FIMA), at its headquarters in Luxembourg, a
 **Graduate** 
 .
   

  

 This is a full\\-time temporary position. The term of this contract will be 1 year.
   

  

 Panel interviews are anticipated for May 2025\\.
   

  

 Purpose
   

  

 You will support senior team members in the Finance Directorate by working on borrowing documents to ensure the Bank’s funding capabilities. Collaborating with experienced professionals, you will contribute to the Bank’s mission as the Bank of the European Union and a leader in climate finance.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for their chance to gain documentation and transactional experience in the capital markets area of the Bank.
   

  

 Operating Network
   

  

 You will report to the Head of Division, and work in close collaboration with all members of the Division, and will have permanent interactions with funding officers, frequent contacts with other FI departments and JU (Legal Directorate).
   

  

 The team supports the Bank’s funding and treasury activities. This position will offer excellent opportunities to enhance financial contract and documentation skills, work on analytical and transactional tasks and collaborate with experienced colleagues, while gaining first\\-hand exposure and experience of working on capital markets issues.
   

  

**Internal contacts:** 
 as a Graduate you will interact with all FI departments and their respective management, as well as with colleagues in other Directorates, primarily in Legal (JU).
   

  

**External contacts:** 
 when required in performing your duties, the Bank’s counterparties. when required in performing your duties, the Bank’s counterparties.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

 Contribute to a wide range of capital markets related activities including:
   

  

**Borrowing**
* Support the execution of capital markets documentation for standardised transactions,
* Execute specific and defined aspects of standard documentation processes, such as:
* review and comment on term sheets and bond issue documentation (final terms and subscription agreements),
* ensure smooth closing of each standard bond issuance by following up in a prompt manner with all involved parties,


**General**
* Conduct any legal, regulatory, and operational research required in relation to the team’s documentation activities.
* Actively contribute to the improvement of the products, processes, and procedures of the Bank by analysing and identifying (also by interacting with other divisions/departments) potential changes, providing concrete proposals, and following up their implementation.
* Provide further analytic, research or other professional support as required for capital markets related documentation activities.


**Qualifications**
* University degree (minimum an equivalent to a Bachelor) preferably in Law, but degrees in Finance, Economics, Business or related field can also be considered, ideally together with a demonstrated experience with documentation matters.
* No more than two years of relevant professional experience after graduation (summer jobs and internships with a duration of less than 9 months should not be counted).
* Professional experience in legal, regulatory and/or financial area would be an advantage.
* Basic understanding of finance, financial law and documentation is required.
* In\\-depth understanding of financial law, documentation, and financial and operational aspects in relation to capital markets would be an advantage.
* Knowledge of the Bank’s standard office tools (particularly Word and Excel).
* Excellent knowledge of English. (Knowledge of other EU languages would be an advantage).


 Competencies

 here
   

  

 We hire and value talent with unique characteristics, creating a work environment where they can be themselves. We believe that Diversity, Equity and Inclusion makes us a performing and innovative organisation. We encourage all suitably qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity/expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity.
   

  

 We strongly invite applicants with a disability, neurodivergent profile or chronic condition to request reasonable accommodations at any stage during the recruitment process. Please contact the EIB Recruitment team Jobs@eib.org who will ensure that your request is handled.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge the importance of maintaining the security and integrity of the Information of the EIB Group. In case of selection for the position you agree to comply with all measures (policies, controls, document classification and management) implemented by the EIB Group to prevent unauthorised disclosure of any information or any damage to the EIB Group reputation.
   

  

 Deadline for applications:
 **23 April 2025**

title: Working Student – Marketing (Practice Area Corporate Finance & Strategy)
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 We are looking for a strong candidate to support the marketing team of the Corporate Finance \\& Strategy Practice Area in all marketing activities, ranging from internal and external communications, social media, organisation of virtual and face\\-to\\-face events to tracking, reporting and analysis of all marketing activities.
   

  

**You’re good at**
* Collaborating and being a team player, while actively bringing new ideas and challenging existing notions to inspire innovation.
* Pairing a problem\\-solving attitude with creativity, emphasizing accuracy and detail orientation in all tasks.
* Exhibiting strong interpersonal credibility, reliability, and a service mentality, ensuring trust and effectiveness in teamwork.
* Assisting in gathering, analyzing, and interpreting marketing data from various sources, developing and maintaining reports and dashboards to track key KPIs.
* Conducting competitor research and market analysis to identify trends and opportunities for development, enhancing the strategic impact of marketing initiatives.


***You can work up to 20 hours/week during your semesters and up to 40 hours/week during your vacation time. The role offers enough flexibility to combine personal, academic and professional life. This is a temporary role from min. 12 to max. 24 months. You need to be an enrolled university student in Munich.***
 What You'll Bring
   

  

* You will be currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree with outstanding academic performance in STEM subjects, business or marketing, demonstrating a keen interest in gaining a comprehensive understanding of data and analytics. Prior experience in marketing and data analytics, statistics is preferred.
* Exceptional communication skills in English (German is welcome but not mandatory), coupled with strong analytical abilities and proficiency in Microsoft Office, enabling the analysis, illustration of data, and preparation of compelling presentations and reports (Knowledge of Tableau and PowerBI is welcome but not mandatory).
* Proven organizational and project management competencies, with the ability to handle multiple tasks in a dynamic environment, showcasing attention to detail and a structured approach to problem\\-solving.
* Creative and independent with a proven track record of reliability and a high ethical standard, capable of maintaining confidentiality and demonstrating a strong service mentality.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with an affinity for technology and innovation in marketing, eager to continuously develop and apply new skills in a fast\\-paced setting, including an interest in a holistic view of marketing strategies and execution.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 In this role, you will be part of a dedicated and collaborative international team based in the US, UK and Germany. The Corporate Finance \\& Strategy marketing team is the largest practice area marketing team within BCG, supporting the practice area leadership and our consultants both regionally and globally in all areas of marketing, including external communications, social media, PR, internal communications, events, and thought leadership publications.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

 The Corporate Finance and Strategy Practice Area partners with clients to drive their success by helping CEOs and senior executives to see the "next game", identify how to maximize value creation, and translate these insights into ambitious agendas for successful transformation.
   

  

**Find Out More About What We Offer At Www.bcg.com/capabilities/corporate\\-finance\\-strategy/overview**
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

description:
Student Analyst / Data Scientist – Power \\& Hydrogen Markets
   

  

 (Internship or Working Student)
   

  

 We are currently looking for multiple student analysts/ data scientists to join our growing energy analytics team in Karlsruhe (Germany).
   

  

 During your time with us, you will help us shaping our European power, hydrogen, gas and carbon analytics and develop insight into the European energy commodity markets. As a student at ICIS, you will work on your own project, develop your own ideas and you will contribute significantly to our products. To do so, you will work together with our experienced analyst team to receive support and to have challenging discussions about your project and analysis.
   

  

 We offer our students a high degree of flexibility also related to your university schedule – you can organise your working hours independently.
   

  

 As a leading research and prognosis provider we have access to a wide range of data and optimization tools. Furthermore, we have highly skilled analysts that help you get started and provide valuable insights and a steep learning curve.
   

  

 Depending on your interests you can choose a focus area:
   

  

* supporting our power trading analysis and modelling
* our long\\-term power and renewable investment proposition or
* our upcoming hydrogen modelling and project analysis.


 On top, we will select your individual project based on your skills and interests. This could be for example the automatic data extraction using NPL (natural language processing) or modelling build out plans for heat pumps.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Development of new tools, features and later also models, using state\\-of\\-the\\-art data science methods (also using AI if needed)
* Understanding the wider energy complex consisting of power, gas, carbon, coal, hydrogen and ammonia markets
* Supporting the analyst team in the day\\-to\\-day business, analyzing the market, running the fundamental model, operations
* Implementation of model results on our client\\-facing EU analytics portal


**Key Skills**
* Affinity and basic understanding of energy markets
* Some coding skills be it Python, C\\+\\+, Java, GAMS, HTML, SQL, …
* Analytical mindset, critical thinking, and solid numerical ability
* High level of interest in learning new modelling techniques
* Good communication skills in English as you will work in an international environment
* To apply for this role you need to be enrolled at a top 10 university in Germany


**We Offer**
* A vibrant environment working alongside a dynamic and motivated team
* Insights into the European carbon, gas, hydrogen and power markets
* Exposure to key market players in the European power \\& hydrogen markets
* Active involvement and responsibility from Day 1
* Fair remuneration for students
* Great office with free drinks, vegetables and food, table football and tennis, barbeque in summer, kitchen for cooking, winter garden…

Taking ownership and thriving with empowerment. Not afraid to take calculated risks and fail. We put the customer first and have a thirst for learning. If this is you, then get in touch.*

 Studyflix ist mit über 6 Mio. Nutzern die größte kostenlose E\\-Learning\\- und Karriere\\-Plattform im DACH\\-Raum! description:
Our vision is to establish HUGO BOSS as the leading premium tech\\-driven fashion platform worldwide and to be one of the top 100 global brands. At HUGO BOSS, we work as a team to apply our knowledge, skills and experience together and create a diversity of ideas and solutions. What unites us? We love fashion, we change fashion!
   

  

 At HUGO BOSS, you have the opportunity to contribute your personality, ideas and creativity — because only when we break new ground together can we create something unique. Become part of our team of more than 19\\.000 employees worldwide and shape your future at HUGO BOSS!
   

  

**HUGO BOSS is looking for an Intern (m/f/d) to join the CRM, Customer Data \\& Analytics Team at our global headquarter in Metzingen, Germany starting 01\\.06\\.2024 for 6 months.** 
 During the internship program at HUGO BOSS, your main responsibilities will be to support our team with analysing performance of customer\\-centric marketing communications and loyalty actions from different perspectives, such as sales and data quality, and also with developing new analytical models and reporting tools.
   

  

**What you can expect:**
* You create analysis and performance reports in weekly, biweekly and monthly rhythm with a focus on customer registration quality and sales KPIs for the international markets and different stakeholders
* You are responsible for descriptive statistical analysis of customer related data with findings in development and trends across different countries
* Through the participation in internal meetings you are enabled to bring conceptual and content\\-related ideas to the table
* In addition to this, you also collect IT experience through testing new IT solutions, implementations and updates
* You support the analytics team with data exploration and developing new customer\\-oriented models


**Your profile:**
* You are studying in the field of business or economics or any comparable course of studies or have already completed your Bachelor studies
* You find exciting work with numbers and analytical tasks
* You have passion both for fashion and analytics
* You have deep knowledge of MS\\-Office (particularly Excel) or are willing to strengthen your skills proactively
* You have a very good command of spoken and written English and would like to work in an international team


**Your benefits:**
* We offer a competitive salary and attractive benefits, including vacation and Christmas bonuses, a mobility allowance / Deutschlandticket, an annual clothing allowance, a company pension scheme, and our SHIP share program.
* Made for Me: Enjoy the freedom of our flexible working models. With 'Threedom of Work', spend 3 days in Metzingen and 2 days working remotely. Benefit from our 'Me Time' program for personal time off and the option of 30 days of 'Mobile Work EU' annually.
* High\\-performing people need a healthy balance. Take advantage of the employee gym, a variety of sports activities, a 37\\-hour workweek, and 30 vacation days a year.
* Your personal development is important to us. We offer a wide range of training opportunities, both online at HUGO BOSS University and through external training providers.
* Exclusive discounts for shopping and arts: benefit from discounts for family and friends along with free entrance to more than 15 international art museums.
* Does innovation drive you? Same for us! This passion is reflected in our modern workplaces and innovative tools.
* Sustainability is one of our key values, and more than just a trend. We are committed to environmental, animal and climate protection, and human rights. As part of our commitment, we offer an environmentally friendly bus shuttle.
* We also place great importance to good taste when it comes to food. Welcome to our award\\-winning restaurant \\& café Times.


 We are a global company with our employees representative of the world at large. Our inclusive culture embraces each person’s authenticity and individuality. We are committed to equal employment opportunity. And we believe our equitable work environment helps unleash your full potential and inspires you to thrive.

What To Expect
Start date: ASAP

Duration: 6 months

Location: Gigafactory Brandenburg

Tesla is accelerating the world's transition to sustainable energy. This is only possible through extraordinary speed, innovation and efficiency. • Preferable previous experience in Supply chain processes and procurement
• CSS and Java Script front end styling preferred

, Tesla

title: Praktikum Data Analytics & Digitalisierung
description:
Einleitung

Eine gute Idee war der Ursprung, ein erfolgreiches Konzept ist das Ergebnis. Qualität zum guten Preis möglichst vielen Menschen anbieten zu können treibt uns an - mittlerweile weltweit, denn wir sind Lidl. Hier ist das berufliche Zuhause vielfältiger Talente. Ob im Einkauf, in der Logistik, im Warengeschäft oder in der IT; ob als Impulsgeber, Gestalter oder Dienstleister der Länder. Wir suchen Anpacker, Durchstarter, Möglichmacher und bieten spannende Aufgaben und Projekte in einem dynamischen und internationalen Umfeld. Bei Lidl findet jeder seine persönliche Herausforderung. Denn Lidl lohnt sich.
Deine Aufgaben
• Unterstützung der Fachbereiche und Landesgesellschaften für 4-6 Monate zur Entscheidungsfindung für aktuelle Themen im weitreichenden Unternehmenskontext durch datengetriebene Analysen
• Begleitung des gesamten Prozesses einer Analyse, von der Definition der Fragestellung und Zielsetzung bis hin zur Kommunikation einer Empfehlung
• Durchführung kleinerer Analysen mit internen und externen Daten, bspw. Effekte der Umstellung einer Werbemaßnahme
• Einblick in die Projektarbeit und Mitarbeit in Projekten aus dem Bereich Machine Learning, wo riesige Datenmengen mittels statistischer Modelle verarbeitet und ausgewertet werden
Dein Profil
• Fortgeschrittenes Studium im Bereich Statistik, (Wirtschafts-) Mathematik, Informatik, Physik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Psychologie, Sozialwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
• Grundlegendes Verständnis von Datenanalyse, idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit Python oder R
• Erste Erfahrungen mit Datenbanken und SQL wünschenswert
• Gute MS Office Kenntnisse, insbesondere Excel und Powerpoint
• Analytisches und strukturiertes Denkvermögen, Teamfähigkeit und ein Schuss Humor
• Gute bis sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse
Wir bieten

Lidl legt Wert darauf, dass sich deine Zeit bei uns lohnt! Deshalb kannst du bei uns nicht nur deine Finanzen aufbessern: Du gewinnst wertvolle Praxiseinblicke in „deinen“ Fachbereich und lernst die Herausforderungen im Tagesgeschäft kennen. Master-Studierende oder Doktoranden der Volkswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsmathematik oder -informatik.
Interesse an Modellierung und empirischen Fragestellungen im Bereich der Finanzstabilität.
Gute methodische und volkswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse.

description:
All German offices

Apply via WhatsApp

Our AI & Data expert team at RB Digital supports our customers from various industries along the entire value chain in dealing with data. In this context, data-driven solutions are developed for strategic business management. For example, complex data-driven products are developed, including machine learning. Building entire data infrastructures is also part of the service portfolio.

Support the AI & Data expert team at RB Digital in Munich, Frankfurt, Düsseldorf, Hamburg, Stuttgart or Berlin immediately as an intern (full-time) for at least 3-4 months or as a working student for 16-20 hours per week for at least 6 months.

Your tasks will be:
• Taking over internal tasks focusing on data architecture, data engineering and other data-driven topics
• Supporting internal projects for the development of tools along the entire ETL or ELT process
• Active participation in further development of our infrastructure using database technologies and cloud computing

Qualifications
• Degree (FH/University) in a quantitative field (Business Informatics, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics), ideally first practical experience in data engineering’
• Enthusiasm for defining and implementing data management frameworks including data governance, metadata management, data lifecycle etc.
• Good knowledge of database technologies (e.g., Postgres, SQL Server, Cassandra, Redis) and ETL processes
• Solid knowledge of at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Scala, Java)
• Knowledge of Big Data technologies (e.g., Apache Hadoop Ecosystem, Apache Spark), cloud computing (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform) and initial experience in SAP is an advantage
• Very good English and good German skills

Benefits

Roland Berger offers all interns in DACH a large variety of benefits – from career development to wellbeing. Here’s an overview of the varios offers.

Are you a game changer and want to shape the future with us?

Munich

title: Working Student Data Analytics (f/m/d)
description:
Upvest, founded in 2017, enables any financial institution to offer great investment experiences to its customers. Upvest is an investment firm regulated by the German supervision authority (BaFin). The company currently employs 160+ people across Europe with its headquarters based in Berlin, Germany.

The company is backed by the world’s largest venture capital funds and investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, BlackRock, Earlybird, HV Capital, Notion Capital, and ABN Amro Ventures, as well as by renowned fintech entrepreneurs (including Maximilian Tayenthal, founder of N26, and Felix Haas, founder of IDnow).

We’re looking for fintech enthusiasts to join us in creating the financial infrastructure of tomorrow. We’re building the first European Investment API to enable any financial institution offering a wide range of efficient and transparent investment products, such as stocks and ETFs in nominal, portfolio, and fractional form. Our mission and vision is to make investing as easy as spending money.

We’re based in Berlin but are also open to hiring remotely in Germany or Estonia for this role. If you're currently based elsewhere but would like to move to Germany, we’re happy to support your relocation.

Your mission:

At Upvest, you'll become an integral part of our Data Management community where Analysts, and Engineers collaborate to learn and grow together. Moreover, our integrated organisational structure provides you with the opportunity to work closely across finance, product, engineering, finance, and operations areas.

This role will give you the opportunity to:
• Data Analysis and Insights: Dive into complex datasets to extract valuable insights and trends that drive data-informed decisions, ensuring our B2B offerings are optimised for success.
• Client Data Analysis & Customised Reporting: You'll conduct in-depth analysis of client data to provide actionable insights and create custom reports and data visualisations tailored to our B2B clients' specific needs, enabling them to make informed decisions and gain a competitive edge.
• Data Architecture and Tools: Collaborate on data architecture projects with a primary focus on achieving 100% data consistency. Utilise advanced tools such as DBT, BigQuery, and Looker, prioritising data quality and integrity in all data modelling and analysis tasks. This approach enhances our ability to meet client needs by ensuring consistent and reliable data.
• Cross-Functional Impact: Collaborate with various teams, including developers and product managers, to seamlessly integrate your data-driven insights into our B2B products and services, driving continuous improvement.
• Data Strategy Implementation and Product Enhancement: Play a pivotal role in executing our data strategy, ensuring that data-driven solutions are seamlessly integrated into our B2B offerings, and work to enhance our financial APIs and services based on data-driven insights that meet our clients' evolving needs. Additionally, actively support the initiative to transform our data into a standalone product, leveraging your analytical skills to develop valuable insights and features that can be marketed and sold to a wider audience, thus expanding our revenue streams and market presence

Job requirements:
• Data-Driven Impact: You will play a crucial role in our data analytics team, contributing to data collection, cleaning, and analysis. By developing analytical models, interpreting trends, and presenting your findings, you will help shape our business intelligence solutions and drive our data capabilities forward.
• Variety of Data Challenges: You'll face a diverse range of data tasks, working with various data sources. Your role will involve creating comprehensive dashboards, tackling data mining and analysis projects. Regular team discussions will provide opportunities to present your innovative solutions, fostering a collaborative environment focused on excellence and continuous improvement in data analysis.
• Collaboration: Expect a collaborative environment where you'll work closely with talented professionals across different teams, including developers, product managers, and financial experts. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do.
• Continuous Learning: You'll enjoy ongoing opportunities for professional development. We provide comprehensive training programs, workshops, and resources to enhance your data analysis skills and keep you at the forefront of industry trends.
• An experienced team and culture driven organisation: Despite the early stage of the company, we have assembled a world-class team with lots of experience across all key domains that we require for our success, from banking and risk to regulatory, legal and compliance to product and engineering. The organisation is also full of people who have successfully scaled companies before, who understand the importance of live and breath culture and “people first”.

Minimum requirements
• Graduate or current master's student in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or related fields, with at least 2 semesters completed.
• Ability to understand technical information quickly, derive insights, and devise solutions.
• Ideally, you have already gained practical experience in conducting quantitative analysis (e. g. experience abroad, internships) and are interested in financial data
• Familiarity with statistical techniques, data visualisation, and database management is advantageous.
• Experience with Business Intelligence (BI) tools such as Looker or PowerBI.
• You have good knowledge of SQL and Python (PySpark, pandas, scikit-learn) or other programming languages
• A self starter with a strong sense of ownership for your work and an ability to iterate quickly
• A team player who is excited about working with a diverse range of colleagues
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken
• Based in Berlin (where our office is located) to experience the unique team culture at Upvest
• Eligibility to work in Germany

Why Upvest?
• Greenfield projects. We’re building something quite complex and a first in Europe. This means we’re working with cutting-edge technologies and with no legacy code.
• Wellbeing. At Upvest, everyone has access to our in-house coach where you can have regular sessions to support you personally and professionally.
• Development. In keeping with one of our core values, ‘Learn and Grow’, every Upvenger has access to a development budget. In line with one of our other values, ‘Own the Outcome’, how you choose to make the most of it, is up to you.
• Flexibility. We work in a hybrid setup with the team distributed around Germany and Europe. We give you the choice (and budget) to spend your time where you are most comfortable and productive, either at home or the office. You choose.

Our values:
• Learn and grow. We aim high to shape our future. We give and request honest feedback knowing that we develop together. Progression over Perfection.
• Team first. We make it easy for others. We value our differences and are open to others' opinions. We win and celebrate together! Team over Egos.
• Own the outcome. Whether we win or we lose, we stand together. We are proactive and get the job done. Outcome over Process.
• Tell the story. We always start with the why. We share knowledge to empower others. Transparency over Complexity.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

title: Internship - Data Analytics (m/f/x)
description:
About FINN
FINN is an independent platform for car subscriptions from over 30 brands. Subscribe to a car with just a few clicks and it will be delivered directly to your doorstep in just a few days: FINN offers a carefree service and handles insurance, financing, registration, taxes and maintenance. FINN also funds climate action by supporting certified climate protection projects and thus offsets the carbon footprint of every vehicle of all drive types – from production to every mile driven.
FINN was founded in Munich in 2019. The mission: to have a positive impact on people, organizations and the planet through frictionless mobility.
More Information: www.finn.com/
Your Role
As a Data Analytics Intern you will take responsibility for enabling FINN to make data-driven decisions. This includes taking on your own projects in making our objectives measurable or creating insightful analytics. You will also work at the intersection of Data and Business Development to drive initiatives based on the insights you gain. You will work with the most cutting edge tool stack available and can play a key role in establishing a data mindset in your team. You will work closely with the team, independently drive your projects and get the opportunity to contribute to a fast growing organization.

Your Benefits
• This role is based in Munich with flexibility to work remotely a few times a week. Our modern offices feature frequent events with our great colleagues.
• With massive growth potential, FINN allows you to quickly develop and succeed in a highly motivating startup environment with bold challenges in cross-functional teams.
• Competitive fixed salary: 2.300€

Your Responsibilities
• Move fast on your own projects: At FINN you will get responsibility from day one. All projects will have a critical and immediate impact on our company and the purpose to make mobility fun and sustainable.
• Create actionable insights: Execute robust analyses, deliver actionable insights, make suggestions and support in implementing the measures across departments.
• Critically question and improve existing processes: We constantly aim to build the best version of FINN. Help us to improve our existing setup with maximum efficiency by actively proposing improvements to current processes.
• Become a data evangelist: Support your team to expand their analytical skills and educate them to become independent using and analyzing data with the tools that you learn to use (e.g. dbt, BigQuery, Looker).

Your Profile
• Available for a full-time internship lasting 6 months.
• Studying a business or engineering discipline with a focus on IT. A self-taught coding enthusiast is a great fit as well.
• Experience in a high growth startup or another analytical, high-performance environment.
• Experience working with SQL. Knowledge of other programming languages, e.g. Python, R, Java, is a plus.
• Experience with Looker, Tableau (or other BI tools) is a plus.
• Proactive, hands-on attitude and a natural curiosity about software & data tools.
• Meticulous attention to detail and joy in precise working.
• Highly analytical and comfortable around numbers.
• Fluent in English.

description:
DEINE AUFGABEN

Als Werkstudent/Praktikant (all genders) im Bereich Data Science/Analytics & AI unterstützt Du das Team bei der Gestaltung von innovative Lösungskonzepten. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen und hast direkt die Möglichkeit einen echten Fußabdruck in unserem Unternehmen zu hinterlassen.
• Du analysierst finanzielle (Prognose-)Fragestellungen, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst Konzepte für die Modellauswahl und Datenaufbereitung
• Du extrahierst Daten aus Datenbanken und bereitest sie für die Verwendung in Machine Learning Modellen auf
• Du entwickelst und konfigurierst Modelle, berechnest Metriken und optimierst die Modellkonfiguration
• Du evaluierst Modelle, Methoden und Tools für die effiziente Erstellung, Berechnung und Bereitstellung von Advanced Analytics Ergebnissen
• Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Implementierung innovativer Business Intelligence und Predictive Analytics Lösungen und arbeitest an Kundenprojekten sowie an der Entwicklung von Use Cases, zum Beispiel zur Prognose finanzieller Informationen und zur Anomalieerkennung in Finanzdaten
• Du extrahierst relevante Informationen aus Datenbanken und Web-APIs
• Du erstellst Datenmodelle und adressatenorientierte Visualisierungen

DAS BRINGST DU MIT
• Du bist in einem Studium im Bereich BWL, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert
• Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen im Rahmen eines Praktikums oder einer Werkstudententätigkeit im Bereich Data Science gesammelt
• Du zeigst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an analytischen Themen im Innovationsfeld Big Data und Advanced Analytics
• Du kennst Dich mit relevanten Programmiersprachen, insbesondere Python, sowie den Konzepten der funktionalen und objektorientierten Programmierung aus
• Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Datenbanken, insbesondere mit Microsoft SQL Server und SAP HANA
• Du verfügst über praktisches Wissen bei der Implementierung und Verwendung aktueller Machine Learning Frameworks, insbesondere Scikit-Learn und TensorFlow
• Du besitzt Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Finance, Accounting und/oder Controlling, sowohl praktisch als auch theoretisch
• Du hast Erfahrungen mit mathematisch-statistischen Methoden und Modellen, insbesondere mit Zeitreihenmodellen (ARIMA), Regressionen, Entscheidungsbäumen und neuronalen Netzen
• Idealerweise hast Du Erfahrungen in Entwicklungsworkflows und -umgebungen, insbesondere mit Git, Azure DevOps, Visual Studio Code und Docker
• Du hast ein stark ausgeprägtes Interesse an strategischen Fragestellungen und zeigst eine hohe Zahlenaffinität
• Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch

Über uns
Lerne den Spirit von valantic Digital Finance kennen. Wir suchen Consultant:in, Senior Consultant:in, Data Engineer:in, Solution Engineer:in und Manager:in - Du bist Herzlich Willkommen.

Als attraktiver Arbeitgeber lebt valantic Digital Finance Werte, achtet, fördert und unterstützt.
Erfahre hier mehr über unsere Werte und Benefits.

Fragen? Unser HR-Team steht Ihnen jederzeit zur Verfügung. Kontaktieren Sie uns einfach unterbewerbung@df.valantic.com.

description:
Externe Stellenbeschreibung
   

  

 Du willst mehr als Uni und möchtest erste Berufseinblicke und Kontakte knüpfen? Dann bist du hier richtig! Als Werkstudent oder Praktikant bei Kaufland gehörst du von Beginn an zu einem starken Team und kannst zeigen, was in dir steckt. Werde auch du Teil von \\#teamkaufland!
   

  

**Deine Aufgaben**
* Wir zählen auf dich: Du unterstützt unser Team bei der Bearbeitung unserer Analytics Use Cases entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette bei Kaufland.

* Zukunft gestalten: Du sammelst erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit den relevanten Technologien und fortgeschrittenen Machine\\-Learning\\-Methoden.
* Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Tausche dich mit Kollegen aus verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Kaufland\\-Ländern aus und profitiere von einem großen Netzwerk.


**Deine Vorteile**
* Dein Job lohnt sich: Mit einer attraktiven Vergütung und Urlaub, um Energie zu tanken.
* Heute Büro, morgen remote: In individueller Abstimmung mit deiner Führungskraft finden wir die idealen Arbeitsbedingungen für dich. So kannst du von den Vorteilen beider Arbeitswelten profitieren.
* Blick hinter die Kulissen: Gewinne interessante Eindrücke aus der Welt eines international agierenden Handelsunternehmens.
* Und sonst? Freue dich auf vielfältige Rabatte und profitiere z. B. von vergünstigten Angeboten in Fitness\\- und Freizeiteinrichtungen.


**Dein Profil**
* Du absolvierst gerade ein Studium im Bereich Statistik, (Wirtschafts\\-)Mathematik, Physik, Wirtschafts\\- oder Sozialwissenschaften, Informatik, Psychologie oder hast einen vergleichbaren Schwerpunkt? Perfekt \\- wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.
* Grundlagenkenntnissen in Statistik und Machine Learning bringst du mit. Auch mit Python oder R hast du bereits herumgetüftelt.
* Erste Erfahrungen mit Datenbanken und SQL hast du ebenfalls? Damit kannst du bei uns punkten.
* Und wie sieht's mit deinen Englisch\\- und Deutschkenntnissen aus? Fließende Kommunikation in Wort und Schrift zeichnen dich aus.


 Ein Anschreiben? Benötigen wir nicht. Klick einfach auf den Button „Jetzt bewerben“, dann geht’s los.

 Rebecca Turban
   

  

 kaufland.de/karriere

 Darmstadt \\| Befristet (Für 24 Monate) \\| Teilzeit \\| Hybrid

* Die Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von KI\\-Modellen rundet dein Aufgabengebiet ab.

* Laufendes naturwissenschaftliches oder technisches Studium, z.B. Computer / Data Science, MINT, Energiewirtschaft o.ä.

Elia Grid International has offices in Belgium, Germany, the United Arab Emirates (UAE), the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), Malaysia, and Thailand.

  


**Your function**



EGI wishes to reinforce its team working on **Owner's Engineering (OE)** to support the preparation, planning and construction of high\\-voltage projects. To achieve this, we are looking for a **motivated full\\-time intern/part\\-time working student** to support the team.

  


**Typical activities involve (but are not limited to):**


* Participate in site visits and construction meetings.
* Assist in the reviewing of planning and construction documents.
* Perform research and gather relevant technical data to support project deliverables.
* Analyse construction methodologies and propose optimization ideas.
* Provide support on the preparation of proposals and acquisition of projects.

  


**Your profile**


* Currently pursuing a Master’s degree or at the end of a bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering.
* Good understanding of permitting procedures for construction projects.
* Motivated quick\\-learning team player.
* Experience with MS Office and MS\\-Visio, knowledge of AutoCAD would be an asset.
* Interest in solving problems and taking on new challenges.
* Fluent in English and German.

  


**What we offer**


* Fair compensation with flexible working hours \\- **6 months duration min**.
	+ 37h/week for interns.
	+ up to 20h/week for working students.
* A mentor who will guide you and give you regular feedback.
* The opportunity to quickly take responsibility and leverage your knowledge and skills, to get hands\\-on project experience in the planning and construction of High Voltage AC Substations, HVDC Converter Stations and other electrical infrastructure.
* Having the resources to work on the solutions to succeed in the energy transition worldwide.


At EGI, we value diversity and inclusion. We are firmly committed to promoting gender equality in all aspects of our organization, from recruitment to professional development. We believe that diverse teams are more creative, innovative, and high\\-performing. Join us to contribute to an environment where everyone has equal opportunities for growth and fulfilment.



Choose EGI and help us guide the worldwide power sector into a future of clean and sustainable energy, smarter and more flexible grids, decentralized production and HVDC systems that span across seas and land to interconnect countries, regions, and different energy markets for the benefit of generations to come.

  


**Location**



Berlin

  


**Please send your CV and cover letter in ENGLISH.**

  


**Want to know more about us?**



Check our website and our LinkedIn page for last news and updates.

description:
FINN is an independent platform for car subscriptions from over 30 brands. Subscribe to a car with just a few clicks and it will be delivered directly to your doorstep in just a few days: FINN offers a carefree service and handles insurance, financing, registration, taxes and maintenance. FINN was founded in Munich in 2019\\. The mission: to have a positive impact on people, organizations and the planet through frictionless mobility. More Information: finn.com **Your Role**  

As a Business Development Intern in the CFLO (Chief Fleet Officer) Office, you will work directly with the Chief of Staff \\- Fleet (Thomas), the SVP Fleet (Paul), the Chief Fleet Officer (Jürgen) and the management team in supporting their day\\-to\\-day business and individually plan and execute projects. You will get the opportunity to join a fast\\-growing organization working towards selling a smart product with a huge market fit. This role is ideal for someone with initial experience in fast\\-paced, high\\-performance environments who is eager to gain deeper insights and drive meaningful impact.
### **Your Benefits**

* With massive growth potential, FINN allows you to quickly develop and succeed in a highly motivating startup environment with ambitious cross\\-functional teams.
* Excellent fixed salary: 2\\.300€ per month.
* Discounted E\\-Gym Wellpass membership enabling you to be active in various gyms within Germany.
* Our open, modern office in the middle of Munich is known for loads of fun with amazing colleagues and frequent team events.

### **Your Responsibilities**

* **Support the business:** Help the Fleet management team to master daily challenges, drive high\\-priority initiatives and get deep insights into our department and the entire company.
* **Manage and drive cross\\-departmental projects and tasks:** At FINN, you will get responsibility from day one. You will support and steer projects across different departments that have a critical impact on our company and directly relate to making mobility fun and sustainable.
* **Steering \\& KPI reporting:** Support in the Fleet department’s reporting process by tracking key performance indicators, ensuring targets are met, identifying risks, and driving strategic solutions.
* **Question the status quo:** Critically examine and optimize existing processes to enhance efficiency, helping us build a world\\-class, data\\-driven organization that runs seamlessly.

### **Your Profile**

* You are pursuing a degree in business administration, finance, economics, industrial engineering, or a related field with a strong academic track record and outstanding achievements.
* Previous experience in consulting, startups, or another fast\\-paced environment.
* Ability to quickly adapt to shifting priorities in an evolving business environment, while effectively coordinating and managing multiple projects.
* Strong problem\\-solving skills with innovative and creative approaches to overcoming them.
* Proficiency in data analysis, with a high level of comfort working with numbers and translating insights into actionable business strategies.
* Genuine interest in and curiosity about the mobility industry, with the ability to stay informed on industry trends.
* Availability for an internship of 4 to 6 months.
* Fluency in both German and English.

**Interested?**  

Please upload your CV online. Thomas and Luisa are looking forward to your application! **Equal Opportunities for Everyone**  

FINN is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are open to all groups of people without regard to age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Internship/Project Support Health and Safety (m/f/d)
description:
**Reference ID**: 41968


Are you looking for a working student job where you can do more than just watch? Or do you want to focus your thesis on something that is really in demand in the industry? Then Döhler is exactly what you're looking for! As a global producer, marketer and provider of technology\\-driven natural ingredients, ingredient systems and integrated solutions for the food and beverage industry, we are looking for people just like you, who are inquisitive and want to break the mould. People who are motivated to deliver only the best.

  


**Project Description:**


As part of a global initiative to strengthen our commitment to health and safety, we are seeking dedicated support to help drive this important project forward. The goal is to develop a clear, structured overview of the current safety performance at our production sites worldwide. By assessing and categorizing each site according to its level of safety maturity, we aim to highlight strengths, identify focus areas, and uncover opportunities for continuous improvement and knowledge sharing across the organization.

  


**Methodology:**


The assessment will be carried out using the following methods:


* Survey and Questionnaires: Gathering employee feedback on health and safety practices.
* Interviews and Focus Groups: Conducting in\\-depth discussions with key personnel to gain valuable insights.
* Document Reviews: Reviewing health and safety records, reports, and compliance documentation
* Benchmarking: Comparing practices against industry standards and best practices.

  




**Your tasks**


* Supporting the creation and execution of surveys and interviews.
* Analyzing and interpreting the collected data.
* Documenting and reporting findings and insights.
* Assisting in the preparation of a structured report for management.
* Collaborating closely with the global EHS team and other stakeholders.

**Your profil**


* Completed bachelor's degree or currently pursuing a master's degree in engineering, safety management, hazard control or health and safety.
* Initial project work experience is an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel, PowerPoint) and MS Teams.
* Independent, structured, and proactive working style.
* Excellent English skills (German language skills an advantage).

  




**Project Duration:**


* 6\\-9 months

**Your Benefits**


* The motivating working atmosphere, of a high\\-tech, innovative company
* The possibility to realize your own ideas
* The chance of experiencing new ways

  




**Your Contact Person**


Please apply online and provide us with your earliest possible entry date. Valerie Krämer will get back to you as soon as possible.


Please take into consideration, that we cannot accept any other channel or send back hard copy applications.

description:
**Your opportunity**
Luminovo is revolutionizing the electronics supply chain with AI\\-powered solutions that enhance efficiency and collaboration.
  

  

Our Luminerds need money (and a work place), our customers are paying us money, and at the end of the month, there should always be some of it left — all of this will be your area of responsibility as our **Working Student in Finance.**  

  

 **Key highlights**
* You’re responsible for the flow of many EUR millions per year — both in and out of our bank accounts.
* You’re part of a Finance \\& Operations team that is constantly trying to cut redundant steps through automations, AI, and other clever tools. We grow our revenue by \\~100% per year, but try to keep our team as constant as possible. Tool\\- and automation\\-wise, we want to be so far ahead of the curve that, after your time with us, you’ll be able to apply and build on your experiences anywhere else.


**Time frame**
* Start date: May 15, 2025
* Duration: minimum 12 months
* Working hours: 15\\-20h per week
	+ You can also start with a full\\-time internship and transition into a part\\-time working student position later.

   

**Whom you’ll be working with**
* Benedikt, our Head of Operations
* Sarah, our Finance Specialist
* Naima, our internal Legal Counsel and Benedikt's Associate
* Maggie, our Legal \\& Operations Specialist
* And other Luminerds working in Operations and Revenue
 Performance objectives


To be successful in this role, you will:* At the beginning of the month, you provide fully prepared books and receipts of the previous month to our tax accountant. Once she’s done with her work, this allows us to easily and accurately analyze our monthly spent. You will be thereby be the crucial valve controlling our outgoing and incoming cash flows, ensuring our service provides, partners, and customers stay happy with our Finance team.
* You ensure that all our revenue flows into our bank account by maintaining a flawless invoicing system that always sends out correct invoices. In special cases, you send out manual invoices on the day the revenue is due. It’s always an uphill battle, but you educate (in various ways) all customers to always pay on time — and if they persistently don’t pay, you collect our overdue revenue in other ways, so that we never have to write off an invoice.
* You automate your work to the largest degree possible. Your predecessors in this job always ended their (working student) careers at Luminovo after multiplying our “cash under management”. Similarly, we want you, your tools, and your processes to grow with the money.
* ️ What will help you succeed

We purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role– here is why.  

  

A general rule, however, applies: **The harder it is from your CV to understand your abilities, the stronger your motivational letter needs to be in order for us to see a match between you and us.**  

  

This role requires you to be fluent (C1\\) in German and English.
What we promise
 

* We greatly value psychological safety and honest feedback. We always expect you to speak up and share your ideas about what we can improve within the company, and take these views to heart.
* We do routine 1:1's with your supervisor, retrospectives, and insight hours to make sure we are constantly getting better at what we do, all while fostering employee mental health and wellbeing.
* Professional development is something strongly encouraged by Luminovo, so there are no fixed budgets when it comes to things that will further your professional growth (education, trainings etc.). Make a case for it and we usually say yes!
* We offer a flexible working environment, we appreciate everyone's time and preferred ideal setup in terms of working hours.
* We offer fully remote working (our only requirement for remote working is that you are within \\+/\\-2 hours of CET). Our Luminerds work from Amsterdam, Nairobi, Verona, Berlin, Cologne, Munich, …
* When it comes to our take on parent support, Luminovo happily contributes to the childcare costs of Luminerds.
* We're excited to revolutionize the electronics industry – and we want you to be too. That's why all full\\-time Luminerds receive strong and fair stock option packages. We also support you in finding your perfect (remote) set\\-up.

  

  

About Luminovo


Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that brings together all data, processes, and players in one place. Our software enables cloud\\-based collaboration among electronics designers, manufacturers, distributors, and suppliers in the trillion\\-dollar electronics industry. Read more about why this is exciting here!
  

So far, 200\\+ active customers and 40\\+ product partners globally are working with us towards the same goal. Backed by top\\-tier investors Cherry Ventures and General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.  

We are a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Our current team not only includes graduates from institutions such as Stanford University and University of Cambridge, but also motivated individuals with rather unconventional CVs who are burning for what they do.  

We are a remote\\-first company headquartered in Munich. Our brilliant team is spread across Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, Verona, ...   

**Our core principles: putting people first \\& building great things.**  

*We provide an authentic environment that empowers all Luminerds from various backgrounds to prosper, succeed, and make a difference. We explore curiously who our people are, what they excel at, and what makes them unique. Combined, our individual uniqueness drives our success as a team.*
  
**Department**


Operations


**Employment Type**


Internship


**Location**


Remote (or Munich)


**Workplace type**


Hybrid


**Compensation**


€1,150 \\- €2,600 / month


**Reporting To**


Benedikt Ummen


**This role's hiring manager:**

Benedikt Ummen

title: Internship: Research and Prototyping GPU and Networking Technologies for Future Radio Systems
description:
GPUs (Graphics Processing Units) have become a staple in high\\-performance computing. Their ability to process large amounts of data in parallel makes them a great solution for various computing problems, including in SDR. Together with you, we would like to explore the solutions offered by GPUs for our SDR product line, and figure out how we use them to accelerate wireless applications, such as 6G research, spectrum analysis, and many others!


**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Get familiar with GPU\\-based development workflows and understand the architecture of GPUs
* Understand how to move data in and out of GPUs
* Prototyping GPU\\-accelerated SDR applications to enable higher\\-speed signal processing applications
Connect GPUs with our DMA/RDMA based options.  

* 
**For this Role, You Will Need:**

* Ongoing academic studies in Computer Science, Information System Technology, Electrical Engineering or comparable field of studies (from 4th semester)
* Courage to independently research a complex topic
* Interest in high performance computing and enthusiasm about the latest technologies
* Interest in programming hardware components such as GPUs
* Familiarity with Linux operating systems
* Basic knowledge in C/C\\+\\+ and Python
* Good command of spoken and written English and/or German
* Availability for 4 to 6 months starting in **October 2025**
* This internship must be a **mandatory** part of your studies
**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**

* You have some experience in GPU programming (e.g., with Cuda, Vulkan, GPUDirect...)
* Some background in DSP (e.g., how does an FFT work)
You have created or contributed to software projects, ideally with some hardware integration (e.g. GPU, Network card (NIC), Raspberry Pi, Arduino…)  

* 

  

**Our Culture \\& Commitment to You :**  

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.  

  



We attach great importance to your development, so we want to make sure that you not only find a challenging job with us, but also a workplace that is supportive and rewarding. You'll receive structured onboarding as well as dedicated support from professional mentors.


Practical expertise imparted:


Experience in improving technology day by day


Get insight into how day\\-to\\-day business looks like for an engineer


Work in an international R\\&D team


In addition, you can expect a variety of attractive employee benefits:


Fair compensation


Flexible working hours


Team events and free drinks, fruits, and veggies


We are committed to providing an inclusive, open, and welcoming workplace environment for people, helping all to make the most of their professional potential.  



**Are you interested?**

If so, we look forward to receiving your application via our application portal, including motivation letter, CV, compulsory internship certificate from your university internship or examination office, most recent certificates and grade transcripts.


National Instruments Dresden GmbH


Ms. Nataliia Verbylo


Am Waldschloesschen 2


01099 Dresden


Germany

title: Finance & Operations Working Student/Intern (d/f/m)
description:
### **Description**

  

**Your opportunity**
Luminovo is revolutionizing the electronics supply chain with AI\\-powered solutions that enhance efficiency and collaboration.
  

  

Our Luminerds need money (and a work place), our customers are paying us money, and at the end of the month, there should always be some of it left — all of this will be your area of responsibility as our **Working Student in Finance.**  

  

 **Key highlights**
* You’re responsible for the flow of many EUR millions per year — both in and out of our bank accounts.
* You’re part of a Finance \\& Operations team that is constantly trying to cut redundant steps through automations, AI, and other clever tools. We grow our revenue by \\~100% per year, but try to keep our team as constant as possible. Tool\\- and automation\\-wise, we want to be so far ahead of the curve that, after your time with us, you’ll be able to apply and build on your experiences anywhere else.


**Time frame**
* Start date: May 15, 2025
* Duration: minimum 12 months
* Working hours: 15\\-20h per week
	+ You can also start with a full\\-time internship and transition into a part\\-time working student position later.

   

**Whom you’ll be working with**
* Benedikt, our Head of Operations
* Sarah, our Finance Specialist
* Naima, our internal Legal Counsel and Benedikt's Associate
* Maggie, our Legal \\& Operations Specialist
* And other Luminerds working in Operations and Revenue

  

### **Performance objectives**

  

To be successful in this role, you will:* At the beginning of the month, you provide fully prepared books and receipts of the previous month to our tax accountant. Once she’s done with her work, this allows us to easily and accurately analyze our monthly spent. You will be thereby be the crucial valve controlling our outgoing and incoming cash flows, ensuring our service provides, partners, and customers stay happy with our Finance team.
* You ensure that all our revenue flows into our bank account by maintaining a flawless invoicing system that always sends out correct invoices. In special cases, you send out manual invoices on the day the revenue is due. It’s always an uphill battle, but you educate (in various ways) all customers to always pay on time — and if they persistently don’t pay, you collect our overdue revenue in other ways, so that we never have to write off an invoice.
* You automate your work to the largest degree possible. Your predecessors in this job always ended their (working student) careers at Luminovo after multiplying our “cash under management”. Similarly, we want you, your tools, and your processes to grow with the money.

  

* **️ What will help you succeed**

  

We purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role– here is why.  

  

A general rule, however, applies: **The harder it is from your CV to understand your abilities, the stronger your motivational letter needs to be in order for us to see a match between you and us.**  

  

This role requires you to be fluent (C1\\) in German and English.### **What we promise**

  

* We greatly value psychological safety and honest feedback. We always expect you to speak up and share your ideas about what we can improve within the company, and take these views to heart.
* We do routine 1:1's with your supervisor, retrospectives, and insight hours to make sure we are constantly getting better at what we do, all while fostering employee mental health and wellbeing.
* Professional development is something strongly encouraged by Luminovo, so there are no fixed budgets when it comes to things that will further your professional growth (education, trainings etc.). Make a case for it and we usually say yes!
* We offer a flexible working environment, we appreciate everyone's time and preferred ideal setup in terms of working hours.
* We offer fully remote working (our only requirement for remote working is that you are within \\+/\\-2 hours of CET). Our Luminerds work from Amsterdam, Nairobi, Verona, Berlin, Cologne, Munich, …
* When it comes to our take on parent support, Luminovo happily contributes to the childcare costs of Luminerds.
* We're excited to revolutionize the electronics industry – and we want you to be too. That's why all full\\-time Luminerds receive strong and fair stock option packages. We also support you in finding your perfect (remote) set\\-up.

### **About Luminovo**


Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that brings together all data, processes, and players in one place. Our software enables cloud\\-based collaboration among electronics designers, manufacturers, distributors, and suppliers in the trillion\\-dollar electronics industry. Read more about why this is exciting here!
  

So far, 200\\+ active customers and 40\\+ product partners globally are working with us towards the same goal. Backed by top\\-tier investors Cherry Ventures and General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.  

We are a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Our current team not only includes graduates from institutions such as Stanford University and University of Cambridge, but also motivated individuals with rather unconventional CVs who are burning for what they do.  

We are a remote\\-first company headquartered in Munich. Our brilliant team is spread across Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, Verona, ...  

**Our core principles: putting people first \\& building great things.**  

*We provide an authentic environment that empowers all Luminerds from various backgrounds to prosper, succeed, and make a difference. We explore curiously who our people are, what they excel at, and what makes them unique. Combined, our individual uniqueness drives our success as a team.*  

Check out our socials: LinkedIn, kununu, and Glassdoor.

title: Internship: FPGA Development for RF and SDR
description:
Software\\-defined radios (SDRs) are crucial in wireless prototyping and research due to their flexibility and adaptability. They allow researchers to implement and test new communication protocols and algorithms on top of a platform combining flexibility of software with the parallel processing capabilities of FPGAs. This accelerates development cycles, reduces costs, and enables rapid experimentation with various wireless technologies, making SDRs indispensable for advancing wireless communication.


**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* You will build up knowledge, drive development, and contribute to our open source SDR platform by developing example applications for our RF Network\\-on\\-Chip (RFNoC) development framework:
* **Developing Custom FPGA Modules** : creating and integrating new IP blocks for specific signal processing tasks
* **FPGA Image Building** : generating and testing custom FPGA images tailored to specific applications
* **High\\-Throughput DSP** : applying existing high\\-throughput digital signal processing algorithms
* **Cross\\-Platform Integration** : integrating FPGA functionality into C\\+\\+ and Python programs for versatile application development
**Who You Are:**

You are passionate about technology and data processing and like to learn and work with the latest software defined radio technologies and equipment.


You take time to ask questions and define the problem and make learning a priority.


You prepare content for communication that is impactful and get in touch with mentors with questions to help drive progress and completion of goals and tasks.


**For this Role, You Will Need:**

* Ongoing academic studies in Information System Technology, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or comparable field of studies (from 4th semester)
* Basic knowledge in FPGA development workflows.
* Basic familiarity with Linux operating systems
* Basic knowledge in C/C\\+\\+ or Python
* Courage to independently research an SDR\\-related problem
* Good command of spoken and written English and/or German
* Availability for 6 months starting in **October 2025**
* This internship must be a **mandatory** part of your studies
**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**

* You have some experience in FPGA development using languages like Verilog / SystemVerilog or VHDL
* You have some prior experience with using software\\-defined radios
You have experience working in open\\-source software development projects  

* 
**Our Offer to You:**

We attach great importance to your development, so we want to make sure that you not only find a challenging job with us, but also a workplace that is supportive and rewarding. You'll receive structured onboarding as well as dedicated support from professional mentors.


Practical expertise imparted:


Experience in improving technology day by day


Get insight into how day\\-to\\-day business looks like for an engineer


Work in an international R\\&D team


In addition, you can expect a variety of attractive employee benefits:


Fair compensation


Flexible working hours


Team events and free drinks, fruits, and veggies


We are committed to providing an inclusive, open, and welcoming workplace environment for people, helping all to make the most of their professional potential.  



**Are you interested?**

If so, we look forward to receiving your application via our application portal, including motivation letter, CV, compulsory internship certificate from your university internship or examination office, most recent certificates and grade transcripts.

title: Intern CX Planning (all genders welcome)
description:
### **Join the movement and find new inspiration.**


We have exciting opportunities for you as:

**Intern CX Planning (all genders welcome)**
--------------------------------------------


Work on real projects and tasks within our CX Strategy Solution department of the Kia Europe Headquarters in Frankfurt/Main, Germany


Minimum of 6 months (possible prolongation for up to 12 months).

 **The Requirements:**


For your internship at Kia Europe you need to be **enrolled during the whole internship period in an European Union University**. Furthermore, you need **a valid visa** and an **unrestricted permit to work** in Germany. We recommend completing a six\\-month internship with us, as this gives you sufficient time to learn about Kia Europe and familiarize yourself with your topic.

 **Your mission:**

* Assist in B2B Customer Experience (CX) activities like project management, information coordination, maintaining files, and organizing monthly meetings and calls.
* Aid B2B and EV CX Managers in journey design using Miro, PowerPoint, and Figma.
* Track e\\-LCV and EV trends, providing creative insights for CX strategies.
* Analyze research data, consolidate findings, and report to CX teams.
* Conduct research on fleet/LCV CX, digital trends, and automotive topics.
* Document and design customer journeys and strategic guidelines for KEU.
* Coordinate CX meetings, workshops, and conferences.
* Handle ad\\-hoc admin tasks, competitor research, and innovative initiatives.

 **Your talents:**

 **Education:**

* Bachelor or Master student in the field of in UX Design, Business Management, Economics, or Engineering Studies (Experience in UX/UI design Figma preferred)

**Skills:**

* Proactive, reliable team player with a curiosity\\-driven, action\\-oriented approach.
* Digitally savvy and comfortable with various online tools/platforms.
* Strong interpersonal skills, open to diverse nationalities and cultures.
* Analytical, detail\\-oriented, and data\\-driven.
* Passionate about Automotive, Mobility, Electrification, Digital CX, and Technology.
* Proficient in MS Office, excelling in Excel and PowerPoint.

 **Who are we?**


Kia is a global mobility brand with a vision to create sustainable mobility solutions for consumers, communities, and societies around the world. Founded in 1944, Kia has been building motorcycles, cars and trucks for more than 75 years.


Kia is now spearheading the popularization of electrified and battery electric vehicles, developing a growing range of mobility services while encouraging millions of people to explore the best ways of getting around. Our brand slogan – ‘Movement that inspires’ – reflects our commitment to inspire consumers through our products and services.


Kia Europe is the European sales and manufacturing arm of Kia Corporation. From our headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany, we lead 39 markets across Europe and the Caucasus, employing more than 5,500 persons, including about 3,500 blue collar workers in our state of the art car plant in Zilina, Slovakia.


Our headquarter is home to 37 different nationalities and this diversity is truly inspiring! This means that every day at Kia is an opportunity to learn something new and to grow personally and professionally. The mix of ambitious and dynamic employees from all over the world is the fuel to our success. Do you have what it takes to join our team? We are looking forward to getting to know you!

**You will enjoy working with us if you like these things:**

* A pulsating international environment. Our workforce is composed of people from 37 nations
* Playing an active and important part in the development of Kia in Europe.
* Developing new frameworks and solutions
* Demanding challenges to which you can creatively contribute
* A competitive compensation package; private leasing offer; systematic off and on\\-the\\-job training, free staff restaurant, support as concerns Health Management and more

**If you’re interested to become part of our Kia team, please apply via our online portal. We are looking forward to getting to know you.**

description:
### **Description**

  

**Your role**  

  

We are looking for a full\\-time **Software Engineering Intern** to join one of our product teams and help us build our electronics supply chain platform (check out this blog post for some more context on what we are building).  

  

You will be treated as a regular member of our product team and get to enjoy the full responsibility (and challenge) of shipping features end\\-to\\-end (from the first brainstorming to shipping it to production). Our past interns have gone on to work for large tech companies, start their own startups, or (our favorite ) join us full\\-time.
  

  

Our tech stack is Typescript \\& React on the frontend, Rust (and some Python and Scala) for the backend, Postgres as our main database. Our software runs on Kubernetes and Azure.
  

  

You should be proficient in at least one of these technologies, **preferably in Rust**. The focus of this role will be backend or full\\-stack (with a higher component of backend).  

  

Please note: We only offer working student positions after you have done an internship with us for a minimum of 3 months.### **Performance objectives**

  

* **Deliver user value consistently and reliably** by contributing to the development efforts of one of our cross\\-functional product teams.
* **Accelerate product development through technical growth** by building expertise across our software stack (React, TypeScript, Rust, Postgres, Kubernetes).
* **Improve team efficiency and collaboration** by actively participating in retrospectives, dailies, and other agile ceremonies.
* **Contribute to a strong team culture** by embodying Luminovo’s operating principles in your day\\-to\\-day work and interactions.
* **Continuously raise the bar for engineering excellence** by proposing improvements to tools, processes, and technical approaches based on your learnings.
* **Create meaningful product impact** by developing a deep understanding of our users and the electronics industry, and translating that into product decisions.

  

### **Skills, knowledge and expertise**

  

Just so you know \\- we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles \\- see here.  

  

**Compensation**  

We want to offer compensation that aligns with industry standards. To maintain a transparent and fair approach to compensation, the salary ranges for all positions are determined based on market benchmarks and a comprehensive leveling framework.  

For this role, the monthly salary ranges from **€2,400 to €2,700** depending on the leveling we’ll establish with you throughout the hiring process. *This range might differ in other countries within our \\+/\\- 2h time zone remote work area.*
