At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? Your technical expertise in a vast array of cutting\\-edge big data tools will empower you to develop groundbreaking solutions tailored to meet the unique requirements of each customer.
  

  

But that's not all – your role as a Data Consultant at Kyndryl will transcend traditional boundaries. You will lead captivating workshops and engaging consulting engagements, helping customers forge data\\-driven strategies that reshape their future. Educating our customers about the latest Data Science technologies and frameworks will be second nature to you, enabling them to unlock the full potential of their data resources.
  

  

Armed with an analytical approach, you will unveil strategies, assessments, recommendations, and comprehensive plans to address complex issues while seamlessly aligning both the technical and functional requirements of IT and the business. Your deep consulting skills and business acumen will be harnessed to analyze customer business issues, formulate hypotheses, and test conclusions, ultimately delivering data solutions that defy expectations.
  

  

If you have a passion for turning data into a force for change and thrive in a dynamic, fast\\-paced environment, this is your chance to shine! Join Kyndryl and become part of a remarkable team that turns data into success stories.
  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

As a Data Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross\\-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


* At least 3 years of experience in designing and implementing solutions, services and operating models, preferably on Cloud Computing technologies, with a focus on Data Solutions and Data Platforms
* Concrete experience (hands on) in designing and delivering solutions for large\\-scale data platforms using relevant approaches (Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Cloud Scale Analytics, etc.), which fully meet customer needs

Ability to map business processes, aimed at analyzing and creating data solutions in the Public Cloud Hyperscaler environment


* Identify and design architectural solutions with key elements such as performance, security and reliability
* Deep Knowledge of SAP BTP services and adoption within Customer ERP transformation
* Deep knowledge of Cloud architectures and Data components such as: Data Factory, Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Fabric, Mongo DB, CosmosDB, SQL DWH/Synapse/SQL Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
* Knowledge of platforms and cloud providers such as: Amazon Web Services (EMR, S3, Redshift, Glue, MSK, Lambda), Cloudera Data Platform (Data Hub, Data Flow, SDX, Data Catalog)
* Database knowledge: NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase), Relational (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL), Data Warehousing (Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake)
* Knowledge of Bigdata Frameworks: Apache Hadoop (HDFS, MapReduce, YARN), Kafka, Flink, Hive, Icesberg, Hbase, ecc
* knowledge of programming: Scala, Python, PySpark Java, SQL, nonchè conoscenza di strumenti di versionamento: Git, CodeCommitBachelor's degree or Master’s degree

  

Preferred Skills and Experience:


* Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree
* 5 years of experience (minimum) selling technical services for multi\\-industry customers

  

**Being You**

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

With state\\-of\\-the\\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:

We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.  



  

**The Role**

Are you ready to embark on an exhilarating journey as a Data Consultant? Join Kyndryl and become a driving force behind the transformative power of data! We're seeking an exceptionally talented individual to accelerate the competitive performance of our customers worldwide, establishing us as their unrivaled business and technology consulting partner.
  

  

As a Data Consultant, your impact will be monumental. You will unleash the potential of data technology, collaborating with customers to envision and conceptualize strategic applications. By combining your deep understanding of business and technology, you will become a catalyst for success, delivering invaluable insights and recommendations that propel our customers' organizations forward.
  

  

Prepare to immerse yourself in the world of data strategies and programs, crafting ingenious approaches to collecting, storing, analyzing, and visualizing data from diverse sources. Your technical expertise in a vast array of cutting\\-edge big data tools will empower you to develop groundbreaking solutions tailored to meet the unique requirements of each customer.
  

  

But that's not all – your role as a Data Consultant at Kyndryl will transcend traditional boundaries. You will lead captivating workshops and engaging consulting engagements, helping customers forge data\\-driven strategies that reshape their future. Educating our customers about the latest Data Science technologies and frameworks will be second nature to you, enabling them to unlock the full potential of their data resources.
  

  

Armed with an analytical approach, you will unveil strategies, assessments, recommendations, and comprehensive plans to address complex issues while seamlessly aligning both the technical and functional requirements of IT and the business. Your deep consulting skills and business acumen will be harnessed to analyze customer business issues, formulate hypotheses, and test conclusions, ultimately delivering data solutions that defy expectations.
  

  

If you have a passion for turning data into a force for change and thrive in a dynamic, fast\\-paced environment, this is your chance to shine! Unleash your creativity, embrace innovation, and become a master of efficiency as you create solutions that revolutionize customer business and IT landscapes. Join Kyndryl and become part of a remarkable team that turns data into success stories.
  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

As a Data Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross\\-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.  



  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* At least 3 years of experience in designing and implementing solutions, services and operating models, preferably on Cloud Computing technologies, with a focus on Data Solutions and Data Platforms
* Concrete experience (hands on) in designing and delivering solutions for large\\-scale data platforms using relevant approaches (Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Cloud Scale Analytics, etc.), which fully meet customer needs

Ability to map business processes, aimed at analyzing and creating data solutions in the Public Cloud Hyperscaler environment


* Identify and design architectural solutions with key elements such as performance, security and reliability
* Deep knowledge of Cloud architectures and Data components such as: Data Factory, Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Fabric, Mongo DB, CosmosDB, SQL DWH/Synapse/SQL Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
* Knowledge of platforms and cloud providers such as: Amazon Web Services (EMR, S3, Redshift, Glue, MSK, Lambda), Cloudera Data Platform (Data Hub, Data Flow, SDX, Data Catalog)
* Database knowledge: NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase), Relational (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL), Data Warehousing (Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake)
* Knowledge of Bigdata Frameworks: Apache Hadoop (HDFS, MapReduce, YARN), Kafka, Flink, Hive, Icesberg, Hbase, ecc
* knowledge of programming: Scala, Python, PySpark Java, SQL, nonchè conoscenza di strumenti di versionamento: Git, CodeCommitBachelor's degree or Master’s degree

  

Preferred Skills and Experience:


* Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree
* 5 years of experience (minimum) selling technical services for multi\\-industry customers

  

**Being You**

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

With state\\-of\\-the\\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Join **Ascom**, where we lead the way in Healthcare ICT and mobile workflow solutions worldwide. With our Swiss\\-based headquarters driving advancements across 19 countries for over 160 years, we're committed to revolutionizing the healthcare industry with transformative technology. Our systems are operational in over 12,000 hospitals globally, managing an incredible 800 million alerts annually. At Ascom, our dedication translates into tangible impact, enriching the experiences of everyone entering the healthcare facilities and care\\-homes we partner with.


Join our team as a **Software Engineer** and play a key role in software development, implementation, and customization. You'll collaborate with management and IT teams to define and deliver on technical priorities, ensuring alignment with organizational needs. You’ll also help maintain a dynamic knowledge base of programming solutions to support a highly efficient and productive IT infrastructure.

 **Your Contributions:**

* Coordinate software projects and provide customer support for Ascom UMS products, including Digitstat, Clingo, and Carefusion.
* Implement and manage new customer support processes for software and related technologies.
* Train and support team members, deliver customer training onsite, and contribute to training material and course development.
* Configure and oversee external customer support, continuously improving based on customer needs and technical analysis.
* Manage all technical support calls, including monthly data extraction and analysis to identify recurring issues and areas for improvement.
* Plan, execute, and maintain customer\\-focused implementation activities, ensuring effective coordination across the department.
* Draft technical specifications for customer\\-specific developments.
* Prepare required documentation to ensure compliance with legal regulations, CE marking, contractual obligations, and QMS standards.
* Serve as the main interface with customers and third parties, coordinating all project activities from initiation to final testing.
* Collaborate with Product and Development Coordinators to plan and deliver customer\\-driven enhancements.
* Support the Delivery Coordinator by monitoring product and service deliveries, identifying and addressing any non\\-compliance, customer complaints, or incidents.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

###### **Qualifications \\& Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
* Proven experience in system integration deployments.
* Experience with medical software installation and configuration.
* Fluent in Italian and English.
* Comfortable working in an international environment.

###### **Skills \\& Competencies**

* Confident in customer\\-facing situations.
* Strong experience with software installation, IT troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Programming skills (VBScript or MS C\\# preferred).
* Experience with Windows OS, SQL (MSSQL required), and relational databases.
* Familiar with web technologies (XML, HTML, JavaScript, CSS) and/or Web Applications.
* Knowledge of medical device connectivity and HL7 standard (IHE, FHIR is a plus).

###### **Personal Qualities**

* Organized, analytical, and team\\-oriented.
* Able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Strong communication and problem\\-solving skills.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.

**What We Offer You:**

* A company you can take pride in.
* Inspiring and collaborative colleagues.
* Abundant opportunities for personal and professional growth.
* The chance to work with cutting\\-edge technology in the healthcare industry.
* Flexible remote work

**Join Us and Make an Impact:**


Ascom is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other protected status. We believe that a diverse workforce strengthens our team, drives innovation, and enriches our workplace. Join us in creating an inclusive environment where everyone is valued and has equal opportunities to succeed.


Join our team at Ascom and help us realize our vision of enhancing digital information for optimal decision\\-making in the healthcare industry. Together, we are making a real difference in the lives of those who benefit from our technology.


To learn more about what we do, visit us at: ascom.com

description:
**Site Name:** Italy \\- Liguria, Italy \\- Piemonte  

**Posted Date:** Apr 17 2025  

We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued, and included. We offer a competitive salary, an annual bonus based on company performance, healthcare and wellbeing programmes, pension plan membership, and shares and savings programme.


We embrace modern work practises; our Performance with Choice programme offers a hybrid working model, empowering you to find the optimal balance between remote and in\\-office work.


Discover more about our company wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage *Life at GSK \\| GSK*

***Scope:***


GSK, per il potenziamento della Field Force interna per la **Divisione Oncologia,** è alla ricerca di uno/a **Specialist Oncology** che si occupi di informazione medica in ambito specialistico per il trattamento del carcinoma ovarico e del carcinoma endometriale sul territorio di riferimento assegnato.


La posizione verrà inserita all’interno del Servizio Scientifico aziendale che, nel rispetto delle normative di legge ed aziendali vigenti, prevede l’attività di informazione medica presso gli Operatori Sanitari e Farmacisti Ospedalieri, illustrando loro le caratteristiche farmacologiche e terapeutiche dei farmaci al fine di assicurarne il corretto ed appropriato impiego.


Area di competenza: **Liguria e prov. di Asti, Alessandria e Cuneo**


Gli Specialisti Oncology sono responsabili di riferire alla Direzione Commerciale e Medica le osservazioni che emergono dal colloquio con operatori sanitari e farmacisti ospedalieri in particolare di riportare tempestivamente tutte le informazioni sulle sospette reazioni avverse dei farmaci al Responsabile della Farmacovigilanza.


Il/la candidato/a selezionato/a lavorerà nell'ambito della BU Oncologia e collaborerà con:

* Operatori sanitari e farmacisti ospedalieri appartenenti al settore di **Onco\\-ginecologia**
* Direzione Medica
* Regional Payers and Evidence Solutions
* KAM e RAM
* Direzione Marketing
* Direzione Commerciale
* Dipartimento di Servizio Scientifico
* Dipartimento di Farmacovigilanza.

***In this role You will...***

* Promuovere e spiegare il valore dei prodotti GSK a tutti gli interlocutori di riferimento, comunicando loro i messaggi chiave dal punto di vista scientifico
* Garantire una comunicazione efficace e coerente con i bisogni degli operatori sanitari e farmacisti ospedalieri, pianificando e organizzando l’attività di informazione scientifica in coerenza con il piano definito a livello di BU Oncologia
* Proporre al proprio Line Manager iniziative di formazione/aggiornamento scientifico per gli operatori sanitari e farmacisti ospedalieri come integrazione ai colloquio individuali in ottemperanza alla normativa vigente e al modello commerciale di GSK
* Proporre e diffondere l’uso dei nuovi media (es. web conference sistemi digital, come richiesto dal nuovo modello HCP engagement) per l’informazione scientifica e diffonderne l’uso anche per la formazione scientifica collettiva, interfacciandosi con la Medica regionale
* Contribuire all’implementazione del Key Account Action Plan per il territorio in modo collaborativo secondo la strategia nazionale
* Assicurarsi che tutte le attività e i piani siano eseguiti in linea con gli elevati standard di etica e conformità di GSK e con tutti i requisiti e i regolamenti legali applicabili.

***Why you?***

**Basic Qualifications \\& Skills:**

**We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:**

* Laurea in Medicina e Chirurgia, Scienze Biologiche, Chimica con indirizzo organico o biologico, Farmacia, ecc. (vedi Decreto\\-legge 219/2006 e successivi aggiornamenti).
* Esperienza nel ruolo in ambito oncologico.
* Residenza nelle zone di competenza (**Liguria**).

**Preferred Qualifications \\& Skills:**

**Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply:**


Le seguenti caratteristiche saranno considerate un plus:

* Esperienza in marketing.

***What we offer:***

* Permanent contract in a very Inclusive environment
* Performance Reward
* Company Car
* Flexible Benefits
* Company Healthcare Plan
* Integrative pension fund
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Tax assistance

***Closing Date for Applications – 11 maggio 2025***


Please take a copy of the Job Description, as this will not be available post closure of the advert.  

When applying for this role, please use the ‘cover letter’ of the online application or your CV to describe how you meet the competencies for this role, as outlined in the job requirements above. The information that you have provided in your cover letter and CV will be used to assess your application.

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together – so we can positively impact the health of billions of people and deliver stronger, more sustainable shareholder returns – as an organisation where people can thrive. We prevent and treat disease with vaccines, specialty and general medicines. We focus on the science of the immune system and the use of new platform and data technologies, investing in four core therapeutic areas (infectious diseases, HIV, respiratory/ immunology and oncology).


Our success absolutely depends on our people. While getting ahead of disease together is about our ambition for patients and shareholders, it’s also about making GSK a place where people can thrive. We want GSK to be a place where people feel inspired, encouraged and challenged to be the best they can be. A place where they can be themselves – feeling welcome, valued, and included. Where they can keep growing and look after their wellbeing. So, if you share our ambition, join us at this exciting moment in our journey to get Ahead Together.


If you require an accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at GSK, please contact the GSK Service Centre at 1\\-877\\-694\\-7547 (US Toll Free) or \\+1 801 567 5155 (outside US).


GSK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), military service or any basis prohibited under federal, state or local law.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**


GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.


Please note that if you are a US Licensed Healthcare Professional or Healthcare Professional as defined by the laws of the state issuing your license, GSK may be required to capture and report expenses GSK incurs, on your behalf, in the event you are afforded an interview for employment. This capture of applicable transfers of value is necessary to ensure GSK’s compliance to all federal and state US Transparency requirements. For more information, please visit the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) website at https://openpaymentsdata.cms.gov/

title: Process Engineer
description:
**PROCESS ENGINEER**

 **About Us:**



Anaergia (TSX: ANRG) is a global leader in offering sustainable solutions for the production of clean energy and the conversion of waste streams to resources. Through a proven portfolio of proprietary technological solutions, Anaergia maximizes the generation of renewable energy, diversion of waste from landfill and reduction of greenhouse gases for customers across the municipal, industrial, commercial and agricultural sectors. Headquartered in Burlington, ON, and through its multiple subsidiaries across North America, Europe, Africa, and Asia, Anaergia is trusted at more than 1,600 installations globally.

 **Mission**



Guarantee the design optimization and the process performances during each phase of the “production”, ensuring the excellence of “Anaergia products”, while maintaining competitiveness and profitability.

 **Goals**



The Process Engineers analyse the input data and the required output, evaluating consistency and completeness, verifying the feasibility and sustainability of the plant.  

They define the appropriate process, specifying fluxes and required capacity, sizing every subsection of the treatment chain and applying the company standards.  

They develop and update the engineering documents under their responsibility as per the provision Document List.  

Actively participate to the development of the company know\\-how, contributing to the implementation of database, including the specification of the required test and analysis, and to the upgrade of the required sizing and calculation tools.  

The PROs provide their expertise in the 4 main phases of the production chain:  

a) Commercial phase: providing process expertise to the Application Engineers  

b) Engineering phase: developing the engineering documents under their responsibility as a member of the Project Team  

c) Commissioning \\& start\\-up phase: providing technical support to the Site Managers  

d) Biological Service in operation: providing support to the Customers, either directly or in cooperation with the Service Team.  

The targets of the Process Engineers can be summarized as follow:  

* Ensure a process design that enable to sell, design and build competitive and performing plants
* Contribute in the selection and integration of reliable and competitive technologies and systems
* Achieve the Customer Satisfaction target
 **Responsibilities and Authority**


* Elaborate the technical specification of the feedstocks according to the required performances and specify the evaluation/analysis criteria
* Define and/or verify/validate the required sub\\-sections of the treatment chain, specifying the performance requirements of each section
* Produce and manage all the process documents as provided by the Document List
* Prepare the start\\-up plan and provide dedicated support during the plant hot\\-commissioning, ramp\\-up and start\\-up
* Provide instruction and training to the concerned parties (owner, plant manager, operators) within his area of expertise
* Specify and plan the required feedstocks and streams analysis campaign during commissioning and operation
* Contribute to the development of the Control Narrative, ensuring the proper implementation on management and control system with special focus on the control strategy (analysis, measures, specific executions).
* Monitor the performances of the plant

 **Job Requirements**



At least 5 years experience in the similar position

 **Educational competencies**


* Chemical Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Chemistry Science
* Biology Science
* Biotechnology

 **Technical / Specialist competencies**


* Proficiency in the use of the main process calculation tools
* Knowledge of the main available technologies and processes and competence in selecting and applying them
* Proficiency in the development of technical and graphic documents by using the best available IT tools
* Ability to plan chemical and biological analysis
* Anticipate and recognize potential process risks that may affect the good performance of the plant
* Excellent knowledge of the Italian language;
* Excellent knowledge of English, read, written and spoken.

 **The following side competencies would also be good to have:**


* Specific competence on the following application


 Anaerobic Digestion  

 Waste treatment  

 Waste Water Treatment  

* Knowledge of other languages

description:
**Description**


**The opportunity**

  

We are looking for a LCA Specialist for the Transformers Business to join our Sustainability team within one of our Technology Centers. You will be at the heart of realizing Hitachi Energy’s purpose of advancing a more sustainable energy future for all by strengthening our capabilities on managing the sustainability impact of our offerings today and support in defining our sustainability value proposition for mid\\- to long\\-term. In this role you will be part of a global, cross\\-functional community of dynamic and engaged professionals with a broad range of experiences and backgrounds.

**How you’ll make an impact**

* Manage and further develop internal Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) and Lifecycle environmental Impact Assessment (LCA) methodologies and tools for transformers and their components.
* Create LCA models and analysis reports of new materials, processes, and technologies in support of product innovations
* Assess sustainability data from the supply chain in LCA models.
* Perform full\\-scale LCA and product carbon footprint studies for external, third\\-party verifications as required and support corporate ESG reporting and commitments.
* Support product teams on executing the sustainability impact transparency roadmap and provide guidance for the design and development of the future sustainability value proposition in the portfolio.
* Support integrating sustainability and eco\\-design principles and tools into R\\&D and innovation processes.
* Update and deliver internal presentations and trainings to different functions, and provide expert support to global project teams in R\\&D, business strategy, supply chain, and others.
* Actively participate in transformers\\-related external sustainability standardization committees and industrial initiatives.

**Your background**

* Proven experience as environmental impact analysis expert in a consulting, industry and/or academic context.
* Strong knowledge of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) methodologies and tools including experience in performing full\\-scale studies with LCA software tools, particularly SimaPro and GaBi.
* University degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, business, or a related field.
* Strong general quantitative and qualitative analytical and problem\\-solving skills.
* A thorough understanding of sustainability topics and standards in the engineering and manufacturing industry of capital goods and services.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate complex information in clear, understandable ways to internal and external audiences.
* Ability to work closely with large and complex remote teams and in a multi\\-country \\& \\-cultural environment.
* Excellent project management skills with demonstrated capacity to take initiative, structure and prioritize work.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, fluent in English.

**What we offer**

* Collective agreement
* Flexible working time
* Health care and wellness allowance
* Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
* Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
* Various trainings and education supporting employee development
* Diversified company with over 70\\+ nationalities working in Sweden
* Supplementary compensation for parental leave
* Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

**More about us**

title: Sustainability Project Manager
description:
**Description**


**The opportunity**

  

We are seeking a Sustainability Project Manager to coordinate sustainability initiatives within the Transformers Business Unit of Hitachi Energy. This role will drive the execution of sustainability projects, ensure compliance with environmental regulations and standards, and support life cycle assessments (LCA), carbon footprint reduction, and circular economy strategies. The candidate will work cross\\-functionally with R\\&D, supply chain, operations, and regulatory teams to integrate sustainability into product development and manufacturing processes.

**How you’ll make an impact**

* Manage sustainability R\\&D projects from initiation to completion, ensuring alignment with corporate environmental goals and industry best practices.
* Support the development of carbon footprint reduction strategies, material efficiency improvements, and energy\\-saving initiatives.
* Support comparative assessments of products and processes to identify sustainability improvements.
* Ensure adherence to global and regional environmental regulations
* Oversee the collection and management of sustainability\\-related data, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
* Support Life Cycle Assessments (LCA), Environmental Product Declarations (EPD), and carbon footprint analysis by collaborating with specialists.
* Develop R\\&D sustainability technical reports, presentations, and performance dashboards for internal and external stakeholders
* Work cross\\-functionally with engineering, supply chain, operations, and corporate sustainability teams to drive sustainability integration.

title: Junior Brand Activation Manager
description:
Description  

Kenvue is currently recruiting for:


**Junior Brand Activation Manager – Personal Care brands**


**The aim of the brand activation team is to ensure market\\-leading excellence in execution towards shopper, customer and final consumer on a given portfolio of Personal Care brands.**

  

This position reports into Senior Brand Activazione Manager and is based at Pomezia – Santa Palomba (Rome).

  

**Who We Are**



At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands \\- including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND\\-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent. Our global team is made up with 22,000 diverse and brilliant people, passionate about insights, innovation and committed to deliver the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means to have the power to impact life of millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours.

  


**What You Will Do**


The **Junior Brand Activation Manager Personal Car** is responsible for:



Develop and implement Local Brand Activation Plans

  

* Accountable for developing \\& deploying annual Brand Activation Plans per brand for the Italian market (Strategy, Channel Strategy, Big initiatives, Priorities, Pricing, NPIs, Distribution Targets, Activation Plans, BMEs allocation per brand, NTS target per brand, Market trends, Sell out estimate, Market Share estimation, Building Blocks)


* Responsible \\& Accountable to ensure Perfect in store activation (Must Stock List for Key Initiatives, Priority List, Manage/Develop \\& Monitor In\\-store POP materials/Theme Events \\- National \\& Tailor Made per Category \\& Brand, planograms creation \\& updates, Category management planning, execution of initiatives etc.


* Own local Brand Activity Overview and secure synchronization of consumer and shopper/trade activities; Build robust selling story to boost sales in Mass channel.


* Be informed about Media strategy and have consulting role in media process (Media plan and communication brief, Media Plan \\& Flow charts, Local Connection Planning: provide input on local requirements).


* Responsible and accountable to prepare \\& deliver presentations and promotional plans to Sales teams, Customers / Distributors.


* Accountable for E\\-Commerce strategy implementation (in close collaboration with E\\-Commerce team) and preparing materials/assets, driving synergies between on\\-line and off\\-line activation.


* Close collaboration with Professional Marketing to support HCP detailing, following Professional Marketing \\& Brand strategy.

  


The local BTL budget (BME)

  

* Input to budget process and target setting, tracking and any recommendations for investment shifts.

  



Monitor the Market / Insights

  

* Be responsible and accountable for monitoring the tracking of competition and key agreed performance KPIs.


* Responsible for in\\-depth Market Share Tracking and relevant actions with the Sales Team and Hub Brand Teams respectively.


* Provide Hub Marketing with competitive information (insights, trends, new competitors’ entry/NPIs, etc).


* Continuous market screening \\& reporting to hub and local internal


* Align with hub on eventual local actions or need of support.


* Provide input on primary research


* Initiate shopper related research and action plan.


* Be close to the market \\- ensure regular market / store visits to understand the environment \\& emerging trends

  



Ensure high quality of local adaptation for customer \\& shopper marketing materials

  

* Be responsible and accountable for the Adaptation or creation for local brands all needed materials
* Responsible for Public Relations related to Press Releases (Review, change and/or validate the texts), Product Sending, PR Events (Local PR agency to share \\& review plan of PR event plan \\& all logistics with BA. BA KDM).


* Have consulting role in artwork (Mastertext and the Final Artwork validation, changes if needed)


* Provide local feedback for all Digital assets (web sites and E\\-commerce). Communicate changes to Cluster marketing.


* Provide feedback \\& share local requirements to Transcreation briefs be responsible for the approval of local translations and local specifications for all assets.

  



Act as local presentative \\& work in close collaboration with Cluster Marketing \\& Business Development Managers:

  

* Actively join \\& represent local point of view in the Cluster Squad sessions and drive business results.


* Share best practice cases and seek opportunity to deploy activation ideas from other markets.


* Input on local issues and requirements to brand strategy \\& brand plans.

  



Other Features of The Job  

  

Be key counterpart to local regulatory \\& supply chain team

  

* Provide feedback to cluster mkt on NPI/NPD (CIS form completion, NTS, MS, GtN, WD, Price, BMEs, GP, cannibalization, presentation to Sales team, …).


* Responsible and accountable for rolling Forecast and being aligned with Supply Chain for NPIs, OOS, Discontinuations, POP stock, procedures, promotions, slobs.


* Local portfolio management (agreed SKU\\-rationalization, phase\\-in and out)

  



 Develop talent \\& drive Energy:

  

* Develop direct reports in terms of functional \\& leadership skills


* Support talent acquisition \\& others development


* Engage in transparent and constructive conversations, actively contributing to high\\-performance team performance

Qualifications **What We Are Looking For**


Required Qualifications
* University/Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent


* At least 1\\-2 years working related experience in the Mass business with proven track record of driving growth of FMCG brands


* Proficiency in English


* Computer Skills: professional knowledge of Excel and Powerpoint

  



Core competencies

  

* Excellent analytical skills


* Agile Mindset and attitude


* Outstanding leadership skills, with the ability to lead by example and influence key stakeholders


* Proven project management skills, ability to collaborate with multiple partners, prioritise high impact activities, and keep sophisticated projects moving forward.


* Excellent communication skills with the ability to build positive relationships with partners both internally and externally


* Business and financial acumen (with ability to manage and read P\\&L)


* Be knowledgeable on syndicated data use and interpretation (for example, Nielsen)

  


**What’s In It For You**


* Competitive Benefit Package


* Learning \\& Development Opportunities


* Employee Resource Groups


* Fixed term contract

Kenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

  


Primary Location Europe/Middle East/Africa\\-Italy\\-Lazio\\-Pomezia (Santa Palomba)

**Perché BIP?**

**Quale sarà la tua sfida?**

La persona selezionata sarà inserita nell'area Amministrazione e Finanza e, a riporto del Responsabile Amministrativo, si occuperà della gestione della contabilità, del controllo delle scadenze e dell'espletamento di adempimenti amministrativi vari.


**Ruolo e Responsabilità** :


* Registrazione fatture attive e passive (anche estere)
* Supporto attività ordinarie in amministrazione e contabilità
* Gestione reportistica fornitori
Creazione report su più sistemi gestionali  
* 

**Sarai tu ad entrare nel nostro Team?**

* Iscrizione alle liste Categorie Protette Art.1 LG 68/99
* Diploma, o Laurea in ambiti affini alla mansione (Ragioneria, Economia, Finanza...)
* Esperienza anche breve nella mansione
* Conoscenza dei principi base di contabilità e gestione amministrativa
* Buona conoscenza pacchetto office, excel in particolare
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese  
* 

**Soft skills**

* Precisione puntualità, attenzione ai dettagli
* Ottima attitudine al lavoro in Team
* Serietà e professionalità, rispetto delle scadenze

***People at the center of our culture***

Fiducia e collaborazione, imprenditorialità e coraggio, meritocrazia e sviluppo guidano la crescita delle nostre persone.

Potrai partecipare a \\+ di 300 corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze su tecnologie e temi di business emergenti.

Troverai una policy che supporta il lavoro AGILE fino al 100% del proprio tempo e favorisce il work\\-life integration.

Grazie a questo percorso siamo oggi oltre 5\\.000 professionisti e professioniste, presenti in 13 Paesi, con oltre 5\\.000 progetti alle spalle e le conoscenze più all’avanguardia nell'ambito della Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4\\.0, IOT e di tutte le Disruptive Technologies che mettiamo a servizio di ogni settore di mercato.

**Data Protection Junior Specialist – L. 68/99 Categoria Protetta (Corporate Internal Function)**

**Quale sarà la tua sfida?**

Per una società del gruppo BIP ricerchiamo un/una Data Protection Junior Specialist L.68/99\\. Collaborerà e supportera il Data Protection Officer di BIP, con particolare attenzione nelle seguenti attività:


* Supporto operativo alle attività connesse alla normativa Data Protection (es. tenuta del Registro dei Trattamenti; esecuzione di DPIA; gestione di incident e/o Data Breach; gestione delle richieste degli Interessati), anche per le società del Gruppo;
* Revisione della documentazione contrattuale con clienti e fornitori (DPA \\- Data Processing Agreement e clausole contrattuali privacy);
* Coadiuvare e supportare le altre aree di business nella verifica e controllo del rispetto della normativa Data Protection nei processi interni ed esterni all’azienda, con identificazione e valutazione dei correlati rischi di non conformità;
* Predisposizione, tenuta ed aggiornamento di policy e procedure interne;
* Supporto al DPO nell’esecuzione di attività di audit, con identificazione delle azioni correttive in caso di riscontro di anomalie ed effettuazione dei relativi follow\\-up;
* Supporto alla predisposizione ed erogazione di corsi di formazione in ambito Data Protection;
Supporto nella predisposizione della reportistica indirizzata al Top Management.  
* 

**Sarai tu a far parte del nostro team?**

* Laurea Magistrale in discipline giuridiche, economiche, ingegneristiche;
* Conoscenza della normativa Data Protection (Regolamento Europeo per il trattamento dei dati personali; Codice Privacy; D.lgs. n. 101/2018; Provvedimenti dell’Autorità Garante; Linee Guida dell’EDPB; comparazione con le normative Data Protection estere);
* Gradita esperienza di almeno 2 anni maturata in ruolo analogo;

* Saranno considerati requisiti preferenziali la conoscenza delle nuove tecnologie informatiche, la partecipazione attiva ad attività di controllo e il conseguimento di percorsi formativi in ambito Data Protection e/o Cybersecurity.

**Soft Skills:** 

* Ottime doti relazionali e comunicative
* Autonomia e proattività
* Ottima capacità di organizzazione

Sede di lavoro: Roma  



**Perché BIP?**

***People at the center of our culture***

Fiducia e collaborazione, imprenditorialità e coraggio, meritocrazia e sviluppo guidano la crescita delle nostre persone.


Lavorare in BIP è un'esperienza sfidante, in cui il merito paga e l'innovazione avviene attraverso idee coraggiose, collaborazione e un rapporto di fiducia con i nostri clienti.


***Challenging yourself***  

Avrai la possibilità di metterti alla prova in contesti progettuali diversi in termini di ambito, natura delle attività e stakeholders coinvolti. Vedrai valorizzato il tuo spirito di iniziativa, la tua passione, l’autonomia e la capacità di assumerti responsabilità e metterti in gioco.


***Unlocking your potential***  

Potrai partecipare a \\+ di 300 corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze su tecnologie e temi di business emergenti.


***Work\\-life Integration***  

Troverai una policy che supporta il lavoro AGILE fino al 100% del proprio tempo e favorisce il work\\-life integration.


***Diversity, Equity and Inclusion***

Valorizziamo l’unicità e ci impegniamo a garantire che tutte le nostre persone abbiano pari opportunità di dare un contributo ed esprimere al massimo il potenziale nell'ambiente di lavoro.


Il nostro approccio alla diversità e all’inclusione si fonda sui principi di etica e integrità e rappresenta il fattore determinante per lo sviluppo di orizzonti, di crescita personale e aziendale, più ampi.


Promuoviamo l’inserimento e l’integrazione lavorativa delle persone appartenenti alle categorie protette – in base a quanto disciplinato dalla legge 68/99  



  

***Next Steps***

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente.


Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca.


L’iter di selezione comprende generalmente un colloquio con HR, un colloquio tecnico con un line manager ed un eventuale colloquio con un Partner.


L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting.


In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future.


Se dovessi identificare ulteriori posizioni di tuo interesse ed in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente.

title: Business Analyst Intern
description:
We're on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you're ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth.
   

  

 How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon you'll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.
   

  

 The Amazon EU Student Programs Team is looking for ambitious students to join us at the heart of our core consumer business. As a Business Analyst Intern you will join one of our business intelligence, retail or seller services teams. The role provides an opportunity to understand Amazon business and processes, enhance analytical skills, and make significant business impact.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Working with operational, finance, retail and technical teams across the organization to identify opportunities, develop sound business cases and drive measurements of actions to continuously improve on the inputs and ultimately the outputs of the business.
* Working with large volumes and big data, in a highly complex business.
* Working with business intelligence tools, accessing and working with big data from multiple sources, and partnering with the business to identify strategic opportunities and deliver results.


 A day in the life
   

  

**Your Paid 6\\-month Internship Includes**
* Mentorship: we care about your career aspirations and strive to assign projects based on your interests. You can learn and be curious with access to unlimited virtual trainings on project management, personal brand, communication skills and many more.
* Get involved: we have with over 13 Amazon Affinity Groups you can join and become an ally to a cause close to your heart (sustainability, diversity, LGBTQ\\+, mental and/or physical disabilities, local community initiatives, etc.)
* Taking ownership of your career: because when you succeed, we all win. A successful internship, could lead to a full\\-time (graduate role) after finishing your university studies.


**About The Team**
 At Amazon Retail, we help improve the selection and shopping experience and offer customers around the world exciting products and deals. As a Business Analyst Intern, you will be part of one of our product categories which go from books to fashion, electronics to grocery, movies and music to toys and health \\& beauty, and everything in between.
   

  

 From a garage\\-based start\\-up in 1995 to a top global brand today, Amazon has evolved and made its way into our lives. Amazon Retail is at the heart of that journey. Join us and become part of it
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Available to commence an internship between January and December 2025\\. Yes, our start dates are flexible! You should then be available for 6 months, full time (40h/week).
* Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree, with an anticipated graduation date after the completion of your internship.
* Experience with SQL, ETL or Python.
* Fluent written and verbal communication in English (Level \\- C1 or higher).
* Fluent written and verbal communication in Italian (Level \\- B2 or higher).
* You will be based in Milan for the duration of the internship. A relocation package may be offered, subject to an eligibility criterion.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Studies within Business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Mathematics or similar fields.
* Experience using databases with a large\\-scale data set.
* Advanced Excel.


 Every day will be filled with developing new skills and achieving personal growth. Interested?
   

  

 Submitting your application takes less than 10 minutes and cover letters are not required. You will just need to attach your CV and answer a questionnaire.
   

  

 Selected candidates will be invited to an online assessment. If successful, you'll attend to two rounds of virtual interviews, which take place on the same day. Interviews consist of behavioural questions and a case study, focusing on our Leadership Principles. The entire recruitment process typically takes 3 to 4 weeks. Do note that the selection process and timelines are subject to change, and vary with role and location.
   

  

 EMEA Student Programs Teams
   

  

 Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: Market Analyst Internship
description:
De Nora is an Italian multinational company, listed on the Euronext Milan stock exchange, a global provider of innovative technologies and solutions, and is recognized as a partner of choice for significant industrial electrochemical processes. Since its foundation in 1923, De Nora has been driven by the philosophy of continual improvement. Today, it is the world’s largest supplier of high\\-performing catalytic coatings and insoluble electrodes for electrochemical and industrial applications. It is also a leading supplier of equipment, systems, and processes for water disinfection and filtration. De Nora is committed to developing unconventional solutions to achieve the energy transition to decarbonization, the green hydrogen economy, and clean water for everyone.
   

  

 Watch the video to discover more: https://youtu.be/vmkv0tuQvKc
   

  

 We are seeking a Market Analyst to join our Energy Transition and Hydrogen team.
   

  

 This opportunity will allow you to work with the team to identify market opportunities and make strategic decisions to drive business growth in the energy transition and hydrogen markets.
   

  

**You Will Support Your Responsible In The Following Activities**
* the Identification and detail potential market opportunities and technology benchmarking.
* Continuously monitor the energy and hydrogen markets, including value chain, geographies, economics, policies, strategies, regulations, and incentives.
* Participate actively in hydrogen trading groups and governmental interactions.
* Develop scenarios, draw conclusions, and provide recommendations that support business strategy for energy transition and hydrogen.
* Expand scope to adjacent markets such as Energy Storage and Circularity.
* Support Investor Relators and AFC CO with comprehensive H2 \\& ET market analysis.
* Apply advanced statistics and data analysis methodologies.
* Collaborate with multiple stakeholders, including consultancies and partners.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Degree in STEM or Economics.
* Strong analytical thinking and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail.


**What We Offer**
* hands\\-on experience of internship with guidance from industry experts
* Duration 6 months with the possibility of hiring at the end of the internship
* Networking Opportunities: Connect with professionals and thought leaders in the energy and hydrogen markets
* Location: Milan
* 1000\\-1200 € per month \\+ Company canteen
* Smart working 2 days per week


 Join us and be a part of a team that is not just anticipating the future of energy but actively creating it. If you are passionate about driving change and looking for a role that challenges you to excel, apply now and let’s shape the future together!
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride of our diverse and inclusive environment. We aim to attract and recruit individuals with diverse backgrounds, skills, and abilities, who will enhance the quality of our products and services and contribute to the Group’s success. We are committed to prioritize talent, make people feel respected, appreciated, and free to fully express their potential.

title: Internship - Data Science
description:
**At ION**
 We want to innovate the financial services offered by commercial/retail banks in Italy in the areas of wealth management, credit lending, risk management and compliance. Building on our consolidated expertise and product offering in the Capital Markets domain, we want to scale our solutions and frameworks to the commercial/retail banking industry. To do so, we start from the quantitative modelling and analysis of the current processes put in place by our customers, so that we can profile opportunities of automation and prioritize client needs on manual/painful workflows. The resource will be involved in business process analyses of Italian commercial/retail financial institutions and is expected to integrate structured information extracted from interviews with the analysis of literature and documentation to build a quantitative picture of the AS\\-IS. The analysis will then be complemented with a consequent implementation analysis and product roadmap definition to design the TO\\-BE and drive product evolutions and developments. The project entails modelling complex business contexts, extracting structured information from unstructured sources, performing quantitative analyses, presenting findings and recommendations to external clients and internal stakeholders, contributing to the definition of product backlogs.
   

  

**What You Will Learn During Your Intern**
* Quantitative modelling of business processes
* Codification of customer requirements, needs, activities
* Business intelligence with PowerBI/Excel \\- Packaging high\\-quality deliverables for external clients –
* Data manipulation with Pandas or Spark/Hive


**What You Need To Know**
* Hands\\-on experience with BI tools (Excel, PowerBI)
* Experience with Python data science libraries (pandas, pyspark, sklearn) is nice to have
* Fluent English


**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* is passionate about modelling unknown business contexts with a quantitative approach
* can find a good trade\\-off between quality and speed of delivery
* proactively contribute your insights and ideas in a way that fits existing frameworks of the firm
* is fond of sharing knowledge with colleagues and documenting your work

title: Digital and Business Technology Internal Audit Professional
description:
Mar 27, 2025
   

  

 Digital and Business Technology Internal Audit Professional
   

  

**About Barilla**
 At Barilla, we believe that every great journey begins with passion and a bold vision. From our humble beginnings in 1877 in a small shop in Parma, Italy, we’ve blossomed into a global leader in the food industry, guided by our commitment to progress and excellence.
   

  

 Today, Barilla is an international group present in more than 100 countries and we are proud to be recognized as the world’s top food company by reputation. With 20 beloved brands in our portfolio, we are world leader for pasta, the number one choice for ready\\-made sauces in Europe, leader for bakery products in Italy, and for crispbread across Scandinavia with Wasa.
   

  

 Our success story is written by a passionate team of 9,000 dedicated employees across 30 plants and offices worldwide, all united by a shared mission to nourish the future with purpose and passion.
   

  

**Are you ready to add your unique flavor to our journey?**
**Job Description**
 Barilla G. e R. Fratelli is looking for a Digital and Business Technology Audit Analyst, within the Internal Audit Group, based in Parma.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The Digital and Business Technology Internal Audit Analyst, under the supervision of the audit management, executes audit projects in the areas of IT (IT general controls review, Data and Information Security \\- ISO 27001, IT governance, IT service management and projects).
   

  

 The activities include the planning of audit engagements activities, the execution of tests and analyses, and the reporting of the audit results by drafting audit observations and recommendations to ensure the adequacy of the company’s internal control system. This role actively participates in discussions related to the audit findings with Management members at all levels.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

 Support the Group Internal Audit in the execution of the IT audit projects in the following activities:
   

  

* Collect and analyze relevant documents and information
* Map the audited processes interviewing management
* Identify potential issues, execute tests, analyze data using specific audit software (i.e. ACL, Power BI)
* Draft and discuss relevant audit observations and recommendations with auditees and Internal Audit Senior Management
* Monitor the implementation of the recommendations agreed upon with management, also performing assigned activities in the execution of follow\\-up audits
* Development of data analytics tools and analyses, by identifying with the audit team new data analytics services to support GIA activities.


**Requirements**
* 2 years of experience in audit is considered a plus
* Degree in Economics, Management Engineering or Computer Science
* Fluent in Italian and English, both spoken and written
* Advanced knowledge of Excel
* Knowledge of information security frameworks (i.e. ISO 27001\\), SAP and PowerBI is a plus
* CIA, CISA or other Information System related certifications are considered a plus
* Attention to detail
* Analytical mindset
* Good interpersonal skills
* Good communication skills to interact with internal B.U and external auditors
* Good Teamworking
* Availability to travel


 At Barilla, we are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where diversity in all its forms is valued and embraced. Our employment policies and practices are designed to ensure equal employment opportunities for all, regardless of age, race, color, citizenship, faith, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or characteristics of expression, sexual orientation, marital status, genetic information, medical condition, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our commitment to equal employment stems from our unwavering belief that it is not only the right thing to do, but it is also a fundamental driver of innovation and business success.

 Parma
   

  

 Permanent

title: Digital Operations Internship
description:

 is a multinational pharmaceutical and chemical company focused on innovation and development to improve people’s health and patients’ lives. Based on a valuable heritage but strongly focused on the future, its Vision is “Innovating cure and care to make patients’ lives better”. Zambon operates in the pharmaceutical and chemical business and is present in 20 countries with subsidiaries in three different Continents – Europe, America, and Asia – and over 2900 employees, with manufacturing units in Italy, Switzerland, France, China, and Brazil. Zambon products are commercialized in 84 countries. The company is working on treating specialties and rare diseases, such as Parkinson’s disease and Cystic Fibrosis, and is well\\-established in 3 therapeutic areas: respiratory, pain, and women’s care.
 



  





**The Role:**




  





 We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\\-oriented "
 **Digital Operations Intern** 
 " to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will gain invaluable hands\\-on experience supporting the management of our company's websites (including our main website, product\\-specific sites, and intranet). You will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth and effective functioning of these platforms.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities of the role:**




  




* **Liaison Role:** 
 Serve as a support to the digital omnichannel team to manage the
 **company websites ecosystem** 
 , acting as a bridge between internal marketing/content teams, external media agencies, communication and technology partners.
* **Technical Collaboration:** 
 Collaborate with technology partners and ICT on websites
 **technical enhancements and small implementation projects** 
 . Conduct basic website testing and quality assurance checks.
* **System Monitoring:** 
 Proactively monitor websites and digital customer\\-facing systems (excluding social media) to detect and report problems/defects, ensuring timely resolution. Manage defects by detailing steps to recreate issues and setting appropriate priorities and severities.
* **Data Analysis:** 
 Utilize web analytics data from various sources to evaluate the effectiveness of traffic\\-building initiatives. Provide recommendations for improvements in content marketing, user experience, and conversion.
* **Reporting:** 
 Collect and present data and recommendations in an easy\\-to\\-understand manner.
* **Governance Support:** 
 Support the enforcement of digital corporate standards, governance, and business practices.
* **Technical Support and Training:** 
 Provide technical support, training, and knowledge sharing across internal and external stakeholders.



  





**What we are looking for:**




  





 Academic background: Degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Digital Media, Marketing, Digital Marketing, similar or equivalent experience.
 



 Professional experience: no previous professional experience is required
 



 Skills:
 


* Strong interest in digital and website technologies.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
* Strong analytical and problem\\-solving skills.
* Detail\\-oriented and organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Basic understanding of web technologies (HTML, CSS, etc.) is a plus.



  





**Benefits**

 :
 



* Gain valuable professional experience in a dynamic and supportive environment.
* Develop a strong understanding of the digital marketing landscape.
* Contribute to the success of a leading company.
* Opportunity to learn from experienced professionals.



  





**Place of work:**
 Bresso (hybrid work)

 Insight and trends

* Italy 50%

**What You Bring To The Table**
* 6\\+ years experience in marketing environment, of which at least 3 years experience in data analysis (research agency, data analytics, qualitative and quantitative) and working with research tools.
* Excellent ability to communicate and influence.
* Ability to work independently and use curiosity to kickstart and drive analysis.

* Ability to simplify complex analytical reports outcome for non\\-analytical people to understand.
* Strong business acumen and judgment along with strategic capabilities.
* Fluent English and Italian in reading/writing as well as speaking/listening.
* Spanish is highly recommended.


**What Makes You Unique**
* Experience delivering Nielsen Presentations and set up of regular reporting.
* Experience in spirits business.


**Who We Are**

title: Machine Learning Scientist Intern
description:
Integral Ad Science (IAS) is a global technology and data company that builds verification, optimization, and analytics solutions for the advertising industry and we’re looking for a Machine Learning Scientist (ML) Intern to join our Multimedia Core Service team in Modena, Italy. If you are excited by technology that has the power to handle hundreds of thousands of transactions per second; collect tens of billions of events each day; and evaluate thousands of data\\-points in real\\-time all while responding in just a few milliseconds, then IAS is the place for you!
   

  

 As a ML Scientist Intern you will work on advancing the understanding and application of dimensionality reduction techniques for sparse feature matrices generated by semantic engines. You will prototype, implement and evaluate a range of dimensionality reduction approaches. The second phase of the project will involve comparing the reduced\\-dimensional embedding spaces with existing pre\\-trained embeddings, to study similarities, overlaps, and differences in representation. This analysis will provide insights into how rule\\-based semantic features compare with context\\-aware neural representations This internship is an opportunity for you to gain practical experience with deep learning, interacting with large scale production environments and having the opportunity to research novel methods that can push the state of the art of media understanding and content evaluation.
   

  

**What you’ll get to do** 
 :
   

  

* Conduct in\\-depth research and experimentation on a wide array of dimensionality reduction techniques, with a particular focus on their applicability to sparse feature matrices commonly produced by semantic engines. This will involve prototyping, implementing, and rigorously evaluating methods such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Truncated Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), and neural embedding models (e.g., autoencoders).
* Leverage these feature representations to construct and train machine learning models that can effectively address a variety of downstream tasks, such as classification, regression, clustering, or anomaly detection.
* Work with the framework of your choice, e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.
* Integrate machine learning models into production systems.
* Stay up\\-to\\-date with the latest advancements in the field of machine learning and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.


**You should apply if you have most of this experience:**
* Currently pursuing a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Computer Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
* Familiarity with machine learning and deep learning methods.
* Proficiency in Python and experience with libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
* Familiarity with SVD, BERT, ViT, or CLIP is a plus.
* Experience with Self\\-Supervised Learning methods is also a plus.


**About Integral Ad Science**
 Integral Ad Science (IAS) is a leading global media measurement and optimization platform that delivers the industry’s most actionable data to drive superior results for the world’s largest advertisers, publishers, and media platforms. IAS’s software provides comprehensive and enriched data that ensures ads are seen by real people in safe and suitable environments, while improving return on ad spend for advertisers and yield for publishers.  At Barilla, we believe that every great journey begins with passion and a bold vision. From our humble beginnings in 1877 in a small shop in Parma, Italy, we’ve blossomed into a global leader in the food industry, guided by our commitment to progress and excellence.

**Are you ready to add your unique flavor to our journey?**
 Working context
   

  

 The stageur will work inside the Agronomy research Team which, among the main responsibilities, manage basil agronomy research projects and design and test innovative farming models (e.g. regenerative agriculture system).
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Research and implementation of agronomic digital tools (eg. forecasting models, remote sensing, AI, …), sustainable cultivation systems (eg. Regenerative agriculture) and biocontrol strategies.
   

  

 He/she will work in collaboration with the Agronomy team, applying directly in the field and with farmers, the innovative practices and the digital tools developed.
   

  

 The candidate will work within internal and external networks: Barilla Agronomy research team and Purchasing department, farmers, research centers/institution, service providers.
   

  

 Main activities
   

  

* Identify new agricultural techniques to promote the transition from conventional to regenerative agriculture in basil cultivation.
* Plan the design of experiments and carry out field trials.
* Collaborate with identify basil cultivars tolerant to biotic and abiotic stresses (diseases, water scarcity,…).
* Support the implementation and monitoring of digital and AI technologies (e.g. irrigation modeling, decision support systems, smart measurement systems,…).
* Collaborate with the Agronomy team applying innovative biocontrol practices.
* Data collection, analysis and reporting.


**Requirements**
* Degree in Agriculture science and technology (3\\-5 years degree).
* Knowledge and/or experience on sustainable agriculture systems or on smart farming tools.
* Interest for innovative cultivation systems applied to our strategic raw materials.
* Attitude to team\\-working and co\\-design approach.
* Ability to nurture good relationship.
* Ability to face different problems keeping ideas.
* Good communication skills, to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Fluency in Italian and English, both spoken and written.
* Self\\-capacity to take decisions/prioritize activities.
* Proactivity

 Start date: June 2025
