title: Extracurricular Internship (Gradute Internship) - Pinheiro Group
description:
**Job Description**
**Human Technopole (HT)** 
 is an interdisciplinary life science research institute, created and supported by the Italian Government, with the aim of developing innovative strategies to improve human health. HT is composed of five Centers: Neurogenomics, Computational Biology, Structural Biology, Genomics, and Health Data Science. The Centers work together to enable interdisciplinary research and to create an open, collaborative environment that will help promote life science research both nationally and internationally.
   

  

 The Pinheiro Lab in the Computational Biology Research Centre at Human Technopole, led by Dr. Fernanda Pinheiro, integrates theoretical and experimental research to develop a predictive framework for evolutionary processes under ecological complexity grounded on models of cell metabolism. We are a hybrid theoretical and experimental lab with a strong interest in understanding antibiotic resistance evolution in complex ecologies including microbial communities where many bacteria interact. We combine systems biology approaches, evolutionary modeling, computational methods, data analysis, and data from evolution experiments, establishing a strong dialog between theory and experiments: We use theory to identify interesting regimes that can optimize experimental designs and biology to motivate new theoretical methods.
   

  

**Internship Project Description**
 The Pinheiro Lab is seeking a motivated postgraduate researcher for an extracurricular internship, focusing on the development of mechanistic models for microbial evolution in complex ecologies. We encourage applicants with a strong quantitative background to join our interdisciplinary team, working at the intersection of systems biology, ecology, and evolution. The selected candidate will collaborate closely with researchers from various fields to explore innovative solutions in microbial evolution.
   

  

**Key tasks and activities**
* Assist in the development of mechanistic models for microbial evolution in complex ecologies (e.g., in response to antibiotic challenge, in interacting microbial communities, for predator\\-prey systems);
* Collaborate with experimental group members to support the design of experiments, data analysis, and testing of theoretical hypotheses;
* Develop critical thinking and gain insight into scientific research by contributing to discussions, presentations, and scientific writing under the guidance of senior researchers;
* Participate in enhancing the group’s network of internal and external collaborations.


**Job Requirements**
**Essential requirements**
* A Master's (or equivalent) in a quantitative field (Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related area) with an interest in biological systems.
* Fluency in English \\- HT is an international research institute.


**Preferred Requirements**
* Strong analytical and numerical skills (experience with any programming language is welcome, and training will be provided if needed).
* Comfort with working with biological datasets (previous learning experience is a plus, but not required).


**Organizational And Social Skills**
* Ability to interact effectively in an interdisciplinary environment with other team members and teams, and work synergistically to drive projects forward.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\\-paced environment and to work independently;
* Ability to work in a multi\\-cultural, multi\\-ethnic environment with sensitivity and respect for diversity.
* Highly curious, creative, and ambitious individuals that are open to pursue new theoretical avenues, willing to develop and implement new methods, with a strong interest in conceptual research.
* Excellent communication and team working skills.


**Application Instructions**
* a CV.
* a motivation letter in English.
* For specific enquires concerning the role only, please contact the Talent \\& Acquisition Team, recruitment@fht.org (this email address should not be used to send applications).


**Why Human Technopole**
 HT seeks scientific excellence, we recruit the best scientific talents through international, open calls.
   

  

 Our working environment is international, friendly and inclusive. Our scientists work together across disciplines on research topics of biomedical relevance, leveraging synergies between their diverse skillsets and methodological approaches.
   

  

 We believe that highly diverse teams yield the best and most innovative results.
   

  

 We engage in outward\\-facing scientific activities aimed at benefiting the national and international research community. Training is also at the heart of our activity, with initiatives and opportunities for our staff, including scientific courses, conferences and workshops.
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Canteen service.
* Guest House upon availability, if needed.
* Access to all training initiatives targeted to HT scientists.
* International research environment with networking and training opportunities.
* Hands\\-on experience with real\\-world research projects addressing compelling scientific questions and applying state\\-of\\-the\\-art technologies.
* Supervision by experienced researchers providing personalized feedback and career advice.


*Special consideration will be given to candidates who are part of the protected categories list, according to L. 68/99\\.*
**Number of positions offered:** 
 1
   

  

**Internship duration:** 
 up to 12 months.
   

  

**Reimbursement.**
**The position is based in Milan.**
*The Foundation reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to extend, suspend, modify, revoke, or cancel this job posting without giving rise to any rights or claims whatsoever in favor of the candidates; the Foundation reserves, however, the right not to proceed with the awarding of the above\\-described assignment due to the effect of supervening regulatory provisions and/or obstructive circumstances.*

**Junior Data Scientist** 




  





 Are you curious and ready to accept a new challenge in your career? Are you eager to join a dynamic company and bring innovation through your work and skills?
 



 Prometeia offers you opportunities for growth and training in a Group with over 1000 professionals working for more than 500 clients in 20 countries around the world.
 



 We are looking for candidates interested in enriching our Data Science team, and the development of new technologies/tools related to it.
 



  





**PROFILE:** 




 The ideal candidate is a student / new graduate in machine learning / big data engineering subjects. He/she is interested in using large amounts of data to develop models and applications in the financial / insurance domain. He/she is also interested in software engineering and is willing to gain experience in the scientific computing domain.

* Critical analysis of large volumes of banking/insurance data.

* Attention to detail, excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Critical/experimental approach to data analysis.



  





**NICE TOHAVE:** 



* Ability to rapidly define ideas and solutions, develop critical analyses, and use creative approaches to solve complex problems.
* Experience with code versioning systems (git).
* Experience in Pyspark development.
* Experience in processing and modeling with unstructured data (Text Analytics, Computer Vision)



  





**EDUCATION \\& EXPERIENCE:** 



* Bachelor's/Master's degree with excellent grades in Data Science, Statistics, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related fields (PhD in the same fields is nice to have)
* Experience in a corporate environment (including internships), preferably in finance or insurance.



  





**LOCATION:** 




 Milan/Bologna

 As a Data Analysis and Reporting Intern, you will have the opportunity to support our corporate tutor in various critical activities related to data analysis and reporting.

* **Structured Report Generation:** 
 Develop structured reports to present complex data analyses in a clear and accessible manner.

* **Hands\\-On Experience:**

 The selected candidate will be offered a 6\\-month extracurricular internship, including expense reimbursement and access to the company cafeteria. The position requires a commitment of 37 hours per week, from Monday to Friday.  
 



**Internship location:**

title: AI & Innovation Technology Intern
description:
**Zambon** 
 is a multinational pharmaceutical and chemical company focused on innovation and development to improve people’s health and patients’ lives. Based on a valuable heritage but strongly focused on the future, its Vision is “Innovating cure and care to make patients’ lives better”. Zambon operates in the pharmaceutical and chemical business and is present in 20 countries with subsidiaries in three different Continents – Europe, America, and Asia – and over 2900 employees, with manufacturing units in Italy, Switzerland, France, China, and Brazil. Zambon products are commercialized in 84 countries. The company is working on treating specialties and rare diseases, such as Parkinson’s disease and Cystic Fibrosis, and is well\\-established in 3 therapeutic areas: respiratory, pain, and women’s care.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 The AI \\& Innovation Technology Intern will support the development and implementation of innovative AI solutions, with a focus on generative AI, to enhance business processes, create measurable business value, improve operational efficiency, and support the company's strategic objectives. The intern will work closely with cross\\-functional teams to identify and develop AI use cases, promote AI literacy across the organization, and assist in establishing a robust AI governance framework.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities of the role:** 



* **AI Use Case Development Support**
* Assist in identifying and developing AI use cases that drive innovation and efficiency.
* Collaborate with cross\\-functional teams to implement AI\\-driven solutions, with a focus on generative AI, that create measurable business value.
* Support the evaluation and recommendation of AI tools for use within the company.
* **Internal Training \\& Awareness Program**
* Contribute to the design and implementation of AI awareness programs to upskill employees and promote AI literacy.
* Assist in organizing internal events, editorial plans, and training sessions to educate employees on AI concepts, applications, and best practices.
* Collaborate with HR and communication teams to support the implementation of training activities.
* **Governance**
* Support the development of an AI governance framework to ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
* Assist in coordinating with internal committees to map and analyze AI use cases and establish policies and guidelines for AI use.
* Help in the communication of AI governance initiatives.
* **Innovation**
* Foster a culture of creativity and forward\\-thinking by exploring and encouraging the implementation of innovative solutions, including generative AI, that support business growth and transformation.
* Participate in strategic planning for emerging technologies and contribute to setting priorities and defining implementation roadmaps for innovative projects.



  





**What we are looking for:** 



* Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Data Science, Engineering, Computer science, or a STEM related field.
* Previous internship or project experience in AI \\& machine learning is a plus.
* Good knowledge in programming languages such as Python, R, or Java: 3
* Knowledge of machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\\-learn): 3
* Experience with generative AI models and applications: 4
* Familiarity with data analysis tools and techniques: 2
* Excellent knowledge of English: 5
* Strong analytical and problem\\-solving skills. (Competence Level: Excellent)
* Effective communication and teamwork abilities. (Competence Level: Excellent)
* Ability to work independently and manage time effectively. (Competence Level: Good)
* Creative thinking and a passion for innovation. (Competence Level: Excellent)
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies. (Competence Level: Excellent)
* Agile and collaborative mindset (Competence Level: Good)



  





**Place of work:** 
 Bresso (MI) \\- Hybrid Work

 Milano, IT
   

  

 Market Research Intern

* Research Management: Get an overall understanding about market research process (objective, brief, methods, set up, field, results) and support the administration routine.


**Your Team**
 This position report directly to the Consumer Market and Shopper Insight Manager of Bolton Food. There are no direct reports for this role, but you will work closely with different departments.

* Education: Master’s degree in Economics/Statistics or equivalent;
* Proficiency in written and spoken English and Italian;
* Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Power Point)
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail;
* Ability to set priorities;
* Collaborative, team working approach and ability to demonstrate commitment;
* Interest in understanding consumer and shopper needs/ behavior and market trends;
* Being passionate and strongly interested in food products/trends.


 What’s in for your
   

  

* Work location: Milan, Italy

title: Project Management Intern
description:
Piemme S.p.A. è alla ricerca di una risorsa brillante e motivata da inserire all’interno della nostra Direzione Digital di Milano.
  
  

Se non ci conosci, ci presentiamo!
  
  

Piemme S.p.A. è la Media Platform del Gruppo Caltagirone Editore, con un portafoglio media che comprende:
  
Quotidiani d’informazione di proprietà (Il Messaggero, Il Mattino, Il Gazzettino, Corriere Adriatico, Nuovo Quotidiano di Puglia, la social press Leggo)
  
Siti di news online delle rispettive testate
  
Siti terzi in concessione (Aranzulla.it, Funweek.it, Centrometeoitaliano.it, Sorrisi.com, Focus.it, FocusJunior.it)
  
Periodici del Gruppo Editoriale San Paolo (Famiglia Cristiana, Maria con Te, Credere; Benessere; Il Giornalino, G Baby, I Love English)
  
Periodici Mondadori (TV Sorrisi e Canzoni, Chi, Telepiù, Guida TV, Focus, Focus Storia, Focus Junior, Focus Pico, Focus Wild)
  
Periodici Reworld Media (Grazia e Icon)
  
Radio Subasio, Radio Ciccioriccio, Radio Bruno e Radio Birikina
  
TV Telenova
  
  

**Siamo dove sarai tu:** grazie alla nostra Rete Sales diffusa sul territorio nazionale, ogni progetto partirà dal cliente e crescerà con te.
  
  

Le tue sfide quotidiane
  
Contribuirai all'aggiornamento del Gantt progettuale, monitorando i progressi e supportando il Leadership Team nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi.
  
Supporterai la realizzazione di un documento di analisi sul mercato dei referral e della fidelizzazione dei clienti, proponendo una soluzione strategica e applicativa per Piemme, con focus su processi e strumenti da implementare (Progetto Loyalty).
  
Collaborando con il Team Trafficking, analizzerai i dati di traffico per la produzione di report sui principali trend di performance. Il tuo focus sarà sulla valorizzazione e la monetizzazione dell'invenduto digitale.
  
  

Must Have
  
  

Siamo impegnati nella costruzione di percorsi di crescita e valorizzazione del talento. Per renderlo possibile, puntiamo su persone che abbiano nel loro CV:
  
Iscrizione ad un Master o Corso di Laurea Magistrale (Economia, Data Analytics, Digital Communication) che permetta l'attivazione di uno stage curriculare della durata di almeno 6 mesi
  
Familiarità con il pacchetto Office, in particolare Excel
  
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese
  
Spirito curioso, proattivo e ami lavorare in squadra
  
Capacità di organizzazione, gestire priorità e affrontare i problemi con uno sguardo pratico
  
Comunicazione efficace
  
  

Nice To Have
  
Conoscenza base dei concetti di Project Management e tool come Trello, Asana, Jira o Microsoft Project
  
Hai sentito parlare di Agile o Waterfall
  
Ti piace lavorare con i numeri e fare reporting (Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI)
  
Nozioni base di budgeting e controllo costi
  
  

La nostra opportunità
  
Inserimento con stage curriculare della durata di sei mesi
  
Rimborso spese e buoni pasto
  
Un ambiente in cui imparare davvero, con il supporto del team e la possibilità di seguire progetti reali fin dal primo giorno
  
  

Se ti rispecchi in questo ruolo, inviaci il tuo CV con autorizzazione al trattamento dati personali (D.lgs. 196/2003 e GDPR 679/16\\).
  
  

Il presente annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi (L.903/77 – L.125/91\\).

title: Senior Content Strategist (posizione solo per P.IVA)
description:
Siamo alla ricerca di un **Senior** **Content Strategist** da inserire nel nostro team!

**Il ruolo del Senior Content Strategist**
------------------------------------------


Cerchiamo una persona creativa, strategica e appassionata, capace di definire una strategia di contenuti mirata e coerente, allineando i messaggi del brand con le esigenze del pubblico. Il suo contributo sarà fondamentale per migliorare la visibilità, l’engagement e il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di marketing aziendali.

### **Perché unirti a noi?**

* Perché siamo un’agenzia con obiettivi di crescita importanti
* Perché lavoriamo con importanti brand e aziende di settori differenti che regalano continue sfide e stimoli
* Perché ci prendiamo cura delle persone
* Perché abbiamo già pronto un piano di inserimento e di crescita per te
* Perché ti garantiamo un percorso di formazione personalizzato
* Perché troverai un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e stimolante
* Perché prevediamo premialità sui risultati ottenuti
* Perché ci piace anche divertirci insieme, organizzare attività di team building e non prenderci troppo sul serio
* Perché potrai lavorare alcuni giorni in modalità remote working
### **Quali responsabilità ti affideremo?**

* Definire e implementare strategie di contenuto complesse, mirate a incrementare engagement e conversione
* Mantenere coerenza e unicità del brand in tutte le attività di content strategy
* Analizzare le performance dei contenuti attraverso metriche avanzate
* Ottimizzare le strategie sulla base dei dati raccolti
* Innovare costantemente i contenuti, anticipando trend e nuove opportunità
### **Quali saranno le tue principali mansioni?**

* Condurre analisi e ricerche di mercato per individuare trend, esigenze del pubblico e opportunità di posizionamento differenziante lato contenuti
* Sviluppare e implementare la strategia di brand (tono di voce, archetipi, valori), in coordinamento con il Digital Marketing Strategist
* Definire il Piano di Marketing e Comunicazione, con focus sulla content strategy omnichannel
* Collaborare con gli specialist coinvolti per creare e distribuire contenuti coerenti ed efficaci sui canali online (siti web, newsletter, webinar, video, podcast, social media) e offline (company profile, brochure, eventi, cataloghi)
* Ideare e gestire piani editoriali integrati, in sinergia con le strategie di marketing
* Coordinare i touchpoint di comunicazione del cliente per garantire un messaggio coerente e un’esperienza utente ottimizzata
* Lavorare con il team grafico, fotografi e videomaker per creare asset visivi allineati alla strategia
* Utilizzare piattaforme di data analysis (es. Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Meta) per ottimizzare le strategie e valutare l’efficacia dei contenuti
* Elaborare report periodici sulle performance dei contenuti, in collaborazione con gli altri specialist coinvolti
* Mantenere aggiornato il Project Manager in merito a nuove informazioni rilevanti per il progetto
* Fornire consulenza strategica in ambito content strategy, con comunicazione chiara e professionale
* Erogare formazione specialistica, interna o rivolta ai clienti, su tematiche legate alla content strategy
* Collaborare con colleghi di altri ruoli quando richieste competenze trasversali, mantenendo la responsabilità dei risultati
* Affiancare e supportare tirocinanti o colleghi junior, trasferendo know\\-how e monitorando i risultati
* Partecipare ai Meeting Milestone interni e con i clienti per presentare e consegnare deliverable
* In base alle informazioni raccolte, sviluppare e implementare la strategia social per le piattaforme social individuate
* Creare contenuti testuali e visivi (utilizzando Canva) del calendario editoriale facendo in modo che il tono di voce e i valori del brand siano rispettati
* Supervisionare la creazione di contenuti video o fotografici
* Fornire al cliente indicazioni sui contenuti parlati dei video, suggerendo messaggi chiari, efficaci e in linea con il tone of voice del brand
### **Cosa ti chiediamo?**

* **Esperienza consolidata** nella definizione e gestione di strategie di contenuto multicanale
* Esperienza nella **gestione del cliente**, dalla raccolta del brief al coordinamento del progetto
* **Buona conoscenza** della lingua inglese
* Ottima capacità di analisi e sintesi per trasformare dati, insight e brief in contenuti strategici
* Conoscenza degli strumenti di content management e delle principali piattaforme di analytics (es. Google Analytics, Semrush, Meta, Search Console)
* Eccellenti doti di scrittura e storytelling, con attenzione al tono di voce e alla coerenza del brand
* Capacità di collaborare con team multidisciplinari (designer, videomaker, marketer, project manager)
* Attitudine proattiva, spirito critico e orientamento al problem solving
* Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, gestendo più progetti in parallelo e rispettando le scadenze
* Disponibilità a fornire consulenza, formazione e supporto sia internamente che ai clienti
* Curiosità, aggiornamento costante e interesse per le nuove tendenze in ambito comunicazione e marketing digital
### **Completano il profilo**

* Mentalità strategica unita a un approccio creativo e orientato all’innovazione
* Precisione, cura del dettaglio e attenzione alla qualità in ogni fase del lavoro
* Capacità di adattarsi a contesti e clienti diversi, mantenendo coerenza e visione
* Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative, sia scritte che orali
* Flessibilità e apertura al confronto, con una forte attitudine al lavoro di squadra
* Propensione alla crescita professionale e al continuo aggiornamento
* Interesse per il branding, il marketing e la cultura digitale in senso ampio

title: Talent & Performance Trainee
description:
About us:
Flutter, the world’s largest online sports betting and iGaming group listed on the London and New York stock exchanges, is home to the Southern Europe \\& Africa (SEA) region, featuring iconic brands like Sisal and PokerStars, a globally loved brand that embodies innovation and ambition, with significant growth potential in a dynamic market.
What You Will Do:
As a Talent \\& Performance Trainee, you will join the People \\& Culture team, reporting to the Talent \\& Career Manager. You will contribute to shaping talent development and career growth strategies, enhancing people’s experiences both locally and internationally within Sisal.
You will have the opportunity to support the following areas:
Talent \\& Career Management:* Support talent development initiatives, focusing on internal mobility and growth programs.
* Assist managers and HRBPs in implementing talent management projects aligned with corporate guidelines.
* Monitor individual development plans to ensure professional growth in line with corporate strategies.


Performance Management:* Support the performance management process, collaborating with stakeholders across teams and countries.
* Prepare materials to support employees, managers, and HR teams in managing performance.
* Help ensure alignment between performance management processes and the Workday system.


Analytics \\& Insights Management:* Assist in analyzing performance, talent, training, and career data contributing to create a talent dashboard.
* Support data interpretation to drive strategic improvements.


Who You Are:* Good knowledge of written and spoken English.
* Proficiency in Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint.


Skills:* Interest in talent development and performance management topics.
* Strong communication skills and ability to foster a collaborative environment.
* Positive and proactive attitude, with a willingness to learn and take on challenges.
* Basic knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint, and/or HRIS systems (experience with Workday or BI tools is a plus).
* International mindset and ability to work in a dynamic environment.
* Excellent knowledge of Italian and English; French is a plus.


Education:* Degree in Human Resources, Economics, Work Psychology, or Business Management.
* A Master's degree or certifications in Talent Development, Coaching, or Performance Management are an advantage.


What We Offer:* Internship contract with possible employment
* Hybrid work model.
* An inclusive and stimulating work environment.
* Company devices (laptop and corporate phone).
* Meal vouchers.
* Learning and professional growth opportunities.
* Psychological and wellness support services.
* Volunteer opportunities during working hours.


Equal Opportunities
Sisal is an equal opportunity employer. Diversity and Inclusion are fundamental values for us. We welcome every application regardless of gender, age, culture, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression.
Location: Milan (MM2 Garibaldi)

description:
**Descrizione azienda**
-----------------------


Ciaopeople è un gruppo editoriale leader in Italia nel campo digitale. Opera nell’informazione online, nella produzione multimediale e nei servizi di intrattenimento.


Ciaopeople è editore di Fanpage.it, the Jackal, Cookist, Ohga, Kodami, Geopop, Lexplain e Deepinto.


Ciaopeople ha sedi a Napoli, Roma, Milano.

**Posizione**
-------------


Siamo alla ricerca di una persona da inserire in Stage, per un percorso formativo che la vedrà impegnata, in costante affiancamento al tutor aziendale, nello svolgimento di attività che rispondo al ruolo di:

 **SEO Content Editor**

  

La persona scelta farà parte del team SEO e si occuperà, nella prima fase, di attività editoriali dedicate a contenuti di affiliate marketing. Dopo un periodo iniziale, la formazione continuerà su uno dei progetti del gruppo. In questa seconda fase è previsto lo svolgimento di nuove e diverse attività inerenti allo specifico progetto, utili per proseguire il percorso formativo.

 **Di cosa ti occuperai?**


Nel periodo iniziale della formazione, il principale obiettivo dello stage sarà la realizzazione di contenuti editoriali (principalmente Guide all’acquisto) che siano seo\\-optimized per il posizionamento sui motori.


Nella seconda fase, la persona scelta, in base alle competenze maturate durante il percorso formativo, verrà introdotta alle attività svolte sugli altri prodotti editoriali, affiancata dai rispettivi referenti del team SEO. Il lavoro consiste nell'ottimizzazione di contenuti redazionali attraverso le più avanzate tecniche SEO: non è prevista nè un'attività giornalistica nè l'utilizzo di strumenti social

 **Obiettivi dello stage**

  

* Analisi di un topic e mappatura in ottica SEO
* Analisi di una SERP di Google e comprensione dei fattori di ranking
* Capacità di riconoscere intenti di ricerca, correlazioni di ricerca e argomenti correlati
* Capacità di scrivere contenuti SEO oriented che risultino utili ed esaustivi per il lettore
* Capacità di monitoraggio dei contenuti, revisione e analisi dei dati

**Requisiti**
-------------


Sei il/la candidato/a perfetto/a se:

* hai esperienza di scrittura per il web;
* hai conoscenza delle logiche SEO di base;
* hai propensione all’analisi semantica dei contenuti
* hai un’ottima padronanza della lingua italiana dal punto di vista ortografico, grammaticale e sintattico
* Sei curioso, intraprendente e motivato a diventare un SEO specializzato in ambito editoriale

  

Requisiti preferenziali:

* conoscenza dei tools principali della SEO (Google Trends; Google Analytics, Google Search Console; SEOzoom; SEMrush);
* esperienza in attività di ufficio stampa;
* esperienza nella creazione di contenuti di Affiliation o eCommerce;
* conoscenza delle logiche di digital marketing;
* conoscenza dell’inglese.

  

Allegati:

* esempi di articoli o contenuti scritti per il web

  

Perché dovresti fare application?


In Ciaopeople crediamo che il potere della condivisione sia in grado di creare valore e generare il cambiamento.


Con questa esperienza potrai entrare a far parte di una realtà che ha rivoluzionato il mondo dell’editoria e della creazione dei contenuti, con possibilità di crescita ed apprendimento non solo con il tuo team di riferimento ma anche con il costante confronto con i tuoi colleghi…il tutto, divertendoti!


Allora, cosa stai aspettando?

**Altre informazioni**
----------------------

* Help to deliver **analytics and insight reports** on key metrics to optimize future actions on customer engagement plan and experience to ensure data\\-driven mindset
* Elaborate Excel files and Power Point presentation

**About you**

* Degree in Economics, Marketing/Digital Marketing or Engineering
* Fluent English (B2 level or higher)
* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
* Knowledge of Sales Force Marketing Cloud will be considered as a plus
* Strong communication skills, high motivation, and a keen interest in marketing
* Team player, time management and problem\\-solving skills

* Bring the **miracles of science** to life alongside a supportive, future\\-focused team.
* Start your career with **inspiring mentors** who will help you take your first professional steps.
* You will have the possibility to carry out the internship in a **hybrid mode**.
* We offer an **internship lasting 6 months**. Competitive **monthly compensation** and **meal vouchers** will be provided.

**Pursue** ***Progress*****. Discover** ***Extraordinary*****.**


Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. title: IGrow - Graduate Program
description:
**Gruppo Italgas**
------------------



Italgas è una Network Tech Company, leader nei settori della distribuzione del gas, dei servizi idrici, dell’efficienza energetica e dell’IT. A seguito dell’acquisizione di 2i Rete Gas, suo principale competitor, Italgas diventa il primo operatore nella distribuzione del gas in Europa, gestendo una rete di oltre 150\\.000 chilometri e servendo circa 13 milioni di clienti in Italia e Grecia. Attraverso le sue controllate nel settore idrico, il Gruppo fornisce servizi, direttamente e indirettamente, a 6,2 milioni di persone, pari al 10% della popolazione italiana, principalmente nelle regioni Lazio, Sicilia e Campania. Fondata nel 1837, Italgas è riconosciuta come la società che ha portato il gas nelle case degli italiani, contribuendo in modo significativo allo sviluppo economico e sociale del Paese.


**Job Summary**
---------------


**IGrow** è il Graduate Program di Italgas dedicato a giovani talenti motivati ad intraprendere un percorso di carriera accelerato e altamente formativo, dove saranno chiamati a portare cambiamento e innovazione nelle aree strategiche dei nostri business. Questo programma permetterà di specializzarti in una funzione chiave dell'azienda, offrendoti una formazione pratica e multidisciplinare attraverso **job rotation** e mobilità geografica.


**Diventa protagonista della Transizione Energetica!**


**Job Description**
-------------------


**Il Programma**


Partecipando al programma, ti specializzerai in una delle seguenti aree strategiche di Italgas, acquisendo una visione completa del business e contribuendo attivamente alla crescita dell'azienda. Le tre funzioni si differenziano per le loro sfide e opportunità, ma tutte sono fondamentali per supportare l'evoluzione e il successo del Gruppo.

  


**1\\. Finance \\& Controlling**


La funzione rappresenta il motore strategico dell’azienda. Finance lavora in sinergia con le altre divisioni aziendali per ottimizzare la gestione delle risorse, supervisionare la salute finanziaria del gruppo, garantire l’efficienza operativa e la sostenibilità a lungo termine. In questo contesto, svolgerai attività chiave come la pianificazione finanziaria, la gestione del rischio e controllo e l’analisi e il monitoraggio dei dati, con l’obiettivo di supportare il miglioramento continuo delle performance aziendali.

  


**2\\. Operation \\& Engineering**


Operation \\& Engineering si occupa della gestione, manutenzione e ottimizzazione degli asset di Italgas, garantendo l’affidabilità e la sicurezza delle infrastrutture. La funzione ha un impatto diretto sulla qualità del servizio e sulla capacità di rispondere prontamente alle esigenze del mercato e alle sfide future del settore energetico. All’interno di questo stream, avrai la possibilità di gestire e ottimizzare le infrastrutture e i processi operativi e supervisionare progetti tecnici ad alto impatto strategico.

  


**3\\. AI \\& Innovation**


Con il continuo evolversi delle tecnologie digitali, la funzione AI \\& Innovation si concentra sullo sviluppo di soluzioni tecnologiche innovative per affrontare le sfide della digitalizzazione e della transizione energetica. In questo stream, le attività spaziano dalla ricerca e sviluppo all’open innovation fino all'applicazione di tecniche di data analytics e AI, con l'obiettivo di ottimizzare i processi aziendali e migliorare l'efficienza operativa. Contribuirai alla digitalizzazione dei processi e degli asset, trasformando i dati in soluzioni concrete che migliorano la gestione delle risorse, la sostenibilità e la solidità delle infrastrutture.


**Competenze Tecniche**
-----------------------


**Obiettivi del Programma IGrow**


IGrow ha una durata complessiva di 36 mesi e prevede tre job rotation tra le sedi del Gruppo dislocate su tutto il territorio nazionale. Durante il programma, ricoprirai ruoli diversificati che ti permetteranno di crescere in modo completo acquisendo competenze trasversali e al termine, avrai la possibilità di assumere una posizione di responsabilità all’interno del Gruppo.


**Requisiti**


* Laurea magistrale in ambito ingegneristico, scientifico, economico, finanziario conseguita con ottimi risultati;
* Titolo di laurea conseguito da non più di un anno o in fase di conseguimento entro il 2025;
* Disponibilità alla mobilità geografica su tutto il territorio nazionale per l’intera durata del programma;
* Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, meglio se avvalorata da un’esperienza all’estero;
* Disponibilità ad un inserimento full time dal 1° settembre 2025;
* Digital mindset e capacità analitiche;
* Spirito d’iniziativa, curiosità, flessibilità e comunicazione efficace.


Precedenti esperienze di stage o lavorative sono considerate un plus.


**Deadline per la candidatura: 16 maggio 2025**


**Ulteriori Competenze**
------------------------


**La Nostra Offerta**


* Contratto a tempo indeterminato con pacchetto retributivo dedicato e dinamico per tutti gli anni di durata del programma;
* Premio di produzione;
* Politica di relocation a carico dell'azienda;
* Lavoro ibrido;
* Percorsi di formazione tecnica e manageriale attraverso la nostra Academy;
* Iniziative per il welfare e benessere del dipendente.


**Il processo di selezione**


* Candidatura entro il 16 maggio 2025
* Intervista conoscitiva con HR
* Test on\\-line logico attitudinali
* Assessment in presenza
* Intervista individuale con Line Manager ed HR

* Conoscenza delle strategie di link building e SEO tecnica,

* Un ambiente di lavoro giovane e stimolante,
* Formazione avanzata per trasformarti in un professionista SEO in 6 mesi,

* Dal lunedì al venerdì

The team are – highly trained, proactive and international – and the media buying department are capable of creating growth anytime, anywhere. We believe in the power of media buying to generate successful campaigns, drive engagement, and ultimately, boost successful collaborations. Our inclusive and dynamic work environment fosters innovation, learning, and growth.

  

As we continue to grow and push the boundaries of what’s possible, we are looking for a **Head of Media Buying** to lead and inspire our team, helping us deliver top\\-tier campaigns across multiple channels and verticals.

**WHAT WE WOULD LIKE YOU TO TAKE CARE OF**

* Develop and implement data\\-driven strategies for media buying campaigns across various verticals (E\\-commerce, Leadgen, iGaming, Nutra, and Dating), ensuring full\\-funnel optimization and effective traffic acquisition.
* Oversee and manage a team of media buyers to execute campaigns across multiple verticals (e\\-commerce, leadgen, iGaming, Nutra, and dating), ensuring high\\-quality performance and timely delivery. Inspire your team to reach ambitious KPIs while fostering a culture of growth and collaboration.
* Develop and optimize media buying strategies across the entire funnel from customer acquisition to conversion, ensuring optimal campaign performance at every stage. This includes driving traffic through multiple paid channels, optimizing landing pages, and improving conversion rates on traffic sources like Meta, Google, DIsplay and in\\-App.
* Oversee campaign monitoring, analysis, and optimization efforts to ensure continuous growth and improvement. Use data and KPIs to adjust strategies for maximum ROI.
* Manage the identification, acquisition, and scaling of high\\-quality traffic sources while managing budgets and ensuring cost\\-effective media buying.
* Work closely with other departments (creative, analytics, and development teams) to align media buying strategies with overall business objectives.
* Prepare regular performance reports, insights, and strategy recommendations for senior leadership, ensuring transparency in campaign results and contributing to strategic decision\\-making.
* Keep up with industry trends and emerging platforms, ensuring \\\\LeadX Pro remains at the forefront of media buying innovation.
* Leading, managing a multicultural team, effectively communicating in English.

**WHAT WE WISH YOU’D BRING WITH**

* Proven experience as a senior affiliate marketer or media buyer with at least 4 affiliate accounts or teams managed. Experience working in a structured, results\\-oriented organization with a strong background in campaign management and optimization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage media buying across the entire funnel, from acquisition to conversion.
* Lead the acquisition of traffic sources and manage high\\-volume, scalable campaigns.
* A natural leader with experience managing and motivating teams to achieve and exceed performance goals. (Experience leading multicultural teams is a plus).
* Strong competencies in acquiring and managing high\\-performing traffic sources to drive growth and performance.
* Strong skills in data analysis and optimization. Comfortable working with data to draw actionable insights and refine campaign strategies.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to present campaign performance and strategy to senior leadership clearly and effectively.
* Team \\& Stakeholder Communication: Manage and coordinate with cross\\-functional teams (e.g., creative, data analytics, developers) to ensure seamless campaign execution. Report directly to senior leadership on campaign performance, insights, and improvements.
* Stay at the forefront of industry trends and traffic strategies, exploring new channels, tools, and technologies to ensure that LeadX Pro remains an innovator in media buying.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Familiarity with multiple industries (ecommerce, leadgen, iGaming, Nutra, dating) and understanding their unique media buying needs and challenges.
* Comfort with using tracking systems (Redtrack, Voluum, Keitaro), integrations (Zapier), and media buying platforms. Basic knowledge of WordPress or Shopify is a plus.
* Strong desire to learn new tools, platforms, and strategies in an ever\\-changing media buying landscape.

**WHAT WE WOULD LIKE TO OFFER YOU**

* Join an innovative team during an exciting phase of growth.
* Opportunity for rapid growth within your role and beyond, through a career progression \\& internal rotation program.
* Independence and full autonomy to shape your work as you prefer and suggest changes that truly make an impact.
* Contract: contractor.
* Compensation: Fixed compensation \\& competitive performance bonuses compared to industry standards.
* Full remote

description:
**Sei creativo/a, appassionato/a di comunicazione digitale e pronto/a a sporcarti le mani con un po' di sano lavoro di squadra? Allora potresti essere la persona che stiamo cercando!**

La nostra Social Media Manager ha bisogno di un **partner in crime**…sei pronto/a ad aiutarci a rompere gli schemi?

**Cosa farai?**

Creerai contenuti che spaccano su Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook e soprattutto TikTok

Supporterai la nostra Social Media Manager nella gestione di campagne social e digital, imparando anche a redigere report

Comparirai anche nei video, quindi preparati a essere al top davanti alla telecamera!

Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team, ma diventerai presto autonomo/a (cerchiamo chi sa cavarsela anche da solo/a!)

**Ci piacerebbe se tu sapessi usare:**

✅Canva (o simili) per creare grafiche accattivanti

✅CapCut o Premiere per montare short video virali

✅Gestione di Meta per ottimizzare le nostre campagne social

✅Tool di monitoraggio come Google Analytics o Semrush (se li conosci, hai una marcia in più!)

✅WordPress per gestire al meglio i nostri tre siti web

✅Conoscenze base di programmazione per piccoli interventi tecnici

✅Qualsiasi tool che ci aiuti a organizzarci senza diventare matti (Asana? Trello? Scegli tu!)

title: CRM Intern
description:
If you wish to have an immersive experience in a structured **Customer Care Department** and learn to use one of the main marketing tool, apply to this position as **CRM Intern**.


CRM stays for Customer Relationship Management and is a widely used software to manage the journey and the interactions with customers and potential customers. The tool is used for Sales, Marketing and Customer Care management.


 By joining our CRM team, you will learn to master this software and the purposes it's used for in the company strategies. This is the experience for you if you are very precise and accurate and enjoy to collaborate with your teammates positively impacting to achieve the team's goals. With this experience you will also strengthen your organization skills and learn how to analyze different problems and find out solutions.

 **How you will support the team:**

* New fidelity platform: support the team during analysis, development and tests for the new platform that will be implemented for the subsidiaries. Thanks to this platform we can manage loyalty cards for our customers;
* Continue the activation of a new Sales module to enhance customer and quotes management (Copilot, Assistant, AI). This process involves implementing and integrating the new module into our existing systems, training staff on its features and functionalities and ensuring a smooth transition for all users;
* Management and preparation of monthly report for monitoring CRM usage involving data collected from the CRM system;
* Consult requests that come to the CRM team in the help desk platform, do an initial review, and identify whether they can be tasks handled by the CRM team or should be turned over to consultants. Solve the simplest requests independently;
* Support the team during analysis, development and tests for a necessary revision we need to do on CRM processes (involving the different CRM modules ? master data, sales, pre\\-post sales,?).

 **Who you are**

* Studies in Statistics, Economics, or related (student or graduate)
* Fluent English
* Precision and accuracy
* Proactivity and problem solving
* Organization skills
* Reporting and analytics
* Teamworking and collaboration

 **Why you should join us:**


You will become an integral part of our Global Team where people are friendly and work together in a stimulating and fast\\-changing environment.


You will get in contact with our colleagues worldwide and closely work with other departments, getting the overview about how a multinational organization works.


Training will be core since the beginning: you will learn to use our main enterprise tools, in particular *ERP (Infor), Excel, BI (Qlik Sense).*


Finally, we are offering monthly reimbursement from €600/monthly (gross), free canteen and IT toolset.

  


  

Ruolo: Marketing/Relazioni esterne


Tipo di occupazione: Stage

title: DODO After Sales Intern
description:
Summary
Dodo is the beloved Italian ‘charming jewelry’ brand. Its distinctive line of jewels and charms communicates the brand’s values, builds communities and encapsulates special moments. The Milan Maison’s chic, ready\\-to\\-wear jewels are designed to be layered, stacked and mixed\\-and\\-matched, to elevate the everyday look for a modern woman. Sustainable since its inception, and partnering with organizations to protect the environment, Dodo is one of the ﬁrst jewelers to use 100% responsible gold in all its creations. Inclusive in its very existence, DoDo encourages diversity and self\\-expression, believing that authenticity is the purest jewel in all of us.
Job Description
Your opportunity
The After Sales Intern will be involved in post\\-sales support, with a strong focus on data analysis to improve processes, resolve customer issues, and optimize operations for a better customer experience. The ideal candidate has an analytical approach, attention to detail, and proficiency in analytical tools.
How you will contribute* Post\\-Sales Data Analysis: collect and analyze data related to post\\-sales performance (customer feedback, complaints, returns) and create reports and dashboards to identify trends and areas for improvement.
* After Sales Service Optimization: collaborate with the team to develop solutions for recurring issues reported by customers. Support the team in process improvements by proposing changes based on the analyzed data. Use predictive analytics techniques to anticipate potential issues and address them before they become critical.
* Post\\-Sales Operations Support: Handle post\\-sales support requests, ensuring they are resolved within the set timeframes. Interact with other departments (e.g., logistics, technical, IT, custmer services etc.) to resolve more complex issues.
* Reporting and Presentations: Prepare weekly and monthly reports on post\\-sales performance. Provide in\\-depth analysis and suggest improvements at the product or service level.
* Collaboration and Development: Support the team in the continuous improvement of post\\-sales processes. Participate in team meetings to share analysis, suggest solutions, and contribute to process growth.


Who you are:* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or related fields.
* Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis tools (proficiency in Microsoft Excel.)
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to work in a team and adapt to a dynamic environment.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to collaborate with team members and stakeholders.
* Proactive attitude with the ability to work well in a team\\-oriented environment.
* Excellent knowledge of Italian and English – both written and spoken; knowledge of any other foreign language is greatly appreciated


Why work with us?
This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of a dynamic team with an unconventional brand that offers possibilities to learn and grow. Talent development is a managerial principle at Dodo and we are committed to fostering internal mobility. Our common vision promotes leadership skills and helps every employee to reach their full potential in a stimulating and fulfilling workplace environment.

title: Internship Supply Demand Planning
description:
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.


Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

**Supply**
----------

Our supply chain is the backbone of our business. It's how we get our trusted products to people all over the world, safely and efficiently. And it's our talented and passionate teams that make this happen.  

  

If you're looking for a career in supply chain, there's no better place to be than Reckitt. We offer a variety of exciting opportunities in all areas of the supply chain, from planning and procurement to manufacturing and logistics. You could join our Global Supply Planning team to develop and implement our global supply strategy, or work with our Procurement Centre of Excellence team to negotiate and manage our supplier relationships.  

  

Our Manufacturing Excellence team help us improve the efficiency, quality and safety of our manufacturing operations, and our Logistics Excellence team develop new and innovative ways to distribute our products to customers.


**About the role**
------------------



Your role will be inside the Supply Planning Team. You’ll be responsible to support seamless operation within the supply chain – cooperating with several areas such as Demand Planning, Copacking, Customer Service and Logistic. You will take an active part into projects implementation: your ideas will be the base for setting up effective and efficient processes.


**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------


* Collaborate with Global Factories and Global Planning Team to reach targets of forecast accuracy, stock, SL
* Collaborate with the demand planning, customer service, copacking, distribution and warehousing teams in cross impact flows
* Collaborate with sales and trade marketing to find the best solution for our customers. (Being it Product availability, logistic constraints, or others)
* Monitor KPIs bringing knowledge on them for the whole team to support tactical/strategic decisions
* Propose innovative ideas to improve KPIs and processes leveraging on both own skills and learnings from other markets
* Support Demand Planning team and Copacking on insights/analysis for a better forecasting and production planning
**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------


* MSc Degree in Engineering/Economics
* Highly analytical
* Capable of gathering and processing complex data from a wide variety of sources
* Base knowledge of important supply chain processes/metrics/goals
* Fluent in Italian and English
* Nice to have: good knowledge of Ms Office (Excel, Word, Power Point)
**The skills for success**
--------------------------



Supply Chain Management, Collaboration and partnership building, Relationship Management, Business Acumen, Productivity management, Improve business processes, Data Analytics, Supply Chain Planning, Logistics Management.


**What we offer**

title: Junior Business Analyst
description:
Mavriq, parte di Moltiply Group, è la tech company a cui appartengono alcuni tra i più importanti brand di comparazione ed intermediazione online in Italia (MutuiOnline.it, Segugio.it, SOStariffe.it, Trovaprezzi.it, Switcho e molti altri) e all’estero (LeLynx.fr, Rastreator, Pricewise, Verivox). I servizi offerti dai brand di Mavriq aiutano con trasparenza i consumatori a trovare ciò di cui hanno bisogno, al miglior prezzo. Siamo un team di circa 1\\.000 “smart disruptors” distribuiti in Europa, America Latina ed Asia.  



  

Il successo di Mavriq è legato al successo dei nostri team. Per questo, siamo oggi alla ricerca di un nuovo o una nuova team member con cui continuare a scrivere la nostra storia nel mondo della comparazione ed intermediazione online a livello internazionale.  



  

**Posizione:**
--------------

**Il ruolo**


Per supportare la crescita dei brand **Trovaprezzi.it, Drezzy.it** e **Qualescegliere.it**, stiamo ampliando il nostro team di Marketing Analysis \\& Partnership e ricercando un/a **Junior Business Analyst** che analizzerà diverse fonti dati e produrrà output utili ad influenzare le decisioni strategiche e le attività di Marketing dei brand.

 **Location**


La tua sede di lavoro sarà sarà a Giussago, in provincia di Pavia. Lavoriamo in modalità **ibrida**: almeno 2 giorni in ufficio (tra palestra, mensa interna e colonnine per auto elettriche o metano) e fino a 3 giorni in smart working, con flessibilità in ingresso e in uscita. I due giorni in ufficio sono un momento per i nostri team di aggregazione e condivisione (di idee, pause pranzo, pause caffè, ecc.), e ci permettono di continuare ad alimentare la nostra Cultura Mavriq.

  

La sede non è servita da mezzi pubblici, quindi sarà necessario **essere in possesso di un proprio veicolo** (ma con il metano o l’elettrico, puoi rifornirti gratuitamente in sede).

 **Cosa farai**

* Estrarrai dati da diverse fonti, garantendo la qualità e la coerenza delle informazioni.
* Produrrai report periodici per monitorare le performance e identificare opportunità di miglioramento.
* Progetterai nuove analisi, quando emergono nuove esigenze o cambiamenti strategici.
* Svilupparai analisi personalizzate in risposta a richieste specifiche per ambiti che richiedono approfondimenti.
* Validarai i dati, nel momento in cui vengono introdotte nuove metodologie e/o basi di dati per le estrazioni.
* Collaborerai con altri team (Data Analysis, Data Engineering, Marketing ecc.) e fornitori per approfondire problematiche complesse o per richiedere nuove funzionalità utili alle analisi.
* Presenterai ed illustrare i risultati, sia internamente che esternamente al team.

**Requisiti:**
--------------

**Di cosa avrai bisogno per il ruolo**

* Breve esperienza pregressa in ambito digital, specialmente nell'analisi dei dati o una forte motivazione a costruire il tuo percorso in Business Analytics.
* Buona padronanza del pacchetto Office, con particolare attenzione a Excel.
* Buona padronanza della lingua inglese (B2\\-C1\\) e italiana (C1\\).
* Ragionamento quantitativo e approccio analitico e capacità di raccontare i dati e risultati in modo semplice.
* Capacità di lavorare per priorità rispettando le scadenze, con precisione e con orientamento agli obiettivi.
* Ottima capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborazione cross\\-team.

 **Nice to have (non è obbligatorio, ma può fare la differenza)**

* Conoscenza di Power Query.
* Familiarità con Power BI.

 **Cosa troverai da noi**

* Ambiente di lavoro dinamico e informale, flessibilità di orario, smartworking, formazione continua e partecipazione a eventi e conferenze;
* Sede spaziosa e sostenibile, immersa nel verde, dotata di mensa interna con chef, palestra aziendale, campi da tennis, basket e pallavolo;
* Rifornimento gratuito di gas metano e elettricità per gli autoveicoli dei dipendenti;
* Pacchetto di servizi welfare a sostegno di esigenze personali e familiari (assicurazione infortuni, contributo libri e asilo nido, Grest per i figli dei dipendenti, servizi di assistenza fiscale, partecipazione a iniziative CRAL, ...).

  

Non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti!

**Altre informazioni:**
-----------------------

Puoi scoprire di più su di noi a questo video. Leggere le nostre Recensioni su Indeed o Glassdoor. Familiarizzare con i nostri principi guida qui.

title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
At Quantcast, we're redefining what's possible in digital advertising. As a global Demand Side Platform (DSP) powered by AI, we help marketers connect with the right audiences and deliver measurable results across the Open Web. Our foundation is built on cutting\\-edge measurement and consumer analytics, giving our clients the tools they need to drive success in an ever\\-evolving digital landscape.  

Since our start in 2006, we've pioneered industry firsts—from launching the original measurement platform for digital publishers to introducing the first AI\\-driven DSP. If you're ready to be part of a dynamic, forward\\-thinking team that thrives on creating transformative solutions, Quantcast is the perfect place to grow your career.  

Quantcast is excited to be hiring a Senior Sales Manager in our Millan office.  

As a Senior Sales Manager, you will focus on educating and evangelizing Quantcast advertising products within key brands across Italy.
### **What you'll do:**

* + Develop, agree and be accountable for a sales strategy and business plan for some of the Italian’s top Brands in line with Quantcast's sales and profitability goals as set by the VP.
	+ Effectively present and evangelize Quantcast‘s capabilities and offering in the digital ad marketplace.
	+ Develop the sales pipeline and effectively account manage Quantcast's existing customers in Italy.
	+ Coordinate with other Quantcast faculties for the timely preparation of proposal presentations and RFP responses.
	+ Channel marketplace feedback regarding Quantcast products

### **Who you are:**

* + Must have a minimum of 5 years' sales experience.
	+ Strong direct relationships with Italian brands and independent media agencies.
	+ Proven track record in new business sales and closing deals.
	+ Ability to build relationships with decision makers around a solution/strategic sale.
	+ Demonstrate a high degree of media proficiency, effective presentation and communication skills and expertise in audience buying.
	+ Programmatic knowledge.
	+ Knowledge of, or experience in, performance \\& branding advertising.
	+ \\#LI\\-SK1

At Quantcast, we craft offers that reflect your unique skills, expertise, and geographic location. On top of a competitive salary, this position includes eligibility for a performance bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Depending on your location, this may include generous vacation, medical, dental, and vision coverage, and retirement plans. For more details, visit our Careers page and see how we support our team. Please see the Applicant Privacy Notice for details on our applicant privacy policy.  

  

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in San Francisco, we are a diverse, aligned community with offices across 10 countries worldwide. Join the team that unlocks potential.  

Quantcast is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are looking for an experienced Data Architect (Middle Office, Back Office). The ideal candidate will have hands\\-on experience in IT solution.
You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and optimizing IT solutions for post\\-trade securities processing while ensuring compliance with regulations
### **What you'll be doing**

* Design and implement solutions to meet specific business needs, working closely with clients to translate business requirements into technical specification and solution design
* Experience in design and architecture of complex data integration systems (batch and streaming)
* Experience in design and architecture of securities and investment platforms on their integration (batch and streaming) with upstream and downstream systems
* Propose solutions into systems qualities and repeatable design strategies and patterns, such as adaptability, scalability, availability, and reusability.
* Design and implement data processing pipelines (stream and batch)
* Build, architect, design and implement federated data processing and storage systems
* Use native cloud development framework for all data needs (Processing, Storage, Monitoring, Governance)

### **What you'll need to succeed**

Essential Skills
* Proficiency in designing and implementing hybrid data architectures (GCP and/or Azure \\& on\\-premises) ensuring seamless data migration and integration.
* Experience designing and implementing API\\-based integrations and real\\-time data streaming between systems
Required Skills
* Strong functional expertise in securities and investment domain, including settlement, trade processing, corporate actions, and reconciliation.
* Hands\\-on experience with Google Cloud data services, including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Spanner, Dataflow, Dataproc, and Pub/Sub.
* Expertise in designing and implementing data pipelines (ETL/ELT) for both batch (Apache Beam, Dataflow) and streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Spark Streaming) use cases.
Technical Skills
* Deep knowledge of data modeling (relational, NoSQL, graph), storage optimization, and partitioning strategies for high\\-performance analytics and processing.
* Strong proficiency in SQL and programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala for data engineering and automation.
Governance \\& Compliance
* Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance standards in financial services (e.g., GDPR, BCBS 239, MiFID II).

Additional Requirements:* Advanced level of English language (written and spoken – MUST)
* German Full working proficiency (written and spoken \\- NICE TO HAVE)
* Italian Full working proficiency (written and spoken \\- NICE TO HAVE)
* University degree

\\#UnlockYourPotential \\- People are our greatest asset, thanks to their diverse experiences, skills and perspectives. Die UniCredit ist eine paneuropäische Geschäftsbank mit einem einzigartigen Produkt\\- und Service\\-Angebot in Italien, Deutschland sowie Zentral\\- und Osteuropa. title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit and that can carry cargo \\- and potentially humans in the longer run.


We want you as a Technical Product Owner to help us in our mission through development of our in\\-house Model\\-Based System (MBSE) Engineering tool suite.


You will be at the forefront of European innovation \\- consolidating the needs of (don't be overwhelmed) hardware, software, ground \\& flight software, avionics, GNC, and multitude of other hard\\-core engineers \\- directing the tools they use to enable of our maiden flight.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


In your service role as a Technical Product Owner, day to day your duties will include:

* Collaboration \\& Communication:


	+ Act as the primary point of contact between hardware and software engineering resources, demonstrating clear understanding of user needs and pain points;
	+ Fast resolution of user issues with products
	+ Translate deep technical requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria.
	+ Challenge technical solutions proposed by teams to ensure alignment with product goals and feasibility.
* Product Ownership:


	+ Ability to prototype fast technical solutions in agile environment;
	+ Support Digital Department in defining and communicating the product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
	+ Ensure features and technical initiatives are aligned with engineering needs and long\\-term product vision;
* Technical Aspects:


	+ Develop a deep understanding of what type of tools does it take to fly a spacecraft.
	+ Discuss technical details with engineering teams to make informed decisions.
	+ Evaluate technical challenges and provide input on their impact on the product.
* Fast paced agility:


	+ Ability to change context and roles to adapt to changing needs, while protecting the integrity of the product \\& process.

**What we would love to see from you**
--------------------------------------


In the role of Technical Product Owner ideally, you will have the following:

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven experience as a Technical Product Owner or in a similar role in a technical environment.
* Experience working with backend systems or APIs is a strong advantage.
* Strong proficiency with Python \\+ any other general purpose programming language
* Ability to work under high pressure
* Experience with Agile (Scrum) methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
* Familiarity with data analysis and BI tools (e.g., Metabase, Tableau, SQL, Google Analytics, Matomo, DataDog etc.)
* Fluency with command\\-line tools, as well as strong proficiency with Python \\+ any other


A plus would be:

* Experience working in the aerospace / automotive industry
* Experience with Model\\-Based System Engineering Concepts and Tools

**Why you should join us!**


What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:

* We’re Agile \\- we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind
* We’re Open and Collaborative \\- we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them
* We have a lot of Fun \\- we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?


We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.  

  

*The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.*

title: CEO/Managing Director (D2C product)
description:
**About us**
============


Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer\\-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about\\-us/

**About the role**
==================


We are creating a new D2C product in the Utilities category and we are looking for a Managing Director that can take care of day to day operations, execution and building a world class team.

**Profit Share**
================


This role comes with the profit share incentive and stock option that is quite generous for this role, more details would be shared at the interview.

**The team**
============


You will be building a strong team with high talent density who enjoy working in our fast\\-paced, 100% remote environment.

**About you**
=============


You are a dynamic and hands\\-on leader with extensive experience in the D2C Digital Products (preferably subscriptions). You excel at driving growth and innovation, with a deep understanding of engineering, product, marketing, and growth strategies. In this role, you will be at the forefront, leading all departments with a focus on executing strategic initiatives and optimizing performance across the board. Your proven ability to manage teams, deliver results under pressure, and deeply engage in the technical and operational aspects of the business makes you the ideal candidate to steer our company towards continued success.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Lead the company's strategic growth by developing and executing initiatives that drive business expansion, optimize market positioning, and advance overall progress.
* Lead cross\\-functional teams in executing complex strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment across engineering, product development, growth, marketing, and sales.
* Drive revenue growth and profitability while optimizing operational expenses.
* Oversee the product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring products meet market needs and quality standards.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions that align with customer expectations and business goals.
* Ensure that the product roadmap is aligned with business strategy and customer feedback.
* Oversee marketing campaigns, ensuring they are data\\-driven, customer\\-centric, and aligned with product launches and sales strategies.
* Utilize data analytics to refine and optimize growth strategies, ensuring sustainable revenue growth.
* Continuously monitor and analyze key financial and operational metrics, such as revenue growth, EBITDA margins, and customer acquisition costs (CAC).
* Evaluate customer lifetime value (LTV) and return on ad spend (ROAS) to optimize marketing efficiency and resource allocation.
* Track onboarding conversion rates to identify areas for improvement in user experience and increase customer activation and analyze average revenue per user (ARPU) and user retention rates to inform product development and enhance long\\-term profitability.

**What we offer**
=================

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom of working from anywhere, anytime, fostering a better work\\-life balance.
* **Stock options:** We acknowledge the commitment required for the CEO/Managing Director role. Hence, we offer generous company stock options and revenue sharing to appreciate and reward your hard work.
* **Company\\-provided MacBook:** We offer employees access to powerful MacBooks if needed, ensuring top\\-notch performance, energy efficiency, and seamless productivity.

**Location**
============


Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Interview Process**
=====================


After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Final Interview (60 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================


At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we're a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe.


We are an equal\\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that a diversity of thought and backgrounds builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, place of birth, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service status, or disability status. Join us and be part of a company that is crafting the future of technology across multiple industries.


\\#Li\\-Remote

title: CEO/Managing Director (D2C product)
description:
**About us**
============


Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer\\-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about\\-us/

**About the role**
==================


We are creating a new D2C product in the Utilities category and we are looking for a Managing Director that can take care of day to day operations, execution and building a world class team.

**Profit Share**
================


This role comes with the profit share incentive and stock option that is quite generous for this role, more details would be shared at the interview.

**The team**
============


You will be building a strong team with high talent density who enjoy working in our fast\\-paced, 100% remote environment.

**About you**
=============


You are a dynamic and hands\\-on leader with extensive experience in the D2C Digital Products (preferably subscriptions). You excel at driving growth and innovation, with a deep understanding of engineering, product, marketing, and growth strategies. In this role, you will be at the forefront, leading all departments with a focus on executing strategic initiatives and optimizing performance across the board. Your proven ability to manage teams, deliver results under pressure, and deeply engage in the technical and operational aspects of the business makes you the ideal candidate to steer our company towards continued success.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Lead the company's strategic growth by developing and executing initiatives that drive business expansion, optimize market positioning, and advance overall progress.
* Lead cross\\-functional teams in executing complex strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment across engineering, product development, growth, marketing, and sales.
* Drive revenue growth and profitability while optimizing operational expenses.
* Oversee the product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring products meet market needs and quality standards.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions that align with customer expectations and business goals.
* Ensure that the product roadmap is aligned with business strategy and customer feedback.
* Oversee marketing campaigns, ensuring they are data\\-driven, customer\\-centric, and aligned with product launches and sales strategies.
* Utilize data analytics to refine and optimize growth strategies, ensuring sustainable revenue growth.
* Continuously monitor and analyze key financial and operational metrics, such as revenue growth, EBITDA margins, and customer acquisition costs (CAC).
* Evaluate customer lifetime value (LTV) and return on ad spend (ROAS) to optimize marketing efficiency and resource allocation.
* Track onboarding conversion rates to identify areas for improvement in user experience and increase customer activation and analyze average revenue per user (ARPU) and user retention rates to inform product development and enhance long\\-term profitability.

**What we offer**
=================

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom of working from anywhere, anytime, fostering a better work\\-life balance.
* **Stock options:** We acknowledge the commitment required for the CEO/Managing Director role. Hence, we offer generous company stock options and revenue sharing to appreciate and reward your hard work.
* **Company\\-provided MacBook:** We offer employees access to powerful MacBooks if needed, ensuring top\\-notch performance, energy efficiency, and seamless productivity.

**Location**
============


Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Interview Process**
=====================


After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Final Interview (60 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================


At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we're a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe.


We are an equal\\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that a diversity of thought and backgrounds builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, place of birth, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service status, or disability status. Join us and be part of a company that is crafting the future of technology across multiple industries.
