title: Marketing Data & CDP Manager
description:
**About us:**


At **Outliant,** we're a fully remote, US\\-based digital product development and consulting company. Our diverse team combines exceptional skills to create seamless digital products, fostering growth, creativity, and innovative thinking.


We're helping Willow is a telemedicine company focused on personalized, clinically proven weight loss treatments utilizing GLP\\-1 medications.


Their mission is to make high\\-quality healthcare accessible and convenient for individuals seeking transformative solutions for their health and wellness. Through virtual consultations, comprehensive care, and ongoing support, we empower our patients to achieve sustainable, long\\-term success.


They’re a fully remote team of healthcare professionals, technologists, and innovators dedicated to improving lives through seamless telemedicine experiences.

***Outliant will be actively involved in the interview process, ensuring that the best talent is selected. The chosen candidate will be directly employed by the Willow team.***

**About the Role**  

This role will own and manage Willow’s customer data platform (CDP), tracking infrastructure, and marketing analytics tooling. You’ll ensure accurate, privacy\\-compliant data collection across platforms and work cross\\-functionally with marketing, product, engineering, and data teams to support growth, measurement, and reporting needs.

**Responsibilities**  

* Own and expand the tracking lexicon/event schema across all platforms (web, backend, marketing tools, etc.)
* Ensure accurate data collection and attribution across tools like Segment, GTM, Google Analytics, and ad platforms
* Manage integrations between the CDP (Segment) and marketing/destination tools (Meta Ads, Google Ads, etc.)
* Oversee tracking compliance including cookie management, consent banners, and data privacy best practices
* Collaborate with product and engineering to implement new tracking events and user\\-level data
* Generate self\\-serve reports and dashboards in Mixpanel, and support growth/marketing analytics
* Query and maintain reporting pipelines from Snowflake and other data warehouse sources
* Set up and optimize experiments using platforms like Optimizely
* Support performance marketing team with attribution modeling and insights
**Requirements**  

* 3–5\\+ years in a data\\-focused role, ideally with exposure to marketing tech, growth, or analytics engineering
* Hands\\-on experience with the following tools:
* Segment (or similar CDPs)
* Snowflake (or comparable data warehouses)
* Facebook Ads Manager \\+ Google Ads
* Google Tag Manager
* Google Analytics (GA4\\)
* Mixpanel
* Optimizely
* Strong SQL skills and comfort querying large datasets
* Working knowledge of cookie behavior, consent management, and compliance (GDPR/CCPA)
* Experience managing event tracking implementation end\\-to\\-end, from planning to QA
* Excellent attention to detail, documentation, and cross\\-team communication
**Nice to Have**  

* Familiarity with tools like RudderStack, BigQuery, dbt, or Amplitude
* Experience supporting DTC, subscription, or telehealth businesses
* Exposure to reverse ETL tools like Hightouch or Census
**What’s in it for you?**


As a full\\-time member of our team, you’ll enjoy:

* Flexible hours, work wherever you choose
* Unlimited PTO
* Non\\-working holidays per country of residence
* Salary increases and performance\\-based bonuses
* Fun and casual work environment
* We are a diverse, global team!

**Important Notice**


To ensure the legitimacy of job opportunities, we strongly recommend that you solely rely on positions posted here on our official website: **outliant.com/careers**.


All our current job openings require video interviews conducted in either or both synchronous (via Google Meet) and asynchronous (via Willo) formats. Kindly refrain from accepting offers that appear suspicious. For any inquiries or concerns, feel free to reach out to us via email at **recruitment@outliant.com**.


Please be assured that we are fully committed to maintaining integrity in our hiring process.

title: Industrial Operations Finance Partner | Ravenna
description:
**Location** : Ravenna

**City** : Ravenna \\- Porto Corsini

**State** : Ravenna (IT\\-RA)

**Country** : Italy (IT)

**Requisition Number** : 38916

 **BUNGE** has an exciting opportunity available for a **FP\\&A Analyst, Industrial Operations Finance Partner**. In this role, you will be the **main supporter for the Plant Manager from financial perspective**, identifying and driving improvements in the plants, making sure targets for costs, important metrics and CAPEX budget are reached. Also providing accurate data in time, mainly for consolidation systems, and ensure compliance is important.

 *“Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.”*

 ***Note:*** *you are ideally located in Ravenna \\- Italy to obtain this job.*

 **More on the FP\\&A Analyst, Industrial Operations Finance Partner:**

  

The FP\\&A Analyst, Industrial Operations Finance Partner will collaborate regionally, working closely with industrial leaders in our Bunge plant located in Porto Corsini and maintain a good partnership with our colleagues from commercial, finance and operations teams to understand business challenges and needs. We encourage to challenge the status quo, provide insights and improvements which will benefit the organization and provides you opportunities to grow.

 **Main Accountabilities:**

  

* Work together (“be a partner”) with plant manager and key plant stakeholders to detect potential cost deviation, mitigation plans or saving opportunities, plus follow up on their execution and results.
* Ensure correct financial accounting reporting of industrial expenses monthly. Prepare accrual of variable cost to be booked by GL team. Build monthly forecast of plant industrial cost. Production of a monthly package with the analysis of actual expenses versus forecast and Business Plan (BP). Ensure forecast accuracy.
* Lead the preparation of yearly Business Plan (BP) of plant industrial expenses (Variable, Fixed and Depreciation). Preparation of monthly reports as well as ad hoc analysis to support plant manager, Industrial Director and FP\\&A team.
* Drive the preparation of new initiatives (minor and major projects) and post implementation reviews. Support Business Finance Partners in identifying and validating projects resulting in added profit and/or cost savings based on insights from KPI and benchmarking exercises. Ensure proper OPEX vs CAPEX classification.
* Monthly submission of proper PQSE KPI reporting. Ensure compliance with internal reporting guidelines and support external reporting (US\\-GAAP). Management, control and documentation of inventory counts (commodities and spare parts).
* Work with other plant Industrial Finance Partners to standardize processes amongst the market and value chain. Support automatization, process rebuilding and process/software projects (Tableau, SAP). Participate on regional and global initiatives bringing value added to the finance community.

 **We are looking for different skills in our ideal candidate:**

  

* A degree in Finance, Management or Business.
* \\+/\\- 5 years of experience in a similar role.
* Ease of learning SAP, Tableau, One Stream, PQSE and Genius tools.
* Fluency in both English and Italian are required.
* Ability to analyze large and complex data and extract simple actionable insights.
* Knowledgeable about international company procedures and compliance issues, having a global view of the business.
* Good communication skills.

  

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work, they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers.

  

If this description reflects your profile or ambition, we’re looking forward to seeing your application and motivation in English by hitting apply!

  

In case of questions, please reach out to Aitor Alonso (Talent Acquisition Specialist at aitor.alonso@bunge.com).

 *Acquisition by agencies is not appreciated, we do not use agencies at this moment for our recruitment. Open proposals of candidates are at own risk.*


\\#LI\\-AA3

 **We Are Bunge**

  

Bunge is a global agribusiness with one mission – we connect farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed and fuel to the world. We have unmatched global scale and deeply rooted relationships which allow us to bring innovative ingredients and knowledge to some of the world’s biggest brands – many of which are likely in your home right now.

  

We know that to achieve our mission and deliver the best results to our customers, each other and the world we need to work ***together*** – so we hire talented people who are **passionate**, **bold** and **driven** to work as One Bunge. This dedication is deeply embedded in our culture and reflected in the way we work.

  

Every day our people exemplify these values, which represent Bunge at its core:

 **Act as One Team**

*by fostering inclusion,*  

*collaboration and respect*

 **Drive for Excellence**

*by being agile*  

*innovative and efficient*

 **Do What’s Right**

*by acting safely, ethically*  

*and sustainably*

  

If this sounds like you, **join us**! We value and invest in people who believe in our purpose and are excited to live it every day – people who are **\\#ProudtoBeBunge**.

 *Bunge is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, national origin, citizenship, age, disability or military or veteran status, or any other legally protected status.*

title: DATA Architect - pre sales services
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.  



  

**The Role**

Join our dynamic team as a Customer Technology Advisor and become an integral part of our cutting\\-edge Go\\-To\\-Market team. As a certified expert in your field, you will be at the forefront of revolutionizing technology solutions for our valued customers. Working hand in hand with our Kyndryl Consult Partners and customer partners, you will leverage your technical and solution expertise to drive targeted opportunities and exceed customer expectations.
  

  

In this role, you won't just be another advisor; you will be a trusted ally and visionary, delivering unique and differentiated value to our customers. Through captivating show\\-and\\-tell methods such as engaging demos and compelling presentations, you will showcase our credibility and eminence in the industry, leaving a lasting impression on potential customers.
  

  

As a vital member of our team, you will support Consulting, Advisory, and Architecture activities across Sales, Pre\\-Sales \\& Delivery, collaborating closely with Customer Partners and Kyndryl Consult Partners. With your extensive technical knowledge and mastery of the practice\\-specific domain, you will bring together the breadth of Kyndryl's expertise to develop profitable deals that drive our success.
  

  

Your dedication to continuous improvement and your passion for our practice will shine through as you showcase your end\\-to\\-end knowledge of the domain you align with, as well as the associated subdomains. Your technical prowess, backed by your external certifications, will establish you as a true authority in your field.
  

  

As a Customer Technology Advisor, you will possess strong technical and business acumen, allowing you to provide value driven solutions within the practice services domain(s). Your exceptional customer facing skills, combined with your articulate communication style and interpersonal finesse, will enable you to effortlessly convey the technical benefits of Kyndryl's capabilities, perfectly matching the unique needs of each customer.
  

  

As a strategic thinker, you will identify the intricate business and technical requirements of our customers, leveraging the vast capabilities of Kyndryl to generate winning cross\\-practice solutions. Your ability to develop and deliver compelling demonstrations, proof of concepts, and prototypes will clearly demonstrate the tangible value our offerings bring to our customers, leaving them eager to partner with us.
  

  

In addition to your technical expertise, you will also take the lead in coordinating the entire pre\\-sales process, ensuring quality and compliance verification while adhering to Kyndryl best practices. Your collaboration with internal and external stakeholders will generate winning responses and create optimal technical solutions. Moreover, you will actively build and nurture relationships with our external alliance partners, fostering a collaborative environment where joint solutions are co\\-created.
  

  

Join our team of forward thinking, tech\\-savvy professionals and embark on a journey of innovation, growth, and fulfillment. As a Customer Technology Advisor, you will not only shape the future of technology solutions but also make a meaningful impact on the success of our customers and Kyndryl as a whole.
  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

Required Skills and Experience


* At least 3 years of experience in designing and implementing solutions, services and operating models, preferably on Cloud Computing technologies, with a focus on Data Solutions and Data Platforms
* Concrete experience (hands on) in designing and delivering solutions for large\\-scale data platforms using relevant approaches (Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Cloud Scale Analytics, etc.), which fully meet customer needs
* Ability to map business processes, aimed at analyzing and creating data solutions in the Public Cloud Hyperscaler environment
* Identify and design architectural solutions with key elements such as performance, security and reliability
* Good knowledge in deploying Infrastructure as a Code
* Deep knowledge of Cloud architectures and Data components such as: Data Factory, Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Fabric, Mongo DB, CosmosDB, SQL DWH/Synapse/SQL Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
* Knowledge of platforms and cloud providers such as: Amazon Web Services (EMR, S3, Redshift, Glue, MSK, Lambda), Cloudera Data Platform (Data Hub, Data Flow, SDX, Data Catalog)
* Database knowledge: NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, HBase), Relational (Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL), Data Warehousing (Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Snowflake)

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Conoscenza linguaggi di programmazione: Scala, Python, PySpark Java, SQL, nonchè conoscenza di strumenti di versionamento: Git, CodeCommit
* Conoscenza framework e strumenti di Big Data: Apache Hadoop (HDFS, MapReduce, YARN), Kafka, Flink, Hive, Icesberg, Hbase, ecc
* Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree
* 5 years of experience (minimum) selling technical services for multi\\-industry customers

  

**Being You**

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

With state\\-of\\-the\\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Technology Expert - Workstation Services
description:
**Position Snapshot**

* Headquarter of Nestlé in Milan, Italy;
* Nestlé welcomes people with disabilities;
* Permanent contract;
* Full\\-time in the Milan HQ with flexibility to work remotely (hybrid mode);
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience;
* 5\\+ years experience in IT solution disciplines including modern device management, end user experience \\& proactive device management, enterprise browser policy configuration and agile project management;
* Effective English communication.

 **Position Summary**  

Are you a talented Technology Expert ready to join our Workforce 360 Devices team?


We are a diverse and heterogeneous team of people coming from different countries across the world, each one with a unique experience around people, technology, business and processes.


We are part of Nestlé Global IT HUB in Milano (Italy), a cross\\-technology team that includes more than 130 professionals and span across more than 20 different nationalities.  

We need your passion and skills around Modern Management \\& End User Experience Management to guide and promote usage of innovative technologies in Nestlé, helping us to deliver our purpose: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come.  

As Technology Expert for Workstation Services your focus will be around the building modern and scalable management solutions based on Microsoft Intune \\& End User Experience Management solutions, enabling proactive management of the clients, leveraging new and innovative technologies coming in this space.  

You will be part of a team with other Technology Experts and Technical Leads and will report to the Senior Product Manager for your area.

 **A Day in the Life of… a Technology Expert Workstation Services**

* Provide specialist consultancy, guidance and support in the technical areas of expertise.
* Supports operations both with technical depth and user empathy and provide recommendations on how to improve efficiency and service delivery.
* Liaise closely with Product Managers, Tech Leads, other Technical Experts and Solution Architects in defining significant functional, technical and process integration decisions.
* Assist in designing the governance models for our Suppliers and Partners and the alignment of our tools and solutions with Nestlé architecture and security frameworks.
* Supports the agile approach of the team, prioritizing activities and projects and always focusing on the end\\-to\\-end experience of our users.
* Partner with other Technical Experts to share knowledge inside the team and support technical and personal growth.
* Collaborate with other relevant Nestlé Teams and Businesses to build together a shared vision around devices and services to bring tangible benefits to Nestlé users.
* Understand technology trends and the practical application of existing and emerging technologies for enabling new and modern operating models.

  

  

**What else will make you successful?**

* 5\\+ years of experience in IS/IT, preferably delivering projects in complex\\\\multinational environments with dependencies across multiple teams.
* Experience in onboarding, managing and updating Windows clients, including application deployment with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM) in co\\-management.
* Deep level understanding in Microsoft Intune about management of different ecosystem of devices.
* Experience in integrating proactive device monitoring (e.g Microsoft Endpoint Analytics, Experience Score) and industry leading end\\-user experience monitoring solutions (e.g. Lakeside Systrack, Nexthink, 1E Tachyon).
* Hands\\-on experience for managing the different configuration and policy items meant for device portfolios and landscapes.
* Experience in managing modern browsers at enterprise level (e.g. Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome).
* Good understanding and working knowledge with the Azure modules and Automations which can be incorporated on Microsoft Intune like through graph APIs.
* Experience in moving from GPOs to cloud policies in Microsoft Intune for securing Windows devices.
* Experience with certificate deployment in enterprise environments, advanced knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Microsoft Graph API is a plus.
* Experience in designing and implementing modern device provisioning at scale with Windows Autopilot in hybrid environments is a plus.
* Strong understanding of Agile/DevOps methods and processes with proven ability to take part in Agile project teams by providing advice and guidance on opportunities, impacts and risks.
* Able to balance excellent analytical skills, deep technical knowledge with strong listening capabilities.
* Experience interacting with advisory councils, industry user groups, and key technology Partners and Vendors.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, system analysis or related study, or equivalent experience.
* Experience with effective communication in English at any different level of the organization.

 *Only cvs submitted in English will be considered.*

title: Global Procurement Manager – Inerts
description:
The Global Procurement Manager for Inerts will oversee a portfolio of raw materials across all Gowan manufacturing and tolling facilities worldwide. This role demands strong collaboration and leadership with regional buyers, who will be directly responsible for executing supply agreements and commercial terms. The position requires excellent negotiation skills, strategic supplier development, and the ability to establish a robust resiliency platform to mitigate supply chain and regulatory risks. Additionally, the role focuses on achieving cost\\-saving targets while ensuring the timely delivery of high\\-quality, compliant products.  

This position reports to: Global Head of Procurement
### **Role Responsibilities:**

* + Source and evaluate new suppliers for inert portfolio.
	+ Develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, monitor their performance to ensure on\\-time delivery and adherence to quality standards, and obtain competitive benchmarking on pricing and market trends.
	+ Develop and implement procurement strategies for inerts at a global level, moving from regional to global approach to evaluate synergies and local efficiencies for cost savings.
	+ Lead supplier negotiations, contract management, and introduce competitive bidding for commoditized inerts.
	+ Monitor market trends and pricing fluctuations to optimize procurement costs and support cost\\-saving initiatives.
	+ Introduce multiple sources for critical inerts to reduce costs and mitigate risks (supply, regulatory).
	+ Collaborate with internal stakeholders across multiple functions and regions to ensure strategies are executed and supply agreements are followed.
	+ Ensure materials meet the required quality standards by providing detailed specifications to suppliers and relay customer feedback for quality improvements.
	+ Prepare and present regular reports on procurement activities, supplier performance, and cost savings, utilizing data and analytics for informed decision\\-making.

### **Education:**

* + Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Chemistry, Business Administration, or a related field.

### **Experience / Skills / Abilities:**

* + Minimum of \\>5 years of experience in global procurement role, specifically in chemical raw material procurement, ideally in Agchem or Crop Protection Industry
	+ Experience purchasing globally, ideally with experience in Europe and N. America.
	+ Strong negotiation and contract management skills.
	+ Strong analytical and problem\\-solving skills.
	+ Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
	+ Demonstrated ability to work cross\\-functionally across time zones, in a fast\\-paced changing environment.
	+ Willing to challenge the status quo, results orientated and can work independently to hit targets

### **Job Expectations / Working Conditions:**

* + International travel will be needed, at least once a quarter US/Europe
	+ One primary requirement is working in the office five days a week

title: Retail Sales Associate - Cooking and Eating
description:
* **Job ID:** 286935
* **Date posted:** 15/04/2025
**Who you are**  

At IKEA, we believe in the power of the many. Our People \\& Culture team works every day to bring the right people on board, people who share our values and bring our culture of togetherness to life. We're looking for a Workforce Analyst who’s ready to dive into data, support our co\\-workers, and help make our store an even better place to work.  

  

If you recognize yourself in most of the points below, we might be a great match:  

  
* + You have previous experience in Workforce analysis or planning.
	+ You have a background in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or Data Analytics and a strong interest in data and people.
	+ You enjoy building good relationships and know how to adapt your communication to different people.
	+ Excel is your playground you're confident in analyzing numbers and turning them into insights. PowerBi is a plus.
	+ You’re curious, open to change, and ready to find better ways of doing things.
	+ You like taking initiative and working independently , but you’re also a true team player.
	+ You approach tasks from different angles, and you're not afraid to ask "what if?"
	+ You speak both Italian and English fluently.
**A day in your life with us**  

In this role, you’ll be part of the store’s People \\& Culture team, and you’ll support in making sure that our co\\-workers are in the right place, at the right time, to meet our customers in the best way. Here's what your day might look like:  

  
* + Turn staff planning principles into action by building schedules that make sense for both people and the business.
	+ Analyze workforce data, produce related reports, and provide new solutions based on the insights gathered
	+ Work closely with leaders to make sure our planning follows IKEA standards, local labor laws and union agreements.
	+ Support in the full staff planning cycle, from forecasting to publishing schedules, ensuring everything runs smoothly.
	+ Highlight potential improvements and flag deviations to the Unit P\\&C Manager when needed.
	+ Help ensure planning supports talent development and creates the conditions for a great co\\-worker and customer experience.
	+ Team up with recruiters and P\\&C colleagues to ensure new joiners get the right contract setup from day one.
  

WE CARE FOR PEOPLE
  

It takes the diversity of thought, background, and culture to make a great idea a reality. We welcome candidates from all walks of life to join us, where we feel valued for our uniqueness and recognized for our diverse talents.  

  

WORKING WITH US HAS ITS REWARDS  

  

  

  

Being part of the IKEA team has many benefits. You’ll be part of an inclusive culture, driven by values and your growth will be guided by structured HR processes.
  

  

As part of the team you’ll have access to:  

  

  

  
* + Structured HR processes to support you in your growth (onboarding, training, coaching sessions, internal recruitment opportunities, etc)
	+ Wellbeing Offering, including an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) that provides you with immediate and confidential support for any concerns related to your daily life
	+ Healthy and affordable food: you will have access to a corporate canteen and will be able to enjoy a complete meal for just over 1€
	+ Employee discount: 15% on the purchase of IKEA products for personal use
	+ IKEA Vouchers for the most important moments in your life (marriage, cohabitation, birth or adoption of a child)
	+ Corporate discounts: you’ll have access to portal dedicated to our co\\-workers to enjoy discounts for different activities such as travel, leisure, technology and more
	+ Bonuses: we believe that everyone's contribution is needed to achieve (and exceed!) our goals. Every year all the co\\-workers can be rewarded for how we develop our business together

title: Architecture Advisor EMEA - Business AI
description:
**We help the world run better**

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose\\-driven and future\\-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choose from.

**This position can be covered in all EMEA Countries**

 **What you'll do:**


The Customer Advisory Architecture Advisor (AA) works closely with SAP’s Sales, Service organization and the Partner ecosystem to define the account strategy. AAs are responsible for bridging the gap between the customer’s business strategy and relevant solutions through crafting the to\\-be business and solution architectures and designing a transformation roadmap at the enterprise level to facilitate the customer’s adoption of Cloud\\-based AI driven architectures. They are trusted advisors for the customer to achieve their desired to\\-be SAP\\-based Enterprise Architecture.


In these capacities and to support the current SAP strategy the role will pose special focus on the positioning of the Artificial Intelligence (SAP Business AI).

  

As an Architecture Advisor (AA), you will focus on the following key areas:

 **Account Planning \\& Architecture Management Responsibilities**

* Support the assessment of current customer solutions from SAP and potential areas of opportunity for faster solution adoption \\& consumption, as well as footprint expansion.
* Engage with customers to support sales cycles throughout the Customer Value Journey as an integral member of the SAP account team.
* Drive business and IT architecture definitions to ensure consistency, cooperation, and alignment with SAP organizations, the customer, and partners.
* Define AI\\-enabled cloud architecture to position the value of SAP toward our customers and to support the transformation and optimization of business processes within SAP environments.
* Provide a linkage from the customer to SAP product development leadership.
* Support building customer demand through appropriate thought leadership positioning.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into scalable AI\\-driven SAP solutions.

 **Creating an SAP Architecture Vision for the Customer focusing on innovation and AI**

* Understand customer’s business process map and business model with industry reference architecture focus.
* Understand customer’s current enterprise landscape and future needs.
* Drive the positioning of standard cloud architectures (plug \\& play) leveraging standard cloud solutions.
* Leverage AI/ML models to enhance predictive analytics, decision\\-making, and operational efficiencies within SAP applications.
* Architect and design AI solutions that integrate with SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, SAP AI Core, and other SAP technologies.

  

* Position the value SAP Business Data Cloud to enable the use of data and the data pipelines to enhance AI capabilities
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to grow on SAP and Customers teams the knowledge on SAP Business AI best practices.
* Stay updated on AI advancements, SAP innovations, and emerging trends in enterprise technology.

 **Building Key Customer Architecture Deliverables: Business \\& Solution Architecture, Target State, Transformation Roadmap**

* Drive business architecture and capability mapping to solution design.
* Ensure IT feasibility of the business capabilities mapping to SAP solution architecture.
* Support customer cloud and AI transformation roadmap definition (business and application focus).
* Drive customer cloud/hybrid transformation roadmap definition (standard cloud application and technology focus).

 **Being a Trusted Architecture Advisor for the Customer**

* Align living roadmap with current adoption/solution consumption.
* Support living roadmap governance \\& adaptation based on evolution of customer needs and SAP solutions.
* Drive solution expansion by highlighting value \\& linkages to the broader SAP Portfolio

 **What you bring:**

* 6\\+ yrs of experience with software/IT organizations as an IT Architecture or Enterprise Architecture Advisor and/or specific expertise with software solutions through Solution Management, Sales, Presales, Adoption/Consumption, Consulting or Business Development, demonstrating successful outcomes over multiple years.
* Represent SAP as the trusted advisor within SAP and/or the market.
* Deep knowledge of Cloud, Hosted Services, SaaS/ PaaS models and AI model.
* Proven professional networks in the market to drive pipeline and revenue growth for SAP.
* Expertise in AI/ML frameworks and cloud AI services (SAP Business AI but also AWS, Azure AI, Google AI).
* Proven track record of success in the selected industry area, if required.
* Proven leadership and project management experience.
* Proven experience of driving tangible outcomes in Enterprise Architecture for customers.
* Fluency in English; any other language is an asset.
* Fluency in the language of local markets is desirable.
* Education: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) required, MBA or equivalent degree required from accredited university preferred.
* TOGAF or SAPIEA\\-10 certifications and Experience in using EAM tools is a an added value for candidates

 **Meet your team:**


At the core of our mission, the Architecture Advisor team is dedicated to guiding our customers through their cloud and AI business transformation journey. Our experts work collaboratively to deliver tailored, consistent value to every customer, ensuring they achieve the best results from their cloud investments.


We are passionate about enhancing the end\\-to\\-end customer experience. By focusing on improving the adoption and consumption of SAP’s products and services, we help customers unlock the full potential of their technology solutions.


What sets our team apart is our deep understanding of each customer’s unique industry landscape. By speaking our customers' language, we build stronger foundations of trust and credibility. This allows us to engage with them in more meaningful ways, addressing industry\\-specific needs, challenges, and opportunities. The better we understand our customers, the easier it becomes to foster lasting relationships that drive real business transformation.


Whether helping customers overcome obstacles or identifying new growth avenues, the Architecture Advisor team is committed to delivering value every step of the way.


**Bring out your best**


SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\\-to\\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\\-driven and future\\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

**We win with inclusion**


SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better and more equitable world.  

SAP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\\-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com  

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

**EOE AA M/F/Vet/Disability:**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.  

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

title: Solution Advisor - Supply Chain Management
description:
**We help the world run better**

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose\\-driven and future\\-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choose from.

**What you'll do**:


As the Solution Advisor (SA), you will be the go\\-to person for any solution or product questions within the sales team. You will leverage your deep expertise in specific solutions to support the entire sales cycle, from identifying opportunities to post\\-sale customer support. Additionally, you will assist customers in expanding their current SAP footprint to maximize value for their organization.

* Provide deep solution\\-specific expertise to support new sales and adoption for key customers
* Provide both standard and customized/personalized solution demonstrations that bring SAP solutions to life and show customers the value of SAP.
* Support the Account Team by delivering solution presentations and events to identify and qualify new opportunities and drive adoption and consumption of SAP solutions
* Evaluate account qualification criteria to determine further investment in pursuing opportunities
* Establish yourself as a thought leader within the account team and fine\\-tune account strategy
* Collaborate with the team in creating overall themes and competitive differentiation
* Conduct vigorous dry runs on strategic deals and customer engagements
* Transition engagement to implementation partner/ Services teams effectively
* Engage with customers to continue selling the vision of SAP solutions and ensure eagerness for renewal
* Leverage digital assets throughout the customer engagement, including demos, presentations, and other content

 **What you bring:**

* Professional experience with large software/IT organizations, preferably in a solution\\-specific segment
* Asset management/Maintenance Processes knowledge
* SAP product experience (or equivalent) and/or 3\\-5 years of relevant solutions/Lines of Business experience
* Working knowledge of Cloud, Hosted Services, and Software as a Service/Platform as a Service models in the Business\\-to\\-Business Environment
* Viewed as a solutions/Lines of Business/Industry expert across SAP with a track record of success
* Focus on creating compelling storylines and themes for customer interactions
* Ability to quickly understand customer business goals and ensure they are at the center of recommended solutions
* Passion and energy in all customer interactions
* Mechanical Engineer background would be a preferred skill

 **Meet your team:**

* Customer Advocate: Collaborate to complement solution expertise and support customers
* Global Digital Content Factory: Leverage digital assets created by the team throughout customer engagement
* Implementation Partner/Customer Services \\& Delivery: Efficiently transition customer engagement for successful deployment and realization of solution value
* SAP Account Teams: Share best practices and collaborate on providing solutions and services support across the entire customer journey.

  

**Bring out your best**


SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\\-to\\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\\-driven and future\\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

**We win with inclusion**


SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better and more equitable world.  

SAP is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\\-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com  

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

**EOE AA M/F/Vet/Disability:**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.  

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

title: Talent & Culture Senior Manager
description:
Cerved è la Tech Company che aiuta imprese e istituzioni a proteggersi dal rischio e a crescere in maniera sostenibile.
Siamo leader nell'ambito dei prodotti e servizi integrati di Risk, Sales e Marketing Intelligence, Credit Management. Con Cerved Rating Agency siamo specializzati nella valutazione del merito di credito di imprese non finanziarie e registrati quale agenzia di rating europea.
Dal 2021, Cerved è entrata in ION Group, uno dei più grandi operatori FinTech sul mercato a livello internazionale in cui lavorano oltre 13 mila persone, con 60 sedi internazionali e oltre 4800 clienti in tutto il mondo: insieme realizziamo soluzioni integrate per aiutare le imprese a prendere decisioni efficaci, semplificando i processi e mettendo al centro le persone.
Il/La Talent \\& Culture Senior Manager guida la strategia aziendale per la gestione del talento e lo sviluppo organizzativo.
Riporta al CHRO di gruppo ed è il/la Manager di riferimento per la crescita delle persone, lo sviluppo della leadership, la creazione di una cultura e di processi innovativi verso un’organizzazione aziendale adattiva, skill based ed orientata al cambiamento.
Guida un team di specialisti e lavora a stretto contatto con il Leadership Team e HR Business Partner per allineare le persone agli obiettivi di business e rendere il cambiamento una leva di successo
Responsabilità principali:* Definire e implementare la strategia di Talent che comprende Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, People Development, Training e Skill Management
* Guidare iniziative e programmi di Change Management per supportare progetti di trasformazione organizzativa, HR innovation ed evoluzione culturale
* Collaborare con il top management per identificare le competenze chiave del futuro e costruire piani di sviluppo personalizzati.
* Monitorare il clima e l'engagement aziendale, trasformando feedback e dati in azioni concrete.
* Promuovere una cultura basata su diversità, inclusione, empowerment e apprendimento continuo.
* Coordinare team cross\\-funzionali per il lancio di programmi di formazione, mentorship, coaching e upskilling.
* Utilizzare strumenti di People Analytics per prendere decisioni data\\-driven su performance, sviluppo e retention.
* Essere un/una ambasciatore/ambasciatrice del cambiamento, facilitando la comunicazione interna e la sponsorship dei progetti di evoluzione.

  

Requisiti:* Esperienza di almeno 7\\-8 anni in aziende complesse in ruoli HR, con focus su Talent Management, Organizational Development, Change Management
* Competenze consolidate in Change Management, idealmente con certificazioni (es. PROSCI, Kotter, etc.).
* Esperienza nella gestione di team e progetti complessi, in contesti dinamici o in crescita.
* Ottime capacità di comunicazione, leadership e stakeholder management.
* Mentalità strategica e orientata all’impatto.
* Conoscenza di metodologie Agile, Design Thinking o Lean Change.
* Esperienza in ambienti internazionali o altamente regolamentati.
* Inglese fluente (scritto e parlato).

title: CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST
description:
BAXI SPA è un'azienda che progetta e produce apparecchi domestici per il riscaldamento e la climatizzazione a Bassano del Grappa (VI) e che fa parte del gruppo BDR Thermea, tra i leader di mercato nel settore.


Con una storia di quasi 100 anni fatta di ingegno e resilienza, dagli anni '70 l'azienda è entrata nel mondo HVAC. In particolare, oggi offre un’ampia gamma di caldaie a condensazione per il residenziale ma anche di alta potenza per grandi edifici, pompe di calore e sistemi ibridi. **Tutti i prodotti sono progettati per garantire massimo comfort e risparmio energetico, con un'attenzione costante alla sostenibilità,** che ci ha portato a progettare e produrre per primi una caldaia interamente funzionante a idrogeno. Facciamo parte di un gruppo unito, che collabora per raggiungere obiettivi sfidanti, valorizzando ciascuno nella sua unicità.

**Oggi Baxi vanta il più grande stabilimento europeo per la produzione di caldaie** ed è ha una posizione commerciale di punta nei principali mercati europei e mondiali. La nostra realtà aziendale è un ambiente dinamico e internazionale con opportunità di crescita e formazione a diversi livelli.

  

  

**Posizione:**
--------------

**La tua mission**


La tua missione sarà ottimizzare e potenziare il programma di fidelizzazione rivolto agli installatori.

 **Il team**


Risponderai al Trade Marketing Manager e lavorerai a stretto contatto la persona responsabile della Customer Experience dei clienti e con il team Sales \\& Marketing. Avrai inoltre la possibilità di relazionarti internamente con tutta l’organizzazione.

 **Le attività in cui sarai coinvolto saranno principalmente:**

* Co\\-progettare le azioni volte a far crescere il numero degli installatori fidelizzati, attraverso scouting dell’audience, tecniche di segmentazione avanzata per creare offerte e comunicazioni mirate, incentivi personalizzati che rispondano alle esigenze specifiche di ciascun segmento, referral, raccolta di feedback su azioni di miglioramento.
* Ottimizzare l’esperienza dei clienti per rafforzare il legame con il brand e aumentare la partecipazione al programma di loyalty
* Customer care a supporto operativo all’installatore che aderisce al programma, attraverso mail/telefono, per favorirne partecipazione e adesione al programma
* Utilizzare strumenti di data analytics per raccogliere dati quantitativi e qualitativi dai clienti, identificare tendenze e pattern nei dati raccolti, capire quali strategie funzionano meglio e dove è necessario apportare miglioramenti
* Monitorare costantemente lo stato avanzamento delle attività e del raggiungimento dei target previsti nel progetto, creando report dettagliati sui risultati dell'analisi e condividendoli con il team per prendere decisioni strategiche.

**Requisiti:**
--------------

**Sei la persona giusta se ti riconosci in quanto segue:**

* Hai una laurea preferibilmente in Marketing
* Hai esperienza di almeno 2 anni in ruolo simile in contesti organizzativi strutturati
* Hai una competenza avanzata nell’uso dei tools IT come Office365, Power BI, CRM per la gestione di documenti e analisi dei dati
* Hai ottima capacità di lavoro in team
* Hai un forte orientamento al cliente, con eccellenti doti di comunicazione e relazione interpersonale

description:
BAXI SPA è un'azienda che progetta e produce apparecchi domestici per il riscaldamento e la climatizzazione a Bassano del Grappa (VI) e che fa parte del gruppo BDR Thermea, tra i leader di mercato nel settore.


Con una storia di quasi 100 anni fatta di ingegno e resilienza, dagli anni '70 l'azienda è entrata nel mondo HVAC. In particolare, oggi offre un’ampia gamma di caldaie a condensazione per il residenziale ma anche di alta potenza per grandi edifici, pompe di calore e sistemi ibridi. **Tutti i prodotti sono progettati per garantire massimo comfort e risparmio energetico, con un'attenzione costante alla sostenibilità,** che ci ha portato a progettare e produrre per primi una caldaia interamente funzionante a idrogeno. description:
De Nora is an Italian multinational company, listed on the Euronext Milan stock exchange, a global provider of innovative technologies and solutions, and is recognized as a partner of choice for significant industrial electrochemical processes. Since its foundation in 1923, De Nora has been driven by the philosophy of continual improvement. Today, it is the world’s largest supplier of high\\-performing catalytic coatings and insoluble electrodes for electrochemical and industrial applications. It is also a leading supplier of equipment, systems, and processes for water disinfection and filtration. De Nora is committed to developing unconventional solutions to achieve the energy transition to decarbonization, the green hydrogen economy, and clean water for everyone.
   

  

 OUR VISION: Leverage available talents as catalysts for a sustainable future.
   

  

 OUR MISSION: Agility \\& green technologies for value creation.
   

  

 We are looking for an HR Communication and Social Media Specialist to join our Corporate HR team.
   

  

 If you are passionate about communication, social media, and HR, this is the opportunity for you!
   

  

 Under the supervision of the tutor and working closely with HR colleagues worldwide, as well as external creative and communication agencies, the resource will support programs and initiatives aimed at positioning De Nora as an Employer of Choice, attracting talents, boosting employee engagement and retention through all social media and digital and physical touchpoints.
   

  

**Join us and make a difference!**
**What You Will Do**
* Communication Strategy: support the definition and execution of the communication strategies, both online and offline, to increase De Nora's reputation and attract new talents worldwide;
* Social Media: help manage the social media editorial plan by generating engaging content and coordinating inputs from different stakeholders/functions like Reputation, local HR teams, and Marketing at a global level;
* Social Community: help build and proactively engage with the social community;
* Creative Campaigns: support the creation of campaigns and new formats aimed at attracting potential candidates and boosting internal engagement by working closely with external creative agencies from ideation to delivery;
* Digital Presence: help to monitor De Nora's digital presence from a reputation perspective on social media (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and WeChat), career website, job boards, and university portals;
* Events: assist in planning digital and physical events such as webinars, career days, job fairs, hackathons, innovation challenges, research labs and presentations at universities and high schools;
* Success Measurement: help measure the success and business impact of key campaigns and events, with relevant reports;
* People Development: support people development programs and initiatives such as training content design and delivery, competence mapping, assessments, job rotational programs;
* Collaborate closely with the Marketing and HR Internal Communication to create cross\\-channel communications.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in public relations, marketing, communication, HR, or related fields, or in economics or management
* Excellent written and spoken English is a must. Other languages are a plus
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite – Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Knowledge of tools like Photoshop and In\\-design is a plus
* Good knowledge of social media and web analytics tools
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Passionate about people and curious about workplace culture, diversity, and the employee experience
* Enthusiastic, proactive attitude and problem\\-solving skills
* Ability to work autonomously and ability to build relationships across the organization with others in HR, recruiting, marketing, and communication
* Creative mind balanced with the ability to articulate data and insights.


 LI\\#SC1
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride of our diverse and inclusive environment. We aim to attract and recruit individuals with diverse backgrounds, skills, and abilities, who will enhance the quality of our products and services and contribute to the Group’s success. We are committed to prioritize talent, make people feel respected, appreciated, and free to fully express their potential.

 Continuous Improvement

 Business Administration / Economics / Finance Degree or equivalent
 



  





**Languages** 




 Fluent English (both written and spoken). Experience abroad is a plus
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




 \\- Knowledge of controlling, business administration, capital budgeting, economics
 



 \\- Use of Microsoft Office applications (advance use of Excel and PowerPoint is a plus
 



  





**Soft Skills** 




 • Analytical skills
 



 • Attention to details
 



 • Planning and organizational skills
 



 • Team working
 



  





**Contract and Benefit** 




 6 months internship
 



 Monthly Reimbursement of 1000 Euros
 



 Free access to internal canteen for lunch and Meal vouchers for each day of remote activities
 



 Free shuttle for Chiesi employees from raliway station to HQ or free pass for urban public transport

description:
***The chance to build a better future is right in front of you***
------------------------------------------------------------------

  


***Do Work That Matters*** **\\- Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità**

Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse


Il **Digital Assurance Team** è un team all’avanguardia di KPMG in cui diverse competenze collaborano per dare forma alla digitalizzazione del futuro dei servizi di assurance e revisione contabile. Avrai l’opportunità di lavorare a fianco di revisori esperti sviluppando, attraverso la formazione interna ma soprattutto il training on the job, la capacità di analizzare criticamente i processi aziendali a supporto dell’informativa finanziaria e i dati elaborati dai sistemi informativi delle società identificando elementi di anomalia ed interpretando le dinamiche alla base dei trend economico\\-finanziari.

  


**Starting date:** Settembre 2025


**Tipologia di inserimento:** Apprendistato

  


Nello specifico ti occuperai di:

  


* Sviluppo di soluzioni di **analytics** a supporto dei team di audit (transactional analytics, dashboard di analisi di dati contabili, process mining, KPI di processo, ecc)
* Sviluppo di tecniche di revisione basate sull’utilizzo di **soluzioni tecnologiche innovative**
* **Supporto ai team** nell’utilizzo delle soluzioni proposte
* Cura di **eventi di comunicazione** volti a far conoscere il progetto / le soluzioni

  




***Come As*** ***You*** ***Are \\- Le tue competenze e caratteristiche***

Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:


* Hai una formazione di base **economico\\-contabile**
* Hai spiccato interesse per l’area del **reporting finanziario** e per i **data analytics**
* Hai voglia di **imparare** e metterti in gioco
* Vuoi crescere all’interno di un **Network Internazionale**

  




***Your Future With Us \\- Cosa troverai in KPMG***


* Un ambiente di **lavoro inclusivo**, equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le **diversità**
* Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la **creatività** e il **lavoro di squadra**
* Modalità di lavoro **ibrida,** per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale
* Programmi di **formazione** e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati
* **Mindset** **internazionale** e **progettualità innovative**
* Iniziative incentrate sul **benessere psicofisico**

  

  

***Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno***


Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i **Valori di KPMG** che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di **esprimere tutto il loro potenziale**.


Grazie all’impegno nel favorire un **ambiente di lavoro inclusivo**, il nostro Network ha ottenuto le **certificazioni ISO 30415**, che attesta la conformità del Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l’Inclusione, e **UNI PdR 125**, che certifica la parità di genere. All’interno del nostro **Impact Plan** \\- Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) \\- trovi riassunte tutte le **azioni concrete** che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance (**ESG**).

  


**Unisciti a noi!**


*I tuoi dati saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto delle disposizioni del Regolamento (UE) n. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation \\- "GDPR") e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare l'informativa sulla privacy di KPMG**.*


*KPMG S.p.A. garantisce le pari opportunità.*


*\\-*  



*The chance to build a better future is right in front of you*

  


***Do Work That Matters \\- Your Role and Responsibilities***


Do you want to do work that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, society, and your colleagues tackle and solve the most current and complex challenges.

  


The **Digital Assurance Team** is KPMG’s innovative team which brings together different skill sets to shape the digitalization of the future for assurance and audit services. You will have the opportunity to work alongside expert auditors – through in\\-house courses and especially on\\-the\\-job training – developing the ability to critically analyse the company processes used in financial reporting and the information processed by the companies’ IT systems, identifying errors and interpreting the dynamics underlying financial performance.

  


**Starting date:** September 2025


**Type of contract***:* Apprenticeship

  


Specifically, you will be tasked with:

  


* The development of **analytics solutions** for audit teams (transactional analytics, dashboards for the analysis of accounting data, process mining, process KPIs, etc.)
* The development of audit techniques based on the use of **innovative technological solutions**
* **Assistance to the audit teams** in using the new solutions
* The organization of **communication initiatives** to raise awareness of the project/solutions.

  


***Come As*** ***You*** ***Are \\- Your Skills and Characteristics***


This is the perfect opportunity for you if:  



* You have a business/accounting background with a **degree in business subject**
* You have a strong interest in **financial reporting** and **data analytics**
* You have a desire to **learn** and **challenge yourself**
* You want to grow within an **International Network**

  




***Your Future With Us \\- What You Will Find at KPMG***  



* An **inclusive** and equitable **work environment** that respects, encourages, and values **diversity.**
* A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages **creativity** and **teamwork.**\\[NL1]
* **Hybrid** work arrangements to promote a healthy work\\-life balance.
* Advanced **training** and development programs to stay current.
* **International** mindset and **innovative projects.**
* Initiatives focused on physical and **mental well\\-being.**

  

  

***Together for Better – Our Values and Commitment***


Leadership, teamwork, respect for individuality, continuous learning, transparency, community engagement, integrity: these are the **values of KPMG** that create an environment open to the exchange of ideas and knowledge, allowing our professionals to **express their full potential.**


Thanks to our commitment to fostering an **inclusive work environment**, our network has obtained **ISO 30415 certification**, which attests to the compliance of our Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and **UNI PdR 125** certification, which certifies gender equality. Within our **Impact Plan** \\- Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) \\- you will find a summary of all the concrete actions we are taking on environmental, social, and governance **(ESG)** issues.


**Join us!**


*Your data will be processed in full compliance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) no. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation \\- “GDPR”), as amended. For more information, please see KPMG’s privacy policy**.*


***KPMG S.p.A. is an equal opportunity employer.***

title: CEE Sales Planning & Analysis Coordinator
description:
**Job description**  

With more than 3\\.500 employees, the Safilo Group is a worldwide leader in the premium eyewear sector for sunglasses, optical frames and sports eyewear. With an international presence through 30 owned subsidiaries in primary markets – in America, Europe and Asia – and exclusive distributors, Safilo produces and distributes its home brands such as Polaroid, Carrera, Smith and the licensed brands such as BOSS, Hugo, Carolina Herrera, Tommy Hilfiger, Fossil, Kate Spade, Marc Jacobs, Pierre Cardin, Moschino, Levi’s, Missoni.


**CEE Sales Planning \\& Analysis Coordinator** will be the key responsible person within Safilo Central European team for maintaining and constant improving of the sales planning, forecasting and sales execution processes across all the countries of the Region.


**Key Accountabilities:**



In your role as CEE Sales Planning \\& Analysis Coordinator you are fully involved into the business from day one, entrusted with the following areas of responsibility:


* Active involvement in delivering the Region’s monthly, quarterly and annual business targets by acting as the regional **Sales Execution owner**:
	+ Weekly Regional Orderbook consolidation and analysis
	+ Weekly Sales Forecast submission
	+ Key contact person for the countries’ Commercial managers and Sales Operations coordinators regarding goods availability and KA customer supply plans in constant collaboration with Customer Service Team Leader
  


* **Ownership of CEE sales planning process** in cooperation with sales, marketing and finance based on historical data and information on prospective promo actions and sales events.
	+ Monthly Sales Plan elaboration for the following countries: Turkey, Poland, Hungary, Czech republic, Slovakia, Slovenia, Croatia and CEE countries with distributors’ coverage.
	+ Coordination of Russia timely and accurate SP submission
	+ Consolidating full regional Sales Plan and submission to BPC tool
	+ Leading monthly SP alignment meetings with the countries’ leadership teams and CEE \\& North Commercial officer
  


* Acting as **regional Demand planning expert****:**
	+ Responsible for ABC ranking volumes plan for novelties and Ranking accuracy tracking
	+ Regular assortment analysis to support commercial decision making: customer selections, samples provisions, etc.
	+ Functional controlling of Russian Local stock planning and consumption
  


* Support and coordinate development of **joint business planning with key retail partners**

  


* Act as **commercial analytics expert for CEE community****:**
	+ Key user of global analytical tools: Tableau, BW Analysis
	+ Coordinate requests or initiate new regular Tableau dashboards creation
	+ Support CEE Commercial Teams with regular and ad hoc analysis: brand productivity and overlap, customer analysis, teams performance, etc.

  




  

**Other Information** **Requirements:**


* Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is required. A Master’s degree is a plus.
* Minimum of 3\\-5 years of experience in sales planning, demand planning, sales operations, or financial analysis, preferably within the consumer goods, fashion, or eyewear industry.
* Proven experience in forecasting, budgeting, and sales analysis.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Strong proficiency in data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
* Fluency in English and Italian is required. Fluency in Russian or another CEE language is a strong advantage.
* Experience coordinating or managing a remote team is a plus.
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to work effectively with diverse teams across different countries.

title: Linguistics Data Analyst - Remote - Milan, Italy
description:

As a Data Analyst on our Linguistics team, you’ll leverage your language expertise to support the development and refinement of language data across our products. Your fluency will directly impact how specific languages are represented and maintained within Lightcast’s global platform. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal part in shaping linguistic features, driving quality standards, and enhancing product functionality. This is a unique opportunity to influence the evolution of language data on a global scale, with meaningful contributions to cutting\\-edge technology.

* Analyze and enhance the data quality of multilingual text classifiers
* Collaborate with linguistics and engineering teams to develop and optimize language parsers
* Translate and align taxonomies across multiple languages, including Skills, Titles, and Occupations
* Create crosswalks from source language skills and job titles to Lightcast’s standardized taxonomies
* Utilize SQL for efficient data handling, querying, and database management

* Bachelor’s degree in Linguistics, Data Analytics, NLP, or a related field (preferred)
* Strong linguistics knowledge, including syntax and structural analysis of languages
* Competency in three or more languages — strong preference given to candidates fluent in Danish, Croatian, and Czech
* Knowledge of multinational labor markets (preferred)

 ti sorprenderà con opportunità di crescita che hanno la velocità della tua curiosità.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Descrizione del lavoro
   

  

**Junior Data Analyst**
 Sei un appassionato di
 **dati** 
 e sei alla ricerca di una nuova sfida? Hai la voglia di metterti alla prova e far parte di un'azienda all'avanguardia nel suo settore? Allora abbiamo un'opportunità imperdibile per te!
   

  

 Dogma Systems, azienda leader nello sviluppo di software gestionali b2b innovativi, sta cercando un
 **Data Analyst** 
 per la sua sede presso
 **Via Sant'Ubaldo, 30, Monsano** 
 , AN, Italia. In Dogma Systems, crediamo nell'importanza della fiducia, del supporto e dello spirito di squadra, e ci impegniamo a promuovere valori come l'integrità, la determinazione e la disciplina.
   

  

 Ciò che rende la nostra azienda unica è la nostra forza, l'innovazione, uniti da una grande meta e ispirati da grandi valori. E proprio per questo motivo, stiamo cercando un Data Analyst che svilupperà le competenze per
 **unire i puntini** 
 che i dati ci comunicano. Se sei una persona ambiziosa, motivata e pronta a metterti in gioco, allora questa è l'opportunità che fa per te!
   

  

 Il candidato selezionato avrà l'opportunità di entrare in Dogma Systems attraverso un tirocinio retribuito, con la possibilità di essere poi trasformato in un apprendistato.
   

  

 Le principali responsabilità del ruolo di Data Analyst includono
   

  

* Raccolta e Pulizia dei Dati: Acquisire dati da diverse fonti interne ed esterne e assicurarsi che siano accurati, completi e pronti per l’analisi.
* Analisi dei Dati: Utilizzare tecniche statistiche e strumenti analitici per interpretare i dati, identificare tendenze, pattern e anomalie.
* Supporto alle Decisioni Strategiche: Fornire insights basati sui dati per facilitare decisioni informate riguardo a sviluppo prodotto, marketing e altre aree chiave.
* Creazione di Report e Dashboard: Sviluppare report dettagliati e dashboard interattivi per comunicare risultati e metriche chiave.
* Collaborazione Interfunzionale: Lavorare a stretto contatto con team di sviluppo, prodotto, marketing e vendite per comprendere le esigenze aziendali e tradurle in requisiti analitici.
* Sviluppo di Modelli Predittivi: Implementare algoritmi di machine learning e modelli statistici per prevedere comportamenti degli utenti e performance future.
* Monitoraggio delle Prestazioni del Software: Analizzare i dati sull’utilizzo del software per identificare problemi, opportunità di miglioramento e guidare l’ottimizzazione del prodotto.
* Gestione dei Database: Assicurare l’integrità, la sicurezza e l’efficienza dei sistemi di archiviazione dei dati.
* Conformità e Normative: Garantire che la raccolta e l’utilizzo dei dati siano conformi alle leggi sulla privacy e alle normative settoriali (come GDPR).
* Formazione e Supporto: Educare il personale interno sulle best practice di analisi dei dati e sull’interpretazione dei risultati analitici.
* Automazione dei Processi: Sviluppare script e strumenti per automatizzare la raccolta, la pulizia e l’analisi dei dati, migliorando l’efficienza operativa.
* Valutazione delle Metriche di Business: Definire e monitorare KPI (Key Performance Indicators) per valutare il successo delle iniziative aziendali.
* Innovazione e Miglioramento Continuo: Rimanere aggiornato sulle ultime tendenze e tecnologie nel campo dell’analisi dei dati per implementare nuove soluzioni e metodologie.


 Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra squadra di professionisti dinamici e appassionati, pronti a raggiungere nuovi traguardi e a crescere insieme. Invia subito la tua candidatura per diventare il prossimo Data Analyst di Dogma Systems!

title: Engagement Operations Analyst - Internship
description:
**JAKALA** 
 è un'azienda che lavora su dati, intelligenza artificiale e sviluppo di esperienze per generare un impatto significativo e duraturo a livello globale.
 



  





 Presenti in oltre 30 città in 21 paesi, i nostri team uniscono competenze su strategia, tecnologia, creatività e operations per offrire esperienze personalizzate e soluzioni trasformative ai nostri Clienti, grazie al supporto di dati e intelligenza artificiale. I Jakalers sono un gruppo eterogeneo di oltre 3\\.000 persone, animate da passione, ambizione e idee brillanti. Proprio questa combinazione unica di talenti è il fattore distintivo che ha ispirato il nostro purpose: Together to get there.
 



  





 Creare un mondo migliore è il nostro obiettivo ultimo: la nostra ambizione è generare valore per tutti i nostri stakeholder in modo sostenibile, con particolare attenzione a etica, clima e qualità. Nel 2021, abbiamo scelto di diventare una Società Benefit, dimostrando il nostro impegno di lungo periodo e la volontà di proteggere i principi e i valori che ogni giorno guidano le nostre azioni.
 



  





 Crediamo che la diversità sia la chiave del nostro successo e, per questo, siamo impegnati a creare un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, dove ciascuno possa sentirsi valorizzato per la propria unicità. Tutte le nostre opportunità di lavoro sono aperte ai candidati appartenenti alle categorie protette L.68/99\\.
 



  





**Posizione** 




  





 Per la nostra area
 **Engagement Operations** 
 siamo alla ricerca di un giovane talento che affiancherà il team nel
 **monitoraggio delle campagne Engagement** 
 presso la nostra sede di
 **Nichelino (TO)** 
 .
 



 Se sei alla ricerca di un ruolo dinamico in un team orientato alla soddisfazione del cliente e in forte crescita, questa potrebbe essere l’opportunità giusta per te.
 



  





**In particolare, ti occuperai di:** 




  




* Contribuire all’analisi dell’andamento delle vendite dei prodotti nelle campagne selezionate
* Collaborare al monitoraggio dello stock, alla verifica delle entrate/uscite, e alla previsione delle richieste ai fornitori
* Assistere il team nella gestione e nell’aggiornamento del flusso documentale della merce e della definizione del Demand Planning di progetto
* Partecipare la gestione della piattaforma voucher e del processo di testing
* Contribuire alla risoluzione dei trouble ticket e al supporto operativo del team



  





**Sei la persona giusta per questo ruolo se hai:** 




  




* Formazione in ambito economico, statistico o discipline affini
* Buone competenze analitiche
* Padronanza nell’utilizzo del Pacchetto Office e di Excel
* Precisione nell’analisi e nel monitoraggio dei dati
* Ottime capacità comunicative, attitudine al lavoro in team e proattività
* Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese



  





**Se investi tempo nel nostro percorso di Recruiting, avrai tutto il nostro impegno. E oltre.**

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At D\\-Orbit, we're pioneering the future of space logistics and transportation. Established in 2011, our company is leading the way in helping businesses profitably and sustainably unlock the full potential of the final frontier. As a member of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside a diverse group of highly skilled individuals, all driven by a shared passion for innovation and excellence. Join us in our global mission to push the boundaries of what's possible and take your ambition to new heights. Apply now and join us in shaping the future of space.  

  

We're looking for a motivated **Propulsion Intern** to support our engineering efforts on cutting\\-edge propulsion systems. This role is ideal for someone with hands\\-on experience acquired for example in a student technical team (e.g., Team Studenteschi, rocketry, etc.) and programming skills.


Whether you're currently completing a Master's degree or recently graduated, if you're passionate about space propulsion and ready to work hands\\-on with cutting\\-edge propulsion technology, we want to hear from you.

* Assist with data acquisition, test stand setup, and analysis of experimental results.
* Write tools/scripts to automate design or analysis tasks (Python, MATLAB, C\\+\\+, etc.).
* Help document engineering work clearly and thoroughly.

 **Requirements**

* Master's degree (completed or in progress) in Aerospace, Mechanical, or related field.
* Proven hands\\-on experience in a student engineering team related to propulsion or vehicle systems.
* Strong grasp of propulsion fundamentals (fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, combustion).
* Programming familiarity (Python preferred; MATLAB/C\\+\\+ is a bonus).
* Familiarity with CAD tools (SolidWorks, Fusion 360\\) and engineering analysis software.
* Basic understanding of piping and instrumentation diagram.

 **Nice to have**

* Experience with propulsion system testing (cold\\-flow, hot\\-fire).
* Background in embedded systems, control, or electronics.
* Familiarity with engine cycle analysis, turbomachinery, or cryogenic systems.

 **What You'll Gain**

* Experience in real\\-world propulsion R\\&D.
* Opportunity to work alongside experienced aerospace professionals.
* Exposure to hardware development cycles and test campaigns.

* Excellent interpersonal skills

* Accuracy and attention to details
* Excellent proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word
* Teamworking attitude, self\\-reliance, stress and conflict management
* Results\\-oriented and problem solving approach

Ability to draft operational and economic\\-financial documents  
*
