title: Demand Planning Internship (Curricular) - May 2025
description:
### **Position**

During this 6\\-months internship, you will support permanent product demand and allocation activities within the **Demand Planning Team** for the **WW Retail Channel.**

### **Job responsibilities**

Particularly, you will be involved in the following activities:


* Permanent reorder and allocation database maintenance (tracking files)
* Delivery plan monitoring to promptly identify delays and corrective actions, including update of related files
* Re\\-orders creation in ROL
* Download of pre\\-defined reports and analysis update (sales monitoring vs target, etc.)
* Data consolidation from different functions (regional forecast, etc.) and preparation of presentations for management meeting
### **Profile**

* Master's Degree in Management Engineering or other relevant studies
* Strong analytical skills and propensity for planning and reporting
* Advanced knowledge of MS Office package, knowledge of B.I./Business Objects considered a plus
* Luxury product sensibility
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written
* Precision, proactivity, flexibility and team working
* Good communication skills
### **Additional information**

This is a **6\\-month full time internship** starting from **May 2025\\.**

**Benefits:**

* Gross Monthly Compensation: 800€
* Ticket restaurant
***LORO PIANA***
**MAISON**
---------------------------

Originally from Trivero in northern Italy, the Loro Piana family began trading wool in the early 1800s. In 1924, Pietro Loro Piana founded Ing. Loro Piana \\& C., the current company. Pietro’s nephew Franco took over in 1941, and after the war the firm began to establish its reputation as a supplier of premium wool and cashmere textiles for a growing haute couture industry, both home and abroad. In the 1970s, Sergio and Pier Luigi Loro Piana took up the reins, diversifying into luxury goods and developing an international retail arm. Now the world’s foremost cashmere processor, Loro Piana prides itself on sourcing the very finest, rarest raw materials the world has to offer, including unique cashmere from baby goats in northern China and Mongolia, vicuña from the Andes, extra\\-fine Merino wool from Australia and New Zealand and lotus flower fiber from Myanmar. The company draws on both time\\-honored traditions and state of the art technology to offer its discerning customers products that are renowned for their peerless quality. All of the company’s collections of ready\\-to\\-wear garments and accessories are made in Italy to the highest standards of craftsmanship and sartorial excellence.

title: Proposta di tesi-Architettura per il Manufacturing
description:
TXT Group è un provider IT end\\-to\\-end internazionale di consulenza per soluzioni software e servizi, che supporta la trasformazione digitale dei prodotti e dei processi core dei clienti. Con un portafoglio software proprietario e una profonda esperienza nei domini verticali, TXT Group opera in diversi mercati, con un'impronta crescente nei settori aerospaziale, aeronautico, della difesa, industriale, governativo e fintech. La Capogruppo TXT e\\-solutions S.p.A. è quotata presso Borsa Italiana, al Segmento Star (TXT.MI), da luglio 2000\\. TXT Group ha sede a Milano e ha filiali in Italia, Germania, Regno Unito, Francia, Svizzera e Stati Uniti d'America.
  
  

**Proposta di tesi\\-Architettura per il Manufacturing:**  

TXT è alla ricerca di tesisti per un progetto di tesi triennale nell’ambito dei servizi industria 4\\.0 e 5\\.0 per le aziende in ambito manifatturiero.
  
  

Titolo del progetto
  
INCREASE Architettura di riferimento.
  
  

Contesto
  
  

L’obiettivo principale del progetto è quello di creare una nuova offerta di servizi industria 4\\.0 e 5\\.0 per le aziende in ambito manifatturiero. I servizi sono focalizzati sulla gestione e estrazione di valore dai dati di produzione, facendo leva sulla costruzione del Digital Twin del processo di produzione, per sviluppare servizi come la previsione della qualità, l’ottimizzazione della produzione con minimizzazione di tempi morti, di setup/manutenzione dei macchinari e di costi energetici.
  
  

Il Progetto INCREASE ambisce a offrire un sistema integrato, modulare e completo, basato su tecnologie di avanguardia come Digital Twin, Intelligenza Artificiale, realtà estesa (XR) e altre a supporto delle PMI (ma non solo). Questo sistema consente alle aziende manifatturiere di sfruttare i benefici derivanti dai servizi dell'industria 5\\.0, evitando però la necessità di investire ingenti risorse per comprendere e gestire tali tecnologie prima di ottenere risultati tangibili. Il fine principale è anche quello di agevolare le imprese nel passaggio verso modelli operativi più snelli, predittivi e capaci di adattarsi ai cambiamenti, grazie all'impiego di strumenti digitali innovativi e strategie di Change Management focalizzate a semplificare l'adozione delle nuove tecnologie.
  
  

Attività previste
  
Analizzare lo stato dell’arte riguardo le architetture di riferimento in ambito manufacturing che abilitano la rappresentazione/digitalizzazione di un’azienda, dallo shopfloor al livello decisionale, abilitando, su richiesta, la comunicazione sicura inter\\-company;
  
Definire e progettare la Reference Architecture per il progetto INCREASE che sia in grado di soddisfare i requisiti di progetto (i.e., data engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Twin, Industry5\\.0, etc.), generalizzandoli e traendo ispirazione dai più recenti risultati provenienti dal mondo scientifico;
  
Definire possibili implementazioni (Reference Implementation) considerando le più importanti tecnologie cloud presenti sul mercato (i.e., Microsoft, Amazon, Google, etc.) e, soprattutto, il mondo open source (i.e., Apache, FIWARE, etc.).
  
  

**Requisiti richiesti:**  

Conoscenza dei principi di progettazione software;
  
Capacità di analizzare i requisiti e documenti scientifici;

description:
**IT Business Analyst Intern \\- Financial Services**

  


*We let the future guide us.* *Join our next generation*

  


**Do Work That Matters \\- Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità**  

Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. **KPMG Advisory** offre servizi di consulenza alle imprese per affiancarle nella trasformazione del business model, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, nell'analisi e nella gestione dei rischi, nonché supporto nelle operazioni di finanza straordinaria. In particolare, entrando a far parte del **Team Enterprise Platform**sarai impegnata/o della gestione dei **processi di cambiamento** aziendali; in particolare, insieme a colleghe e colleghi esperti, analizzerai i requisiti strategici utili a implementare le migliori **soluzioni digitali** presenti sul mercato per la **gestione integrata dei processi**.


Nello specifico di occuperai di:


* analizzare i **requisiti di business** attraverso sessioni di approfondimento e interviste con le aree aziendali coinvolte nel processo in momenti diversi;
* progettare la soluzione migliore per il cliente utilizzando soluzioni **SAP** standard, preconfigurate o personalizzate;
* **analisi funzionale** e tecnica dei processi end\\-to\\-end;
* **test** interni e con gli utenti della soluzione software;
* supporto e **formazione** agli utenti finali;
* supporto al team di progetto durante il rilascio.

Sarai coinvolta/o su progetti nazionali e internazionali al fianco di professioniste e professionisti altamente qualificati e lavorerai a stretto contatto con i nostri clienti del settore dei **Financial Services**, tra cui banche, assicurazioni e società di investimento.


***Come As You Are \\- Le tue competenze e caratteristiche***

Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:


* Laurea in economia, ingegneria gestionale o simili;
* la motivazione a lavorare nell'ambito dell'information **technology** con clienti del settore dei **servizi finanziari** (banche e assicurazioni);
* ottima conoscenza della lingua **inglese**, preferibilmente con esperienze di studio e/o lavoro all'estero;
* ottima conoscenza di **Microsoft Office**.

***Your Future With Us \\- Cosa troverai in KPMG***


* Un ambiente di **lavoro inclusivo**, equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le **diversità**
* Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la **creatività** e il **lavoro di squadra**
* Modalità di lavoro **ibrida,** per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale
* Programmi di **formazione** e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati
* **Mindset internazionale** e **progettualità innovative**
* Iniziative incentrate sul **benessere psicofisico**

Questo team è presente nelle sedi di **Milano, Roma, Napoli, Bologna, Torino.**

  


**Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno**


Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i **Valori di KPMG** che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di **esprimere tutto il loro potenziale**.


Grazie all’impegno nel favorire un **ambiente di lavoro inclusivo**, il nostro Network ha ottenuto le **certificazioni ISO 30415**, che attesta la conformità del Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l’Inclusione, e **UNI PdR 125,** che certifica la parità di genere. All’interno del nostro **Impact Plan** \\- Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) \\- trovi riassunte tutte le azioni concrete che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance (ESG).


**Unisciti a noi!**


*I tuoi dati saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto delle disposizioni del Regolamento (UE) n. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation \\- "GDPR") e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare l'informativa sulla privacy di KPMG.*


**KPMG Advisory S.p.A. garantisce le pari opportunità.**

**IT Business Analyst Intern \\- Financial Services**

  


*We let the future guide us. Join our next generation*

  


**Do Work That Matters \\- Your Role and Responsibilities**


Do you want to do work that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, society, and your colleagues tackle and solve the most current and complex challenges. **KPMG Advisory** offers consulting services to businesses to support them in transforming their business models, improving and digitizing processes, analyzing and managing risks, and providing assistance in extraordinary financial operations. Specifically, by joining the **Enterprise Platform Team** you will be involved in managing corporate change processes. Together with experienced colleagues, you will analyze the strategic requirements necessary to **implement the best digital solutions** available on the market for **integrated process management**.

  


In particular, you will be responsible for:


* Analysing the **business requirements** via in\\-depth sessions and interviews with the company areas involved in the process at different times;
* designing the best solution for the client using standard, preconfigured or customised **SAP** solutions;
* functional and technical analyses of end\\-to\\-end processes;
* **internal tests** and with users of the software solution;
* support and provision of **training** to end users;
* supporting the project team during the **release**.

This team is present in the offices of **Milan, Rome, Naples, Bologna, Turin.**


You will be involved in national and international projects alongside highly qualified professionals and will work closely with our clients in the **Financial Services** sector, including banks, insurance companies, and investment firms

  


**Come As You Are \\- Your Skills and Attributes**

  


To be the ideal candidate, you should have:

  


* A master's degree in business, engineering management or similar;
* Motivation to work in information technology with financial services clients (banks and insurance companies);
* Excellent knowledge of **English**, preferably with study and/or work experience abroad;
* Excellent knowledge of the **Office suite**.

**Your Future With Us \\- What You Will Find at KPMG**


* An **inclusive** and equitable work environment that respects, encourages, and values diversity.
* A stimulating and **dynamic** context that fosters creativity and teamwork.
* A **hybrid work** model to promote a healthy work\\-life balance.
* Advanced **training** and development programs to stay up\\-to\\-date.
* An **international mindset** and **innovative projects**.
* Initiatives focused on physical and **mental well\\-being**.

**Together for Better – Our Values and Commitment**


Leadership, teamwork, respect for every individual, continuous learning, transparency, community engagement, and integrity: these are **KPMG’s Values**, which create an **open environment** for the exchange of ideas and knowledge, allowing our professionals to reach their full potential. Thanks to our commitment to promoting an inclusive work environment, our Network has achieved the **ISO 30415 certification**, attesting to the compliance of our Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and the **UNI PdR 125** certification, which confirms gender equality. Our **Impact Plan** \\- Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) – summarizes all the **concrete actions** we are undertaking on environmental, social, and governance (**ESG**) issues.

  


**Join us!**


The requested data will be processed in full compliance with the provisions of European Regulation 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation \\- "GDPR" or "Privacy Regulation") and its subsequent amendments and integrations.  



**KPMG Advisory S.p.A. guarantees equal opportunities.**

**British American Tobacco Italy has an exciting opportunity for an IDT Supply Chain Internship, in Rome, Italy****.**


Understand business requirements processes, digital technologies and techniques, support to identify technology and/or process opportunities, working with Business \\& IT to develop, support to implement and maintain solutions which deliver business value. The area of responsibility, work close with her/him report, includes but is not limited to: SAP Change Request, User Acceptance including the setup phase (eg data preparation), where applicable support the coordination of the colleagues in the activities to be performed for sample management in the systems, manage new role profile creation in SAP.


**Your key responsibilities will include:**


* Digital Technology Analysis \\& Implementation
* Stakeholder Engagement \\& Supplier Management
* Process Management

* Degree in information technology, engineering, mathematics, statistical sciences.
* Desire some basic experience or knowledge in Digital Technologies (if possible SAP)
* Ability to interpret the business IT and functional strategies
* Creative profile and presence for facilitation and with influencing skills
* Confidence
* Positive attitude and desire to work collaboratively with a team
* Excellent attention to detail and a high motivation to learn
* Fluency in English and Italian languages.

* **We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)**
* **Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work\\-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives**

**Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience** **here****.**  

  

**If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best during the recruitment process, you are encouraged to notify us. We are fully committed to support you by making appropriate arrangements for you to demonstrate your full potential.**

title: International Labelling Compliance Internship
description:
**About Barilla**
=================

  


At Barilla, we believe that every great journey begins with passion and a bold vision. From our humble beginnings in 1877 in a small shop in Parma, Italy, we’ve blossomed into a global leader in the food industry, guided by our commitment to progress and excellence.

  


Today, Barilla is an international group present in more than 100 countries and we are proud to be recognized as the world’s top food company by reputation. With 22 beloved brands in our portfolio, we are world leader for pasta, the number one choice for ready\\-made sauces in Europe, leader for bakery products in Italy, and for crispbread across Scandinavia with Wasa.

  


Our success story is written by a passionate team of almost 9,000 dedicated employees across 30 plants and offices worldwide, all united by a shared mission to nourish the future with purpose and passion.

  


**Are you ready to add your unique flavor to our journey?**

  


### **Working context**

  

  

The unit is responsible for the labelling process cross RD\\&Q and cross Regions. Working on the management and improvement of the labelling software in place to guarantee the correct mandatory contents of product labels for all markets.

  


### **Job purpose**

  

  

* Working within the labelling platform, opening the task, checking presence of contents, then deciding which Mandatory Content on packs should be added/updated. Accordingly activate the appropriate Content Owners within all RDQ. Maintain continuous contacts with RDQ and legal departments tracking artwork approval Manage the reworking process of mandatory labelling contents in case of artwork rejection deciding which RDQ actors should be involved.
* Work on the database review started few months ago and, in collaboration with IT, complete the data upload in the system. Finalize the collection of the data check from the regions and be active part of the upload in the platform checking the correct allocation of the data with a deep understanding of the technical aspects.
  


### **Main activities**

  

  

* Lead the RDQ labelling timing having visibility on all labelling project steps monitoring completion of tasks, defining and mitigating causes of delay. Close the artwork project when all mandatory contents and approvals have been received. Review the formal presence of contents after the amends by the Content Owners. Assure the presence of required languages on pack and, when necessary, send request for translations to ICM (International Compliance Manager).
* Understanding the Barilla labelling process and the actors involved at a global level. Build strong collaboration with RDQ, marketing and legal departments within the labelling process. Collaborate with Technical Regulatory in the nutrition panel review and further upload. Work in close collaboration with the Content coordinator to reach a deep understanding of the usage and management of the database.
  


### **Requirements**

  

  

* Master’s degree in Process Engineering, Food \\& Technology, Quality \\& Food Safety or equivalent
* Analytical approach and strong computer skills
* Attitude to team\\-working and collaborative approach
* Curiosity, openness to new and different ideas
* Good communication and negotiation skills
* Proactivity and can\\-do attitude
* Fluency in English, both spoken and written
  

Start date: June 2025

  


At Barilla, we are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where diversity in all its forms is valued and embraced. Our employment policies and practices are designed to ensure equal employment opportunities for all, regardless of age, race, color, citizenship, faith, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or characteristics of expression, sexual orientation, marital status, genetic information, medical condition, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Our commitment to equal employment stems from our unwavering belief that it is not only the right thing to do, but it is also a fundamental driver of innovation and business success.

title: Trainee Engineer
description:
**Informazioni su Crown**  

  

Crown Holdings, Inc., leader mondiale nel settore del packaging metallico, progetta e produce un’ampia gamma di soluzioni innovative e sostenibili. Con la sua presenza globale collabora con alcuni dei più importanti marchi internazionali di beni di largo consumo.  



Questo è un momento entusiasmante per la nostra attività e l'ingresso in Crown vi offre l'opportunità di crescere e sviluppare le vostre competenze in un settore in espansione.  



La nostra azienda, fondata sul valore della sostenibilita’ e della sua promozione, continua il suo impegno a lungo termine per il futuro.


**About this opportunity**
--------------------------


**About the Role**


We are looking for motivated and enthusiastic interns to join our team.


This internship provides an excellent opportunity to gain hands\\-on experience in a dynamic and professional environment, working alongside experienced professionals.

Prysmian is a global cabling solutions provider leading the energy transition and digital transformation.

Your contribution to Prysmian's Success:

* Support processes of pre\\-contract agreement for survey

* BAS

* Knowledge of GIS systems

* Availability to short but possibly frequent trips, domestic and abroad
* No experience or experience in same or similar role and area
* Knowledge of / experience in geophysical or geotechnical data acquisition or processing

* Hybrid working model: 8 days per month

description:

Role description  

The Code Development (CDV) unit of the R\\&D Codes and Methods department at newcleo is seeking applicants for the position of Fuel Performance Specialist in the domain of thermo\\-mechanics and computer simulation of lead\\-cooled fast reactors. The Fuel Performance Specialist will support the engineering studies with consolidated knowledge of fuel rod performance. This expertise will be reflected both in the computer code modelling and results analysis, proposing new ideas and solutions with a scientific mindset. This position will supervise and actively contribute to the verification and validation process of the fuel performance computer code TRANSURANUS applied to MOX fuel rods under prolonged irradiation in lead\\-cooled fast reactors. This role contributes to the company’s objectives in the field of advanced reactor physics and calculation methods.  

The CDV unit of the Codes and Methods department supports the development of computer codes, physical correlations and nuclear data, methodologies, and engineering applications for criticality and shielding, reactor design and safety studies. The successful candidate will work jointly and in coordination with other research staff to apply knowledge, practices and techniques to the existing methodologies used for reactor studies.

Represent the company in international research projects
Coordinate the fuel performance research group and provide expert judgement
Implement Verification and Validation of TRANSURANUS physical models for MOX fuel rods

PhD in Nuclear Engineering
Fluent English and Italian; French as optional

Deep knowledge of thermo\\-mechanical computer codes used in the nuclear industry.
Consolidated knowledge of nuclear engineering principles, theories, and practices for the design and analysis of reactor systems, possibly for fast reactors.
Experience with FORTRAN and Python programming.
Scientific mindset when approaching new tasks.

description:

**HSE Internship – Taranto, Italy**  

*Are you looking for an internship within the wind energy sector? Join Vestas and become part of a team based in Taranto with national and international scope, offering strong opportunities for professional development.*
In Taranto, Vestas Blades Italia S.R.L. operates one of the most modern blade factories in the world, producing blades for both onshore and offshore wind turbines. Our customers range from local enterprises and project developers to large international power producers and grid operators.


To strengthen our capabilities in Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE), we are looking for a student passionate about sustainability and workplace safety to join our HSE team at the Vestas Blades Italia production plant in Taranto.


The HSE department is responsible for ensuring compliance with safety and environmental regulations, promoting a culture of safety, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives across all areas of the factory.


As an intern, you will work closely with our HSE professionals, operations team, and other key stakeholders across the factory. The department embraces a collaborative and inclusive culture, where teamwork, learning, and communication are at the core of what we do.


**Responsibilities:**
You will be involved in the daily work of the HSE department, contributing to both strategic and operational tasks related to health, safety, and environmental management. Your tasks may include:


* Supporting the implementation and monitoring of HSE policies and procedures
* Participating in workplace safety inspections and audits
* Assisting in risk assessments and incident investigations
* Contributing to the development of safety awareness campaigns and training materials
* Supporting waste management, sustainability, and environmental reporting activities
* Performing data analysis and reporting on HSE KPIs
* Providing support on ad hoc tasks across different departments with a focus on safety and environment

You will also have the opportunity to learn about:


* ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 standards
* Best practices in incident prevention and root cause analysis
* Regulatory compliance in industrial HSE contexts
* Continuous improvement in workplace safety and environmental sustainability

**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Engineering, Safety Engineering, Industrial Engineering or similar. A Master’s Degree will also be valued.
* Availability to join a full\\-time internship program in Taranto.

**Competencies:**
* Passion for HSE topics and eagerness to learn
* Strong organizational and problem\\-solving skills
* Proactive and structured mindset
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
* Strong communication skills
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
* Fluency in Italian; English at a conversational level (A2 or higher)

**What we offer:**
A hands\\-on learning experience in a dynamic, future\\-oriented industry. You’ll become part of an innovative team at the forefront of the energy transition, working with people from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative environment. At Vestas, your ideas are heard, your growth is supported, and your contribution makes a real impact.


**Do you want to join us?**  

Apply to this internship and start your journey with the global leader in sustainable energy.
**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**  

It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\\-recruitment\\-process
**DEIB Statement**  

At Vestas, we recognise the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
**About Vestas**

title: Project and Program Management Stage / Intern
description:
humane and excellent, we collaborate with our clients and partners using imagination, technology and rigour to shape a better world.

  



We are looking for an Intern (STAGE/TIROCINIO) to join our Project and Program Management team within ARUP Milan Office, Italy.



Arup Project and Program Management manages building, industrial and infrastructure projects throughout the world. Our understanding of the design, tender and construction process and our ability to bring relevant technical experience to a project gives us the capacity to deliver projects of excellence that meet client requirements on time and within budget.



**Requirements:**


* MS degree in Architecture, Engineering or Management of the Build Environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering or Design
* Good knowledge of Auto CAD
* Knowledge of 3D Modelling, Adobe Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator and Acrobat
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines;
* Ability to work independently as well as within a team environment;
* Fluency in the English and Italian language.
* The following will be considered a plus:
* Interior design experience
* Knowledge of rendering
* Attendance of Project Management classes or courses


**Rewards and Benefits**



We offer a competitive salary at all levels and one of the best benefits packages in our sector.



Core benefits including flexible working arrangements are made available to support and safeguard your financial, physical and mental wellbeing.



**Shape your time with us**



Our goal is to shape a better world. And to do that, we need to make Arup a phenomenal place to work for everyone. If we want to solve problems for people around the world, we must seek and attract the best people from the widest talent pool and create an environment that supports and includes them. We aim to encourage a culture where people can be themselves and be valued for their contribution. This includes people with disabilities, so please discuss any adjustments that you may require throughout the selection and assessment process with your recruitment contact.



At Arup, you'll be an encouraged member of the team with opportunities to participate in cultural and social events with the local community (e.g. as a STEM ambassador) or by joining one of our staff networks for women, culture or LGBT\\+ people. You'll have access to a range of flexible working options – whether you're a parent, a carer, a student, or have a busy lifestyle \\- we recognise it's not always easy to commit to standard working hours so if you're interested in flexible start and finish times, working from home or working part\\-time, please let us know when you apply, and we'll discuss how this could work in your role.



**Join us in shaping a better world.**



We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcome all qualified applicants. You will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to sex, race, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, genetic data, or other legally protected status. We recognise that not all disabilities are visible and will make reasonable adjustments to cater for diverse applicants in the selection and assessment process.

 * You have achieved/are going to achieve a Degree in Sociology (or similar ones), Environment and Workplace Prevention Techniques (or similar ones), Environmental Engineering.

***Do Work That Matters*** **\\- Your role and responsibilities**

  

Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. **KPMG Advisory** offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions.

  

Specifically, when you join the **Transportation Team** in **Rome**, you will focus on business reorganization in procurement and supply chain, innovation and reengineering, strategy and transformation: the goal is to improve the performance of production processes by adapting them to the changing needs of markets and customers.


You will have the opportunity to work together with leading **Transportation clients** on high\\-value strategic projects that have a crucial impact on their business.

  


Specifically, you will be tasked with:

  


* Defining **business strategies** in the transportation industry
* Preparation of **business plans**
* **Feasibility studies** and **economic\\-financial analysis**
* Analysis of **investment sustainability**
* **Reorganization and reengineering** of industrial processes

  




***Come As*** ***You*** ***Are \\- Your skills and characteristics***

  

This is the perfect opportunity for you if you have:

  


* A master’s degree in **Management Engineering**
* **Organizational and teamwork skills** with attention to detail, including the ability to prioritize and manage various complex tasks and activities
* Excellent knowledge of the **MS Office** package
* Excellent knowledge of **English**, ideally with study and/or work experience abroad

* An **inclusive** and equitable **work environment** that respects, encourages and values **diversity**
* A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages **creativity** and **teamwork**
* **Hybrid** work arrangements to promote a healthy work\\-life balance
* Advanced **training** and development programmes to stay current
* **International** **mindset** and **innovative projects**
* Initiatives focused on **mental and physical well\\-being**

  



  

***Together for Better – Our values and commitment***

  


Leadership, teamwork, respect every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity. These are the **KPMG** **values** that create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, so our professionals can **achieve their full potential**.

**Join us!**

  


*Your data will be processed in full compliance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) no. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation \\- “GDPR”), as amended. For more information, please see KPMG’s privacy policy.*


*KPMG Advisory S.p.A. is an equal opportunity employer.*

title: TRADE MARKETING – INTERNSHIP
description:
About the job  



For our **Sales** division in **Milan** we are looking as of now for a Trade Marketing Intern.



During your internship you’ll be part of a dynamic and passionate team leading the most important innovation for the company and you’ll have visibility on all the company’s departments and you’ll contribute to the achievements of your team.

  


**About the job**



You’ll collaborate with several company’s departments (Sales, Marketing ,Category and Supply Chain) to develop your analytical skills and to discover competitive dynamics of fresh dairy products’ market.



In details, you’ll be involved on:


* Sales and market trends analysis (sell in and sell out analysis);
* Coordination of promotional activities in stores involving Sales Field Force;
* Creation of communication and POP materials in retail channel;
* Management of relationships with creative agencies and stakeholders.

About you

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role, we believe you need to have:


* Master’s degree in Economics or Marketing or Management Engineering;
* Problem solving and entrepreneurial thinking;
* Structured and analytical way of working;
* Relational skills and flexibility;
* Previous international and/or internship experience will be a plus;
* Excel and Power Point knowledge;
* Fluent in English.

About us
**About us**



As a world leading food company DANONE stands for international success. Around 104000 employees work on all five continents in the three Danone business areas **Essential Dairy \\& Plant\\-Based, Specialized Nutrition and Water** on one corporate mission: “Bringing health through food to as many people as possible”.



We want to invite people to join the movement for a healthier world. We recognize the power people have to impact the world through their daily choices. Each time we eat and drink, we vote for the world we want to live in. We believe a healthy body needs healthy food and healthy food needs a healthy planet: this is what our new signature **One Planet One Health** embodies.



Do things your way. The way you work, the way you develop, the way you progress, it’s all up to you.



Working here you’ll need to enjoy a fast\\-pace, complexity and it can get a little challenging. But it’s packed with opportunities. You’ll work with some of the best\\-known brands in the world and we absolutely guarantee that you can just be yourself.



Be innovative and entrepreneurial and the impact you could make might just amaze you. Join our movement for a healthier world. One Planet One Health BY YOU.

  


**We offer**


**We believe in a “Phygital” workplace.**



Phisycal because our offices are centrally located and easily reached by public transportation. Free water, yogurt and fruits are of course benefits for our employees.



Digital as we work for objectives, without time or space constraints, in a responsible, autonomous and flexible way that helps to reconcile life and work times, improving productivity and focusing on results.

  



We offer you a culture, where you’ll be welcomed to bring in ideas and take initiative. You’ll learn from colleagues highly committed and passionate about what they do. We believe in learning something new each day as it means you keep growing every day!



We believe everyone has talent, something which comes natural to you. Your uniqueness is something which brings both excellence as well as energizes you.

  


**In Italy we are Certified Great Place to Work and B Corp.**

  


**Inclusive Diversity**



Danone is committed to create and live an inclusive \\& diverse environment, which will drive our growth as a business, as teams, as members of communities \\& as individuals. Valuing diversity is recognizing and respecting human differences and similarities. Our aim is to ensure that all employees and applicants are given equal opportunity and that our organization is representative of our consumers and society.



We commit to foster an inclusive working environment where we celebrate all types of diversity, both visible and invisible, which includes age, race, gender, nationality, disability, background, education, religion, beliefs, thinking style, perspectives and sexual orientation.



We believe that our differences will make the difference.



In Italy from march 2023 we are Certified for Gender Equality (UNI PDR 125/22\\).

  


**What’s next?**



Willing to start your meaningful journey? **Hit the apply bottom!**

  



Join us! Follow **@idanoners\\_italia** on Instagram! See life at Danone from the front row

  


*Your personal data will be processed in compliance with the EU Regulation 2016/679\\.*


*La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006 ed è aperta a candidat\\* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso.*

title: System Administrator
description:
In vista dell’apertura del nostro nuovo Drive Technology Center a Bologna che, con una superficie di 8\\.000 mq ospiterà attività di manutenzione, assemblaggio e logistica e reparti di ingegnerizzazione specializzata, oltre a un centro di Ricerca e Sviluppo, una Drive Academy per la formazione tecnica di alto profilo e un’area di co\\-engineering con circa 70 postazioni dedicate ai partner siamo alla ricerca di un/a System Administrator per supportare l’infrastruttura IT della sede.


Dopo un primo periodo di formazione (circa un mese) presso la sede di Solaro (MI), la persona sarà responsabile della progettazione e gestione della rete interna e del data center, garantendo sicurezza, efficienza e continuità operativa.
 

**Ti occuperai di** :


* Monitorare e garantire la continuità operativa della sala server
* Progettare e sviluppare le infrastrutture IT
* Gestire macchine virtuali (VMware)
* Amministrare utenze e credenziali con Active Directory
* Configurare e supervisionare backup virtuali e fisici
* Monitorare le reti e la sicurezza informatica
* Supervisionare la domotica del building
* Fornire supporto IT tramite il sistema di ticketing

**Chi sei:**  

Un/a professionista appassionato/a di tecnologia con una forte attitudine al problem solving e una buona capacità di lavorare in team. Ti distingui per l'orientamento al risultato, il pensiero innovativo e un'ottima gestione delle priorità.


**Le competenze che padroneggi:**

Tecniche


* Diagnostica e risoluzione dei problemi hardware/software
* Conoscenza dei sistemi operativi Windows (client e server)
* Esperienza nella gestione di backup e ripristino dati
* Sicurezza informatica: firewall, antivirus, IDS/IPS, gestione delle minacce

title: BIM Intern
description:
**BIM INTERN**


If you are keen on BIM approach and ETIM standard, don't miss the opportunity to apply to intern in our **DProject Team**.

 **How you will support the team:**


D.project team has the ownership of BIM (Building Information Modelling), which is a widely used method of designing buildings and infrastructures that helps minimize interference and unforeseen events during the construction phase.


As to that, one of your goals is to design a Firefighting Room with BIM approach, through Autodesk® Revit®: one of the most popular BIM software. The project will be in compliance with UNI EN 11292 and EN 12845\\.


Secondly, you will help the team in standardizing our product data accordingly to ETIM standard (European Technical Information Model).

 **Who you are:**

* Studies in mechanical/electrotechnical/management/construction/civil engineering (student or graduate);
* Fluent in English;
* Good Excel (formatting, conversion, tables);
* CAD basics;
* Ability of synthesis and schematizing;
* Teamwork.
* 

**Why you should join us:**


You will become an integral part of our Global Team where people are friendly and work together in a stimulating and fast\\-changing environment.


You will get in contact with our colleagues worldwide and closely work with other departments, getting the overview about how a multinational organization works.


Training will be core since the beginning: you will receive training about our products, ETIM, BIM and our main enterprise tools, in particular PTC® Windchill®, Autodesk® Revit®, and the master data management system (Stibo System Step).


Finally, we are offering monthly reimbursement from €600/monthly (gross), free canteen and IT toolset.

description:
**Position Mission**


The candidate will learn to design and implement a scalable, distributed infrastructure to manage large volumes of video data and process it in real time using artificial intelligence algorithms. Furthermore, you will gain experience in the management of video surveillance systems and IT security to ensure the correct functioning of the system and data protection. Programming ability in languages such as Python, Java, and C\\+\\+ and familiarity with artificial intelligence platforms such as TensorFlow or PyTorch are necessary characteristics to be able to carry out the tasks.


The ability to collaborate with other team members, such as software engineers, data analysts and security experts, will ensure the effective integration of AI solutions into existing infrastructure.


During the activities, the principles of cloud architectures and containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes will be explored in depth to support the implementation of a flexible and scalable infrastructure.


The candidate for this position must possess a combination of skills in software engineering, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and distributed architecture, in order to develop and maintain the AI\\-powered video surveillance system AiDA with distributed processing capabilities.

 **Responsibilities**

* Analyzing the functional and performance requirements of application problems, to identify the most appropriate algorithms to be implemented
* Designing the most effective and efficient algorithms and data structures for solving application problems, with particular focus on AI technologies
* Analyzing the completeness and quality of the input data for the algorithms to be developed
* Contributing to the choice of the technology stack, programming patterns and frameworks to be adopted
* Developing the software starting from writing the source code until field tests
* Drawing up the necessary documentation
* Estimating the time required for algorithm design and software development
* Testing the developed software to highlight any bugs
* Monitoring the quality and functionality of the software applications over time.

 **Technical Skills, Qualifications and Professional Experience**


Master's degree in STEM subjects, preferably Computer or Automation Engineering


Programming experience in C/C\\+\\+ and/or Python


Knowledge of the principles underlying cloud architectures and containerization technologies (docker, kubernetes).


Excellent knowledge of Italian and English

  

It is considered a plus \\- Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence/Machine/Deep Learning technologies, with particular focus on Computer Vision issues (TensorFlow framework, PyTorch, Keras...)

title: Internship - Supply Chain Production Planning
description:
DISCOVER PIRELLI
  
  

We are a global leader in the tire industry, specialized in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing high\\-performance tires for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. With a presence in over 160 countries and around 18 production facilities, we pride ourselves on our cutting\\-edge technology and commitment to sustainability. Innovation is at the heart of everything we do, and it is fueled by our commitment to the inclusion of unique perspectives and different experiences. Because power is nothing without our people!
  
  

WHY JOIN US
  
  

We are offering a rewarding role with scope for career progression along with:
  
  

* International, engaging, and supportive working environment.
* Competitive reimbursement.
* Free company restaurant.
* Personal and professional development.


DRIVE YOUR FUTURE
  
  

You will join the Supply Chain team, within the Production Planning department, and will have the opportunity to gain an overview from both a business and an industrial perspective. This internship offers hands\\-on experience, providing a unique opportunity to develop your skills in a dynamic, fast\\-paced environment.
  
  

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
  
  

**You will collaborate with your tutor in:**  

* Defining the production plan of the assigned factories in line with the mix, quantity, times and stock targets
* Granting the product availability for the product range of the assigned plants
* Creating and producing regular reports on KPIs, using data analysis software such as Excel or business intelligence tools like Qlik

*We have a clear vision of how it wants to help make the world a better place, by giving back to communities and supporting what's really important for our future.*

  

The position we are looking for involves supporting the management of environmental engineering and environmental permitting work. The candidate must have a second\\-level degree or master's in environmental disciplines or equivalent. knowledge of the following tools is required: Word, Excel, Acrobat, AutoCAD, GIS.


The training project includes support in:

* Managing projects in the field of environmental engineering in the waste, manufacturing, industrial, and remediation sectors
* Managing environmental data related to various types of projects
* Reporting
* Organising and controlling field activities

**Internship contract duration:** 6 months Potential for company placement after the internship.

A good command of the English language is essential, along with precision in work, the ability to provide technical support, and a commitment to proactive and diligent work. * Our flexible working policy \\- We recognise the importance of **work\\-life balance** and encourage you to find yours.
* WSP is about making the world around us a **better place**, including the environment, transport infrastructure, buildings and land use.
* Excellent **career** prospects. We're growing fast, and every day we strive to outdo ourselves. We are open to your ideas and want to try **new** things. We have a supportive environment that invests in your **development** and training.
* WSP is about embracing a culture of **collaboration** with colleagues who stand out for their **skills**. Come and discover our fantastic team!

**OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS:**



* Telephone interview: We'll start with a telephone interview to get to know you better and discuss your experience.


* HR/Manager Interview: You will meet with our TA team and the department manager to assess your technical and cultural skills.


* Interview with the Business Unit Director: A meeting with the Business Unit Director to discuss your potential role and our strategic vision.


**ABOUT US:**


We are one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Our trusted employees share a common goal of making a positive and lasting impact on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity and inclusion.

**Are you hesitating to apply? Go for it!** We are proud to promote diversity, equal opportunities and professional integration within our teams, and we are convinced that our differences and an inclusive working environment contribute to our development. All applications will be carefully considered.

**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**

**What you'll be doing**


The Services Architect is a subject matter expert and a pre\\-sales persona working with clients and sales/delivery teams in a value co\\-creation process resulting in the design of Managed Services solutions across multiple technology domains.  

  

This role is responsible for the development of competitive, innovative, secure, multi\\-year, viable Managed Services solutions and associated costing inputs to commercial models.  

  

The Services Architect applies both solution design and sales attitude to engage and help close opportunities with decision\\-makers.  

  

This role has the opportunity to design managed services with some of the most innovative global organizations, technologies, accelerating the digital transformation business objectives and outcomes.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Guides a virtual team of domain experts to orchestrate the development of secure, multiple year, solution services.
* Designs complex managed service solutions to meet client requirements by integrating technology and service design across multiple domains.
* Works across multiple teams in the design of the Managed Services offering.
* Tests and validates new designs features and delivery models or recommend improving existing service offers that is being taken to market.
* Responsible for the service design deliverables of the solution and interfacing with multiple teams and partners to ensure supportability.
* Directs the validation processes by obtaining sign\\-off from technical, service and costing stakeholders.
* Leads the service design of solutions for the client that will be commercially competitive whilst mitigating risk.
* Maps the client's requirements against proposed set of service elements and architectures and leads the end\\-to\\-end solution development.
* Supports the sales teams in presenting an architecture solution to clients with a focus on cost savings or uncovering other client growth opportunities using the ability to discover and analyze the client’s current architecture, platforms and operating models.
* Responsible for vendor management depending on the service offers and ensures that the transition to service delivery teams are well coordinated to ensure a smooth transition.
 **To be successful in this role you are asked to have:**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in IT/Engineering/Economics field equivalent degree;
* Broad level of knowledge across Enterprise Architecture, Managed Services, Service Management consulting, and multiple solution services areas (e.g. Networking, Security, Hybrid Cloud, Digital Workplace);
* Ability to develop a service transformation architecture to deliver the transformation business, investments, activities, deliverables, schedules and risks across all service delivery
* Proven experience in designing and implementing new delivery models in a significant globally federated delivery organization;
* Certification and working knowledge of ITIL, Service Management and Integration models:
* Good sales attitude;
* Proven client engagement experience;
* Good knowledge of main hyperscale cloud providers ( Amazon, Microsoft, Google)
* Fluent in English ( written and verbal)
 **We offer:**

* A people centric culture;
* A collaborative work environment;
* Career and training pathways;
* Multinational environment with a local nuances;
* Respect and inclusion for any kind of diversity;
* Hybrid working approach;
* Inclusion approach: the recruitment process will also consider candidates based on law 68/99\\.
 **Company location:** Milano (close to MM Romolo)

**Workplace type****:**

**About NTT DATA**  

NTT DATA is a $30\\+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\\-term success. We invest over $3\\.6 billion each year in R\\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start\\-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  


**Purpose of the job:**


Define and execute the Services Material scheduling and Inventory strategy according to customer needs and internal constraints and in coordination with Industrialization and Operations departments

  


**Responsibilities**


* Guarantee material availability through appropriate needs scheduling and follow\\-up
* Improve Services performance in term of material availability and inventory management
* Define the order\\-reorder strategy to optimize the inventory coverage reducing the stock\\-out occurrences
* Set parts categories (based on ABC, variability, business type...etc) for defining planning strategy and line replenishment
* Provide to sourcing department the forecast of the material needs and the list of priorities in terms of source of supplying to be contractualized
* Define and implement action plans and improvements in the planning process
* Support Planning and Forecasts planning strategy defined by Global Planning
* Define and set\\-up MRP parameters to implement material planning strategies and ensure the data accuracy on SAP
* Improve of the specific tools used for planning, based on the historical data and according to the customer plan
* Analyze Inventory content for correcting planning strategies.
* Support finance for inventory depreciation calculation
* Implement and manage improvement plan in regard of Inventory reduction
* Measure performance in Supply Chain processes and create reports for analysis

  




**Requirements**


* Degree in Economics, Engineering or related field
* Previuos experience in the same role (1 or 2 years)
* Good Knowledge Office pack specially Excel
* Knowledge ERP SAP (MM Material Management)
* Fluent Italian, good Knowledge English language
* Flexibility, Teamworking, Result Orientation, Problem Solving and Proactive Approach complete the profile

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  


**Important to note**


As a global business, we’re an equal\\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Contribute to planning the operational budget, considering everything from financial and labour planning

Strategic planning for the next three, six and twelve months, with a particular focus on peak\\-season planning
  
Be accountable for operational leadership by measuring performance, offering feedback, and providing development support

You’ll be based at one of our operational sites/You’ll split your time across a number of our operational sites. At the same time, you’ll focus on long\\-term objectives. This includes creating contingency plans to keep operations running and mitigate against disruptions and driving initiatives that boost quality, safety and productivity. You’ll be a source of accountability and a business\\-wide champion of best practice.

title: Trust & Safety Analyst – Rider Operations(They/He/She)
description:
If you're here, it's because you're looking for an **exciting ride**.



A ride that will fuel up your ambitions to take on a **new challenge and stretch yourself beyond your comfort zone.**



We'll deliver a **non\\-vanilla culture built on talent, where we work to amplify the impact on millions of people**, paving the way forward together.


**Not your usual app**. We are the fastest\\-growing multi\\-category app connecting millions of users with businesses, and couriers, offering on\\-demand services from more than 170,000 local restaurants, grocers and supermarkets, and high street retail stores. We operate in more than 1500 cities across 23 countries.



Together we revolutionise the way people connect with their everyday needs, from delivering essentials to connecting our ecosystem of users through innovative solutions powered by technology. For us, every day is filled with purpose.


**What makes our ride unique?**


**Our culture and strong values.**


**Our career development philosophy.**


**Our commitment to being a force for good.**

  


We have a vision: **Building the largest marketplace in your city, to give access to anything in minutes****.** And this is where your ride starts.


**YOUR MISSION**



You'll play a key role in **ensuring the integrity and reliability** of our courier operations across Italy. Reporting directly to the **Head of Operations**, you'll work at the intersection of **data analysis, fraud prevention, and courier experience**, building the processes and insights that keep our platform safe, efficient, and human.


**THE JOURNEY**


* **Analyze operational data** and build dashboards that give real\\-time visibility on courier compliance and performance KPIs.
* Run audits and **monitor courier behavior** to flag potential issues and prevent fraud or platform misuse.
* Be a **point of contact for Glovers**, supporting them on topics like app functionality, payments, and compliance\\-related matters.
* Collaborate with multiple teams to improve processes and **implement scalable, data\\-driven solutions**.
* **Own and manage reporting cadence** (daily/weekly/monthly) for all key compliance and courier support processes.
* **Think beyond the basics**: bring creative ideas to the table that can become game\\-changing improvements for courier experience and operational excellence.
* Combine daily execution with a strategic, long\\-term view — **you're here to build, not just maintain**.


**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE**


* A strong academic background in a quantitative field (Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar).
* At least 1 years of experience in high\\-demand roles (consulting, ops, tech, finance, investment banking, etc.).
* Proactive, autonomous, and driven — you don't wait for instructions, you make things happen.
* Passionate about problem\\-solving and data — digging into root causes is your thing.
* You're empathetic, inclusive, and hands\\-on: you understand both systems and people.
* Advanced Excel and SQL skills, and confident working with data sets to extract insights and build reports.
* Full professional proficiency in Italian and English.


Individuals representing diverse profiles, **and abilities,** encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! **Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.**


**We believe driven talent deserves:**


* Top\\-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
* Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
* Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
* Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
* ️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
* Enhanced parental leave, and office\\-based nursery.
* Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well\\-being.


Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds \\- all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.



Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).


**So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?**



Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our Linkedin and website!

title: ELI - Maintenance Support Engineer
description:
Job Description:
JOB TITLE  

Within Aircraft Maintenance Services Organization, we are looking for a Maintenance Support Engineer for our new base of Brindisi.  

THE ROLE  

The candidate will be inserted in Technical Support Department with the following duties:* Evaluate and manage Work Orders received from Civil/Military Continuing Airworthiness Management Organizations of the Customers.
* Design, maintain and deploy the required Technical Documentation, based on the applicable Maintenance Data and IT tools in order to satisfy the Customer Work Orders to be executed by Aircraft Maintenance Operations.
* Provide technical engineering support to Aircraft Maintenance Operations during maintenance execution for both scheduled and unscheduled tasks.
* Act as a Project Manager during helicopter maintenance liaising with Maintenance Planning, Aircraft Maintenance Operations and Logistic Service Department to design and deploy the maintenance sequence required to execute the Work Order with the best turnaround time possible considering resources and logistics.
* Liaise with Aircraft Maintenance Operations and Logistic Service Department to monitor the progress of activities and enable a timely service delivery.
* Prepare and distribute Reports detailing progress status of the maintenance.
* Generate and distribute the additional instructions (e.g. Engineering Orders, Job Cards) needed to support complex maintenance execution, as per applicable regulations and procedures.
* Act as single interface towards Product Support Engineering Organization when additional maintenance data or clarifications are required from Design Organisation.


The candidate will be the Technical Support Manager for the base of Brindisi.
REQUIREMENTS  

Technical skills* First Level Degree in Engineering or similar (First Level Degree can be replaced by at least 3 years experience on aeronautical field)
* Basic knowledge of project planning, monitoring and control
* Basic knowledge of Civil and Military Aviation Regulations \\& Standards
* Basic knowledge of Technical Publications in Maintenance Organization environment (understanding \\& use)
* Basic knowledge of Technical Drawing and Wiring Diagram (understanding)
* Basic knowledge of Helicopter Maintenance Program \\& Configuration Management
* Type training (theoretical element) on Leonardo Helicopters' products and working experience in Rotorcraft Maintenance Organization environment (Civil \\& Military) will be considered a plus.


Behavioral skills* Good attitude to teamwork
* Ability to work under pressure, sometimes with very demanding deadlines
* Flexibility, proactivity, problem solving attitude.


Linguistic skills* Fluent in spoken and written English


Seniority:
Primary Location:
IT \\- Brindisi
Additional Locations:
Contract Type:
Permanent
Hybrid Working:

title: Research Engineer
description:
**Date:** 22 Apr 2025
**Location:** Torino, IT
**Company:** newcleo
Role description  

The R\\&D Codes and Methods group at newcleo is seeking applicants for a Research Engineer position in the domain of reactor physics and computer simulation of lead\\-cooled fast reactors. The Research Engineer will support the engineering studies with new ideas and solutions, using a research\\-driven approach. Within the reactor physics unit (C\\&M/RPH), this position will focus on the verification, validation and uncertainty quantification of reactor calculations for new LFR units, covering advanced fuel cycles, core design and accidental transients. Code development and computer programming may also be requested to cover punctual needs. The role of this position contributes to the company’s objectives in the field of advanced reactor physics and methods.
The R\\&D group in Codes and Methods supports the development of computer codes, physical correlations and nuclear data, methodologies, and engineering applications for criticality and shielding, reactor design and safety studies. The successful candidate will work jointly with other research staff to apply knowledge, best practices and techniques to the existing methodologies used for reactor studies. The group operates in the areas of reactor physics, transport theory and neutronics, reactor thermal\\-hydraulics and heat transfer, two\\-phase flow, and instrumentation physics.  


Main activities
Participate in individual and collaborative research projects
V\\&V of methodologies for the calculation of kinetic parameters and reactivity coefficients for LFR neutronics
Support engineers and computer code users in routine design and safety studies
Prepare scientific publications, technical reports and presentations
Develop and support the community of users of computer codes
Become an advanced user of deterministic and Monte Carlo computer codes
  


Desired qualifications
Master’s Degree in Nuclear Engineering; PhD in Reactor; Physics or Nuclear Engineering is requested for this position.
Fluent English, with Italian or French as optional languages
Show a scientific mindset when approaching new tasks
Knowledge of nuclear engineering principles, theories, and practices for the design and analysis of fast reactor systems
Demonstrated background in neutron transport and reactor physics
Experience with Python programming

title: Aseptic Product Support ECA Automation Engineer
description:
The Regional Product Support (RPS) for Europe and Central Asia (ECA) within Sidel's SERVICE organization offers an exciting opportunity to engage closely with both our innovative products and valued customers. This role encompasses a diverse range of activities, focusing on providing exceptional support for our service operations as well as our cutting\\-edge new equipment. Specifically, this position involves working with aseptic filler machines from Sidel's extensive portfolio, both old and new.


### **Your Mission**


The Aseptic Product Support ECA Automation Engineer plays a vital role within the Product Support ECA organization, offering a dynamic blend of office\\-based responsibilities and occasional onsite missions. In this position, you will ensure the seamless operational follow\\-up and technical support (on automation side) for all aseptic products associated with the filling platform, including essential trade equipment such as cappers, inspection systems, nitrogen dosers, and printers…, throughout the entire lifecycle of the machines. Additionally, you will be instrumental in providing comprehensive support to your colleagues—Field Service Engineers, Installation Site Managers, Project Managers, Customer Care Managers, and Automation Field Coordinators—ensuring they are well\\-equipped to assist customers through various channels, including email, ticketing systems, telephone communications, and onsite visits. You main missions will be the following:


* Execute troubleshooting on all aseptic filler and associated trade equipment, concerning automation platform
* Secure Non Conformity and warranty cost management
* Support Field Service Engineers during projects and service site execution on automation side
* Apply RCA methodology on automation issues, driving data collection and preventive/corrective action
* Provide daily telephone \\& email and tickets support for automation issues, to our customers
* Secure retrofit application on the filler concerning automation platform
* Secure the preparation and the distribution of the appropriate documentation concerning the troubleshooting of automation issues on filler aseptic equipments.



### **Your Profile**


We are seeking candidates with a Master’s or Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, to join our team. Proficiency in spoken and written English is essential.



Ideal applicants will have a minimum of five years of technical assistance, field experience, or engineering expertise in packaging equipment, particularly in automation.



Familiarity with sensitive and aseptic technology is crucial, and knowledge of filling products and processes will be considered an advantage. Candidates should possess a solid understanding of electrical fundamentals, including safety equipment, sensors, motion control, servo drivers, and inverters. Additionally, experience with PLC platforms such as Siemens S7/TIA Portal (SCL, Graph, AWL), B\\&R, and Rockwell Automation is required. Proficiency in HMI systems (ZenOn, Citec, and/or InTouch) and motion platforms (Danfoss, Elau, B\\&R) will further enhance your application.



Join us and contribute to our commitment to excellence in packaging technology!

###### **Permanent**


###### **Country**


###### **ITALY**


###### **Location**


###### **Parma**

description:
### **Job Specs**

**Job Name**Junior – Cloud Developer \\- NextHub Bari


**Location**Bari


**Business Area**DNH \\- ENGINEERING, AI \\& DATA


**Seniority**Junior


**Business Function**NEXTHUB \\- TECHNOLOGY \\& TRANSFORMATION


### **What impact will you make?**

**Junior – Cloud Developer – NextHub Bari**  

Stiamo cercando una figura junior da inserire nel team **Platform Development \\& Integration** di **Deloitte** **NextHub** nella sede di **Bari**, che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid.  

Il team di Platform Development \\& Integration affianca le aziende durante l’intero percorso di Cloud Transformation guidandole, step by step verso la completa adozione delle soluzioni cloud. In particolare supportano i propri clienti nella definizione della cloud strategy, nel disegno dell’architettura target da implementare, nella migrazione dei workloads in cloud, nel cloud native application development, fino alla governance delle soluzioni Cloud implementate. **Your Role**  

 La risorsa Junior sarà inserita in un team di lavoro, affiancando colleghi senior e occupandosi di:  

* Supportare i propri clienti nella definizione della cloud strategy, nel disegno dell’architettura target da implementare, nella migrazione dei workloads in cloud, nel cloud native application development, fino alla governance delle soluzioni Cloud implementate
* Raccogliere e analizzare i dati a supporto dell’elaborazione di soluzioni per i clienti
* Possedere un forte orientamento al team working, alla collaborazione e al supporto dei colleghi, mantenendo sempre un approccio positivo alle situazioni
* Partecipare ad importanti progetti internazionali End to End lavorando sulla definizione della cloud strategy delle aziende clienti
 **Winning Requirements**  

* Laurea triennale/specialistica in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o discipline tecnico/scientifiche affini
* Conoscenza di almeno un DB SQL e/o NoSQL, conoscenza della programmazione ad oggetti e sviluppo di soluzioni con architettura RESTful e conoscenza di almeno un linguaggio di programmazione (ad es. Javascript, Python o Java).
* Gradita la conoscenza di piattaforme cloud come AWS, Azure e GCP
* Buona conoscenza, scritta e parlata, della lingua inglese
* Disponibilità a trasferte

Deloitte è un network leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, presente in oltre 150 Paesi con 457 mila professionisti. Offriamo soluzioni innovative e sostenibili in Audit \\& Assurance, Consulting, Financial Advisory, Risk Advisory, Tax e Legal. Candidati ora!**  

Le persone interessate possono inviare la propria candidatura con autorizzazione ai sensi del dlgs. 196/2003\\. title: Quality Control Specialist
description:
**Quality Control Specialist**
==============================

#### **At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \\- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \\- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. Write the next chapter of your ABB story.**

### **This position reports to**


Quality Manager

### **Your role and responsibilities**


In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the deployment of the quality strategy for a local organizational unit, including quality culture, systems, tools, and competent teams with the aim to achieve and exceed customer expectations, while ensuring sustainable operations. Each day, you will assist the organization in achieving the right mix of prevention, continuous improvement, robust root cause analysis, quick response, and sustainable solutions to problems. You will also showcase your expertise by collaborating with local functions that impact the quality results to reach the targets for the organizational unit and aim for world\\-class performance. The work model for the role is: \\#LI\\-Onsite. This role is contributing to the Electrification Smart Buildings division located in Santa Palomba. You will be mainly accountable for: • Defining quality requirements, quality gates and the process control plan for new launches. • Supporting product development in early stage to ensure products satisfy quality specifications after launch sales. • Defining quality procedures and being responsible for quality trainings. • Supporting the definition and implementation of actions to improve safety, operating efficiency, quality and productivity in the value chain, to improve customer satisfaction and increase profitability in a safe working environment within the local business. • Leading quality operation on a specific product family: continuous improvement both on process and product, coordinating quality activities in production focused on achieving business target within quality. • Be a reference for suppliers/customers during the process audits to ensure the compliance of working practice, procedures, and production surveillance. • Managing non\\-conformity issues: cooperating closely with other business functions and leading RCA according to DMAIC approach. • Be responsible to manage quality data and metrics according ABB standards.

### **Qualifications for the role**

* You enjoy working with Commitment to deliver results by taking responsibility to execute assigned tasks and projects.
* You have at least 2/3 years of experience in similar roles.
* Possess an enhanced knowledge of Statistical Analysis and statistical software (i.e. Minitab). Knowledge of lean six sigma methodology will be considered a plus.
* You are passionate about Willingness to express your full potential bringing\\-in your value added, ideas and passion to continuously innovate daily job and solution.
* Degree in Electrical/Electronic/Automation Engineering.
* You are at ease communicating in English and Italian, both written and spoken.

### **More about us**


We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. \\#MyABBStory For further info: Letizia Breviario, Talent Partner
