I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

***ROLE OBJECTIVE***


We are currently looking for an Oncology\\-Hematology Key Account Manager to cover Calabria and Sicily. The successful candidate will support the realization of Oncology Business Unit sales plan within own territory, consistently with Business Unit objectives, guidelines and in compliance with local regulations.

***ACCOUNTABILITIES***

* Deeply know own therapeutic area, knowing strengths and weaknesses of competing products, getting insights about the characteristics of the area and centers of expertise (organization and structure centers; main contact, scientific needs, therapeutic orientations, etc.).
* Schedule own business activities consistently with BU objectives, preparing/scheduling interviews / meetings and recording the relevant information collected in order to improve sales effectiveness.
* Provide daily/monthly reports to the First Line Manager in relation to the performance of relevant area and the changes taking place and negotiate periodically the action plan to drive BU results.
* Implement promotional activities for company's products, in terms of projects, events, conferences, etc., within budget constraints.
* Develop relationship and partnership with Key Opinion Leaders at local and domestic level, in order to ensure adequate representation of the company and acquire relevant product efficacy data and market information.
* Develop, sustain and grow highly effective working relationships with key medical institutions, medical and academic societies.
* Identify, develop and foster professional long lasting peer\\-to\\-peer relationships with key physicians, key opinion leaders (KOL) and academic centers and ensure ethical and high level exchange of scientific information.
* Comply with the company Compliance Guidelines, Code of Conduct and Promotional Practices. Adhere to Takeda’s Compliance Policies and Procedures.
* Serve as a direct liaison to the Oncology Business Unit by providing marketplace intelligence/insights that will influence sales, patient strategy/resources and services and promotional strategy/resources.
* Define, in partnership with line manager, plans for accounts that flow logically from analysis to strategy to tactics. Adjusts tactics to needs of accounts. Uses account intelligence to segment and target accounts. Sets clear priorities and stays focused on their delivery. Sets SMART goals/objectives.

***EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE \\& SKILLS***

**Education:**

* Scientific University Degree qualification according to art. 122 of D.Lgs. 219/2006 or being employed as Medical Rep with a date prior to 6 July 2006\\.
* Good written and spoken English is mandatory (at least B2\\).

**Experience:**

* Solid experience in promoting pharmaceutical products with high demand of clinical explanation and a proven track of records.
* Preferred experience in Specialty Hospital as Account Specialist in the oncology market. Ideally good knowledge of local KOLs.

**Skills:**

* Concise and effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Great presentation skills underpinned by but not exclusively relying on good PowerPoint skills.
* Demonstrable thirst for knowledge (technical, clinical, medical, scientific) with an ability to assimilate information quickly, present clinical data clearly and concisely and discuss the statistical and clinical relevance in line with product key messages.
* Develop specific knowledge of the disease and its clinical management based on international guidelines and/or local protocols (i.e. Italian scientific Societies documents).
* Ability to plan start and control projects using core project management principles and tools.
* Highly adaptable and adjusts quickly to change.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of the Italian health care systems.
* Self\\-independent working style and motivated by autonomy.
* Highest ethical standards.
* Passionate and self\\-confident.

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to drive or fly to attend meetings, audits, and training.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Willingness to travel.
* Valid and clean driver’s license.

**Residence:**


 Calabria or Sicily

ITA \\- Rome \\- Remote**Worker Type**
---------------


Employee**Worker Sub\\-Type**

Full time

description:
**Chi Siamo:**


Selefor è una società leader nel settore della consulenza HR, specializzata nel reclutamento di professionisti qualificati per aziende di prestigio. Stiamo collaborando con una rinomata azienda italiana operante nel settore delle tecnologie avanzate, nota per la sua attenzione all'innovazione e all'eccellenza. Nel contesto di un programma di espansione e sviluppo, stiamo cercando una nuova figura da inserire nel team come Junior Data Analyst.

**Responsabilità del Junior Data Analyst**
------------------------------------------


Il Junior Data Analyst sarà inserito in un team di esperti analisti dati e contribuirà attivamente al lavoro di analisi e interpretazione dei dati aziendali. La risorsa selezionata sarà responsabile di supportare la raccolta, l'elaborazione e l'interpretazione dei dati indispensabili per l'ottimizzazione delle operazioni quotidiane.


La risorsa sarà inserita in un progetto in ambito automotive e si occuperà di:

  

* Gestione task
* Estrazioni SQL
* Sviluppo di query per la reportistica
* Supportare l'estrazione e la preparazione dei dati per analisi dettagliate.
* Collaborare con diversi dipartimenti per individuare esigenze e requisiti di analisi.
* Produrre report dettagliati sulle performance aziendali e fornire raccomandazioni basate sui dati.
* Utilizzare strumenti avanzati di Business Intelligence per supportare il processo decisionale.
* Contribuire allo sviluppo di dashboard interattivi per la visualizzazione dei dati.

### **Requisiti del Junior Data Analyst**


I candidati ideali per questa posizione dovranno mostrare una forte propensione per l'analisi dei dati e una buona comprensione delle tecnologie moderne di gestione dei dati. Altri requisiti includono:

* Esperienza di almeno 2 anni nel settore
* Buona conoscenza Power BI
* Buona conoscenza SQL
* Buona conoscenza Service Now
* Inglese fluente
* Laurea in Statistica, Matematica, Economia, Informatica o campi correlati.
* Capacità analitiche consolidate e attitudine al problem solving.
* Buone doti comunicative per presentare risultati e raccomandazioni ai team aziendali.
* Possiedi ottime capacità di comunicazione, soprattutto in ambienti internazionali, dove l’inglese è la lingua
  

di lavoro
* Attitudine a lavorare in team e a interagire con diversi stakeholder.

#### **Offerta di Lavoro**

* Contratto a tempo determinato con possibilità di proroga.
* RAL commisurata in base alla seniority.
* BUONI PASTO (anche in modalità full remote)
* ASSICURAZIONE SANITARIA CON COPERTURA INTEGRATIVA
* Possibilità di crescita professionale e apprendimento continuo.
* Ambiente di lavoro dinamico, orientato all'innovazione e al miglioramento continuo.
* Sede: Roma \\- Ibrido
  

2 volte a settimana presso la sede del cliente (zona Muratella/Magliana Vecchia – Roma)

##### **Come Candidarsi**


Se sei interessato/a a far parte del nostro team e ottenere un'esperienza formativa preziosa come Junior Data Analyst, invia il tuo CV aggiornato con una breve lettera di presentazione. Ci teniamo a conoscere non solo le tue competenze, ma anche la tua passione per l'analisi dei dati.

description:
#### **Marketing \\& Sales**

**About us**


At **Automobili Lamborghini** we constantly work to intercept and spread the uniqueness of each member of the team, aware of the richness that comes from the meeting and exchange of differences. We give great value to time, so we offer you a flexible way of working that meets your daily needs, so as to dedicate important moments of your life to yourself and the people you love.


We are looking for people who want to stand out in a place that makes no distinction of gender, age or culture, working every day to value fragilities as an authentic gift.


We are proud to be certified Top Employer because at the core of our actions we put people and their personal and professional growth. Our main challenge is to contribute to the construction of a future\\-proof society, which is why we have made sustainability our mantra. From your first day in the company, you will have the opportunity to see the results of your commitment, leaving an impact that really has an effect.


We are looking for authentic, brave people, eager to go beyond their limits. In our team you will have the opportunity to trace your path and be its driver, anticipating the times and indicating the route. Not only tasks and goals, but singular people and stories that mix, adding their own color to an iconic Brand: Lamborghini.


**About the job**


Are you eager to take a new opportunity?


Are you looking for a challenging and dynamic environment where to build your professional career?

  


We are looking for a **Pricing** to join our headquarters at Sant’Agata Bolognese (BO), reporting hierarchically reports to the **Head of Product Marketing**.


You will be responsible for preparing analyses and proposals for vehicle pricing, categorized by model and markets (including optional features), while adhering to the positioning guidelines established by Product Managers.


* **Global Pricing Strategy**: Develop and implement pricing strategies for Lamborghini's future range, aligning with business targets and market conditions.
* **Final Approval Process Management**: Oversee the pricing approval process at both company and Group levels, including document preparation and support for marketing teams.
* **Competitive Analysis**: Conduct market and model\\-specific competitive analysis to ensure price competitiveness and profitability.
* **Current Range Maintenance**: Analyse and maintain the current range price positioning by country.
* **Price List Management**: Manage vehicle and price list communication to regions and ensure system uploads
* **Budgeting and Planning**: Handle budgeting and long\\-term planning for the Personalization Business Turnover.
* **Turnover Monitoring \\& Forecasting**: Monitor and forecast of the Personalization Business Turnover.
* **Final Approval Process Management**: Oversee the pricing approval process at both company and Group levels, including document preparation and support for marketing teams.
* VW Group contact person: Serve as the main contact for the VW unit responsible for pricing.
* **Business Intelligence**: Release and maintain BI reports and projects related to pricing and personalization

**About you**


* University Degree
* At least 4\\-5 years of experience in Marketing, Pricing, Market analysis
* Fully proficient in English, German as a plus but not mandatory
* Relational skills
* Time and costs management.
* Process set up and management

  


**What we offer**


* Flexible working
* Holistic Well\\-Being program
* Parenthood program
* Specific job posting for internal employees
* Access to qualified Learning paths
* Development programs


If you are interested in taking a new professional opportunity, please submit your application by May 7th.

* **ETL** \\- Informatica, Talend, IBM Datastage

title: Business Analyst Intern
description:
**Intern \\- Business Analyst** 




**👋 Chi siamo** 




  





 Foorban è il partner food e wellbeing delle aziende innovative.
 



 L’azienda nasce nel 2016 con un modello inedito sul panorama nazionale della ristorazione: è infatti il primo food delivery dedicato alla pausa pranzo a controllare tutto il processo, dalla produzione alla consegna, in modo agile e integrato.
 



  





 Nel 2017 Foorban entra nel mondo della ristorazione aziendale rivoluzionando l’esperienza del pranzo in ufficio e proponendo nuove soluzioni sul mercato.
 



 Siamo i primi ad aver lanciato nel 2021 in Italia il modello degli smart fridge per offrire una pausa pranzo sana, conveniente ed in totale sicurezza a migliaia di lavoratori.
 



  





 Oggi siamo leader di mercato con oltre
 **500 smart fridge** 
 installati nelle aziende di 23 province italiane grazie al lavoro di un team formato da oltre
 **100 persone** 
 .
 



  





 In Foorban ci prendiamo cura di ogni singolo dettaglio, in modo da garantire l’unicità del gusto e un’esperienza semplice e coerente con i nostri valori. Per i nostri piatti prediligiamo un packaging compostabile o riciclabile, cerchiamo di limitare gli sprechi attraverso previsioni accurate basate sui dati e destiniamo i pasti non consumati ai più bisognosi attraverso un accordo con Banco Alimentare e con Too Good To Go.
 



  





**I nostri valori:** 




 Fiducia e Stima, trust your buddy!
 



 Passione ed Entusiasmo in tutto quello che facciamo.
 



 Rispetto: per il lavoro degli altri, per le persone, per l'ambiente, per le cose.
 



 Feedback: non dire hai sbagliato o criticare ma dare una mano, aiutare.
 



 Umiltà ed Empatia: siamo umani, sappiamo ascoltare senza imporre le cose.
 



 Qualità: in tutto quello che facciamo, poco ma fatto bene. No superficialità.
 



 Soddisfazione del cliente: sempre presente nei nostri ragionamenti.
 



 Collaborazione: vinciamo come team non come singoli, WE ARE ONE TEAM!
 



  





**📦 Chi cerchiamo** 




 Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire nel Team Operations come supporto analitico per alimentare i nostri processi di Continuous Improvement ed efficientare le business line operative.
 



 Si dedicherà alla strutturazione e redazione di analisi di performance, allo sviluppo ed implementazione di tool e strumenti e al supporto nell’utilizzo degli stessi.
 



 Saranno quindi importanti le capacità di pianificazione, di esecuzione ed analisi in supporto al resto del gruppo di lavoro nel processo di sviluppo e crescita aziendale.
 



 La risorsa verrà integrata all’interno di un team dinamico e giovane, dove avrà la possibilità di mettersi in gioco e fare la differenza fin dal giorno 1, con un chiara prospettiva di crescita organica e duratura.
 



**🎯 Cosa farai** 



* Produzione di report analitici e qualitativi per validare o confutare le strategie operative
* Monitoraggio dei KPI, individuazione delle anomalie e ricerca delle root cause
* Strutturazione ed esecuzione di analisi sia su GoogleSheets sia su Redash
* Sviluppo, esecuzione, e monitoraggio delle roadmap dei progetti
* Sviluppo del sistema di monitoraggio per garantire un miglioramento continuo delle performance
* Supporto trasversale alle attività di Operations aziendali



  





 🎁
 **Must have** 



* Indole analitica e propensione al ragionamento numerico
* Ottime doti organizzative, proattività e ownership
* Capacità di comunicazione e lavoro in team
* Italiano: fluente (livello C1\\)
* Conoscenza Excel o Google Sheets



  





**👍 Nice to have** 



* Inglese: fluente (livello B2\\)
* Laurea in ambito scientifico/economico



**✍️ Cosa Offriamo** 




  




* Un ambiente di lavoro super dinamico, orizzontale, inclusivo in cui poter fare la differenza
* Un team con obiettivi chiari e condivisi a livello aziendale, ambizioni importanti e una visione di lungo periodo
* Stage di sei mesi a scopo di assunzione (800€/mese)
* PC aziendale
* Pranzo Foorban offerto in ufficio
* Caffè e frutta fresca sempre a disposizione



  





**Sede di lavoro** 




 Uffici di Rho, Via Magenta 77/22A.
 



 Possibilità di lavoro ibrido (1\\-2 giorni a settimana da remoto) dopo il training iniziale in presenza.

**Position**
 The intern, as part of the Internal Control team, will collaborate in developing the company risk and fraud prevention plan, by designing and implementing dedicated tracking tools, effective to monitor trends and create reports and meaningful insights to Top Management. Furthermore, the Intern will provide support in setting up interactive and effective periodic communications on key risk trends.
   

  

 The position is based in Rome HQ.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Learn and understand existing monitored risks and detected fraud schemes and cases to be able to support the enhancement of the creation of tracking tools and effective communications.
* Support the development of a new digital tool to enable monitoring and reporting on detected cases, losses and impacts, frequencies and other relevant connected KPIS
* Collaborate to leverage technology, including IA, to create effective communications on preventive measures to be shared with top management and LVMH
* Assist in the development of systematic analysis on patterns discovered, to enable prevention and anticipation of other risks.


**Profile**
* Bachelor’s degree in economics or engineering
* Fluent in Italian and English
* Excellent skills in Excel, basic knowledge of Power BI
* Curious and with strong analytical skills
* Practical and proactive attitude
* Dynamic and flexible mindset


 This six\\-months internship will start in May 2025\\.
   

  

*LVMH is committed to non\\-discrimination and respect of each person’s singularities. We recognize and recruit all types of talent*

description:
**Position Snapshot**
* Nestlé in Italy, Milan headquarters
* 6 months internship
* Full\\-time in the Milan HQ with some flexibility to work remotely
* Nestlé welcomes people with disabilities
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information technology or related studies and experience
* Effective English communication


**Position Summary**
 Are you ready to become a talented Data Security Specialist by joining our IT Security and Compliance, Digital Technology Security, Data Security team in Milan, Italy?
   

  

 We need your knowledge and expertise to support our cybersecurity applications and technologies, as part of the continuous value delivery of our products in Europe and worldwide.
   

  

 You will be part of the team responsible for supporting security solutions such as database security applications or data labeling and classification (Microsoft Information Protection and Purview), as well as encryption tools, used by our employees and platforms.
   

  

 You will work with other technology specialists to support today's cybersecurity technologies while constantly delivering tomorrow's innovations to our workforce.

* Conduct comprehensive risk assessments of architectural designs, identifying potential security gaps, vulnerabilities, and threats
* Identify and mitigate data security risks and vulnerabilities through encryption, database security, data labeling, DLP, and DSPM technologies
* Ensure systems comply with relevant security standards and regulations
* Develop and/or review frameworks, standards, guidelines, controls, and documentation to support security aspects of relevant areas
* Assist others in resolving complex technical problems and investigating the root cause of problems and recommend smart (specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, timely) solutions


**What else will make you successful?**
* Be passionate about the following technologies: security tools, threat detection systems, compliance management, cybersecurity frameworks
* Excellent English communication skills applied with different stakeholders, nationalities, face\\-to\\-face and remote
* Willingness to work in Agile project teams, providing advice and guidance on opportunities, impact, and risks that take account of technical and architectural needs

Business Development Manager

Your role will involve creating meaningful connections at various levels within financial institutions and engaging with other influencers in the business. Foster relationships with key industry participants, including advisory and IT consulting firms, card schemes, domestic processors, and POS manufacturers.

Relevant experience in sales, business development, or product roles within the financial services industry is preferred, especially in the cards space.

title: (BDAP) DevOps Consultant
description:
Who We Are
  
  

**We are much more than just an IT consulting company:** we are innovators, pioneers, and excellence partners. As one of the largest Atlassian partners in the world, we lead organizations into the future with cutting\\-edge technological solutions. Founded in Chicago in 2000, we now operate in Italy, the United States, India, Switzerland, Ecuador, and the United Kingdom, with the ambition to continue expanding. We specialize in Agile, DevOps, and team collaboration technologies, offering strategic consulting and tailored solutions for SMEs and large enterprises. Every project we undertake is an opportunity to innovate and redefine industry standards.
  
  

**(BDAP) DevOps Consultant:**  

The Role
  
  

Herzum is seeking a skilled and motivated DevOps Consultant to join our team and support one of our Clients in working on the Big Data Analytics Platform (BDAP). The role involves contributing to the design, implementation, deployment, and management of systems and services on the BDAP infrastructure, including potential deployment in public cloud environments.
  
  

We are particularly looking for someone who can set up cloud\\-native services in the BDAP platform, and who is comfortable working on server and VM deployment and automation.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Define and manage procedures for deploying information systems and processing services using Kubernetes.
  
  

Set up and manage CI/CD pipelines for data processing and analysis, integrating with the JRC DevOps platform.
  
  

Assist scientific users in configuring and deploying Kubernetes\\-based processing services.
  
  

Support the deployment of Linux nodes on new hardware.
  
  

Test processing environment deployments in public cloud systems.
  
  

Document all work, including configurations, routines, and scripts, in the project wiki and code repositories.
  
  

**Required Skills:**  

Strong experience with Linux environments (RedHat/CentOS, Debian/Ubuntu), including Bash and Python scripting.
  
  

Proficient in deploying systems and services using Foreman and Ansible.
  
  

Solid knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes orchestration.
  
  

Experience with CI/CD automation tools (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).
  
  

Familiarity with Proxmox.
  
  

Experience deploying services in commercial cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure) or OpenStack\\-based clouds.
  
  

**Non\\-Technical Skills:**  

Ability to work independently and deliver high\\-quality results with minimal supervision.
  
  

Experience working in multicultural and international teams.
  
  

**Work mode:** remote or onsite in Ispra (VA).
  
  

Join Us! Become part of a team driven by innovation, belief in talent, and a commitment to excellence. Your next career step starts here.
  
  

This announcement is addressed to both sexes, in accordance with Laws 903/77 and 125/91, and to people of all ages and nationalities, in accordance with Legislative Decrees 215/03 and 216/03\\.

title: Senior Python Software Engineer
description:
Who We Are
  
  

**We are much more than just an IT consulting company:** we are innovators, pioneers, and excellence partners. As one of the largest Atlassian partners in the world, we lead organizations into the future with cutting\\-edge technological solutions. Founded in Chicago in 2000, we now operate in Italy, the United States, India, Switzerland, Ecuador, and the United Kingdom, with the ambition to continue expanding. We specialize in Agile, DevOps, and team collaboration technologies, offering strategic consulting and tailored solutions for SMEs and large enterprises. Every project we undertake is an opportunity to innovate and redefine industry standards.
  
  

**Senior Python Software Engineer:**  

The Role
  
  

Herzum is looking for a talented and proactive Senior Python Software Engineer to join our team and support one of our Clients on data\\-driven projects led by ECAT scientific staff. The successful candidate will be responsible for the development, maintenance, and documentation of software applications, with a strong emphasis on data analytics, data engineering, and data collection tools. This role covers the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, development, testing, and deployment.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Design, develop, maintain, and document software solutions—primarily in Python—for data analytics, data engineering, and data collection.
  
  

Collaborate closely with ECAT scientific staff on data science projects by managing software engineering tasks such as requirements analysis, implementation, testing, and documentation.
  
  

Participate in project update meetings, stakeholder reviews, and technical discussions.
  
  

Build and maintain robust data pipelines to handle data ingestion, transformation, and storage from various sources.
  
  

Apply best practices in software testing, including unit testing, regression testing, negative testing, and stress testing, to ensure high\\-quality and reliable software.
  
  

Define APIs and deploy tools and services using DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab or similar platforms).
  
  

Debug complex Python systems and resolve deployment\\-related issues, such as environment configuration, dependency management, network analysis, and GPU integration.
  
  

Utilize containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes for efficient deployment and scalability of data science applications.
  
  

Stay current with emerging technologies and libraries in machine learning and data science.
  
Produce clear, concise, and user\\-friendly technical documentation for both end\\-users and developers.
  
  

**Required Skills \\& Experience:**  

Solid experience in software development, particularly using Python.
  
  

Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and experience with test automation.
  
  

Proficient in DevOps tools, CI/CD workflows, and version control systems.
  
  

Skilled in debugging and deploying complex software applications.
  
  

Hands\\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (or equivalent technologies).
  
Excellent technical writing skills in English.
  
  

**Nice to have:** certifications or formal training in Data Science, Machine Learning, or related fields.
  
  

**Specific Expertise:**  

Proven experience in designing and developing scalable data pipelines.
  
  

Deep knowledge of test\\-driven development and hands\\-on experience with software testing frameworks.
  
  

**Non\\-Technical Skills:**  

Strong analytical thinking and problem\\-solving capabilities.
  
Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility.
  
  

Excellent time management and the ability to handle multiple projects with overlapping deadlines.
  
  

Comfortable working in international, multicultural, and remote team environments.
  
  

Strong communication skills in English (C1 level or higher).
  
  

High level of discretion and integrity, particularly when handling confidential or personal data.
  
  

**Work mode:** full remote.
  
  

Join Us! Become part of a team driven by innovation, belief in talent, and a commitment to excellence. Your next career step starts here.
  
  

This announcement is addressed to both sexes, in accordance with Laws 903/77 and 125/91, and to people of all ages and nationalities, in accordance with Legislative Decrees 215/03 and 216/03\\.

**Job Title:** Sales Development Representative  

**Company:** US\\-Based IT Consulting \\& MSP Companies

A leading IT consulting firm in the United States, recognized for its **rapid response times, extensive industry experience, and high\\-quality customer service**. The **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** plays a vital role in **bridging the Sales and Marketing teams**. This position focuses on **identifying new business opportunities, engaging potential clients, and managing outreach efforts**.


Candidates should have **experience in lead generation, sales prospecting, and meeting sales targets**. The role involves overseeing marketing campaigns, maintaining CRM data accuracy, and reporting key sales metrics.

* Conduct outreach through **cold calls, emails, and social media** to engage potential clients.

* Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of all **lead management activities**.

* Minimum of **2 years** of experience in **Sales Development, Business Development, or a similar role**.
* Strong ability to **conduct cold calls and convert leads into appointments**.
* Experience working with **CRM systems and marketing automation platforms**.
* Excellent **organizational and time management skills**.
* Strong verbal and written **English communication skills** (near\\-native proficiency preferred).

* Ability to **manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and follow a structured sales cadence**.
* **Self\\-motivated and results\\-driven**, with a strong focus on achieving targets.


### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience in **IT services or professional services sales**.
* Background in **small business sales development**.
* Familiarity with **database management and lead research**.


### **Why Join This Company?**


* **Fully remote work** with flexible collaboration.
* **Career growth opportunities** within a fast\\-paced IT consulting firm.
* **Structured and supportive work environment** focused on professional development.


### **Application Process**


Qualified candidates are encouraged to submit their applications through the company's career website:  

 https://osprey\\-strategic\\-research.breezy.hr/

**Application Project Manager:**  

The Role
  
  

Herzum is seeking an Application Project Manager to join our team and support one of our Clients in the retail sector. The project involves the implementation of an existing Salesforce platform in a specific country (to be adapted to the local context), carried out by the client’s internal delivery factory (functional and technical teams), with the involvement of corporate business and country business stakeholders.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Coordinate the IT delivery of the Salesforce project (fourth country implemented).
  
  

Planning, understanding of functional and process context.
  
  

**Manage timelines and operational activities:** meetings and minutes, urgent tasks and requirement tracking.
  
  

**Ensure compliance with the delivery lifecycle:** testing, data migration, integration.
  
  

Support CRM and functional processes (orders, invoicing, sales, appointments, stock).
  
  

**Requirements:**  

Proven experience as PM/PMO with 3\\-5 years in IT projects (software implementation, business processes).
  
A solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) is essential. This includes familiarity with methodologies like Agile, Waterfall, or DevOps, and the ability to manage each phase of the lifecycle—requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  
  

Knowledge of the delivery lifecycle and management of CRM/Salesforce projects.
  
  

**Familiarity with frontend processes:** orders, sales, invoicing, stock.
  
  

Ability to adapt to changes and work under tight deadlines.
  
  

Monitoring, stakeholder management, escalation of critical issues to the point of contact.
  
  

Flexibility, ability to anticipate problems, and stress management.
  
  

**Languages:** fluency in Italian and English (written and spoken).
  
  

**Nice to have:** Salesforce expertise.
  
  

**Work mode:** partially remote (3/5 on\\-site, variable) in Milan.
  
  

Join Us! Become part of a team driven by innovation, belief in talent, and a commitment to excellence. Your next career step starts here.

**Organizational Setting**
 In accordance with its Charter, the Office of the Inspector General (OIG) provides oversight of FAO's programmes and operations through internal audit and investigation. The Internal Audit Branch of OIG carries out assurance and advisory activities designed to add value and improve the organization's operations by bringing a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluating and improving the effectiveness of risk management, control and governance processes.
   

  

 The Branch conducts its work in accordance with the International Professional Practices Framework (IPPF), including the Code of Ethics and the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing, promulgated by the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) and adopted by the Internal Audit Services of the United Nations agencies.
   

  

 The post is located in the Internal Audit Branch of OIG at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy. The Branch consists of two units, both headed by a Senior Auditor (Head of Unit): Audit Assurance Unit and Audit Advisory and Professional Practices Unit. Internal audit staff would normally rotate between the two units. The selected candidate will initially be assigned to the Audit Assurance Unit.
   

  

**Reporting Lines**
 The Internal Auditor reports to a Senior Auditor (Head of Unit).
   

  

**Technical Focus**
 Internal auditing.
   

  

**Key Results**
 The planning and execution of audit assurance and advisory engagements at headquarters and/or field offices with the aim to provide independent and objective assurance and advice to the Director\\-General, the Oversight Advisory Committee and the FAO Governing Bodies that the programme or operations of the Organization are carried out with due regard to economy, efficiency, effectiveness and ethics.
   

  

**Key Functions**
* Plans and executes audit assurance and advisory engagements, from the initial planning, information gathering and interview stages to the final analysis and report writing stages, in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing and OIG internal audit procedures.
* Prepares or review, using TeamMate, electronic working papers that support audit engagement observations and conclusions.
* Prepares clear and concise draft reports and presents engagement results, orally and in writing to the Inspector General and FAO management.
* Provides specialist advice as appropriate to managers across the Organization.
* Plans, and/or participates and provides specialist expertise on project, programme, operational or other special reviews, and participates in Organization\\-wide working groups.
* Promotes capacity development in internal auditing and on\\-the\\-job training for other internal audit staff.
* Contributes to maintaining and updating the OIG Internal Audit Quality Assurance and Improvement Programme and the Internal Audit Manual.
* Provides support in developing and/or enhancing internal audit tools and techniques for improved effectiveness of internal audit engagements, including through the use of data, technology and artificial intelligence.
* Undertakes outreach activities to support the implementation of OIG’s communication strategy.
* Contributes to initiatives to strengthen the exchange of information and work practices between OIG’s internal audit and investigation functions.
* Performs other duties and focal point roles as required.
